Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Join Readly!

Readly was built on a simple but powerful idea: that curious people should never have to choose between the publications they love and the ones they haven't discovered yet. One subscription. Thousands of titles. Journalism, culture, lifestyle, science, sport, and ideas from around the world, available on any screen, at any moment.

Readly is now part of Cafeyn Group. With the acquisition of Readly's non-Nordic operations, Cafeyn further strengthens its position as the European leader in access to information – combining scale, technology, and deep local market expertise.

Together, the Group now operates across 15 markets, serves 2.5 million users, and provides access to more than 5,200 publications from 1,100 partner publishers.

Our mission?

To empower individuals with access to trusted, high-quality content that fosters personal growth and discovery. Whether it's through the comprehensive collection of news and features on Cafeyn & Readly, the digital publishing solutions of Milibris, the fun and educative content for children on Kidjo, or the collections for manga lovers by Mangas.io, Cafeyn Group stands at the forefront of digital content experiences.

We are looking for a Marketing Data Analyst to join our team and sit at the intersection of Data, Marketing and Product.

In this role, you will own and analyse our key B2C marketing data, helping Marketing teams better understand performance, identify growth opportunities and make data-driven decisions. You’ll go beyond reporting: from analysing the acquisition funnel and running advanced measurement studies to improving attribution, tracking and marketing performance.

You’ll also play a key role in making our Marketing teams more autonomous by building self-serve reporting and AI-powered data products, while ensuring that our tracking and data infrastructure remain accurate, compliant and up to date.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical skills in SQL and Python with a genuine understanding of B2C marketing, strong analytical thinking and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Product and Data stakeholders, making this a highly cross-functional role with a direct impact on our growth strategy.

Missions


Own B2C marketing KPIs from a data perspective, ensuring that key performance indicators and supporting data points are accurate, reliable and available within a reasonable timeframe for weekly and monthly business reviews.
Support Marketing teams with reporting, helping them define relevant dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance indicators to answer their business questions.
Analyse the acquisition funnel, from awareness through to conversion, to identify growth levers and provide actionable recommendations to Marketing teams.
Run advanced marketing analyses to support strategic decision-making, including initiatives such as Geo-Lift studies, attribution analyses and other measurement approaches. Translate findings into concrete recommendations around budgets, channels and acquisition strategy.
Implement algorithms and analytical solutions to support Marketing Operations, particularly around attribution and marketing measurement.
Improve Marketing team autonomy through self-serve data products, enabling stakeholders to answer their day-to-day data questions without relying systematically on an analyst.
Develop and deploy AI-powered data products and insights, using AI to make marketing stakeholders more autonomous and accelerate access to actionable insights.
Own and maintain marketing tracking, ensuring that implementation remains compliant with regulations and aligned with changes across advertising platforms and the wider tracking ecosystem.
Act as a bridge between Marketing and Product to ensure tracking remains up to date, follows best practices and provides the data and signals required for effective acquisition.
Activate relevant data points within marketing platforms to improve acquisition performance and maximise the value of available customer and behavioural data.


Requirements

We are looking for a data-driven and commercially minded Data Analyst who sits at the intersection of Data, Marketing and Product.

You are naturally curious and enjoy going beyond reporting to understand why performance is changing, identify growth opportunities and turn data into concrete business decisions. You are comfortable owning B2C marketing KPIs and ensuring that the underlying data is accurate, reliable and available when stakeholders need it.

Must-have


Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to independently query, analyse and manipulate data.
Experience working with B2C marketing data, ideally within a subscription-based business, with a strong understanding of metrics such as acquisition, conversion, trials and churn.
Proven experience in marketing analytics and reporting, including the ability to translate business questions into relevant analyses and actionable insights.
Experience with marketing tracking and measurement, including familiarity with GDPR, SKAN, DMA and the broader digital tracking ecosystem.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, with the ability to identify meaningful insights and clearly communicate recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product and Data teams.


Nice-to-have


Experience with Snowflake, Airflow, Segment, GTM and Amplitude
Experience with advanced B2C marketing analytics methodologies such as Geo-Lift studies, Multi-Touch Attribution or Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM).
Experience optimising acquisition strategies through A/B testing, particularly across the upper funnel.
Experience activating and sharing data points with advertising platforms to improve acquisition performance.
Experience developing self-serve reporting tools or AI-powered data products that enable business stakeholders to work more independently.


Hiring process


HR Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Manager (30’)
Hiring manager Interview with our Head of Acquisition & Marketing Measurement
Case study that you will present to our Head of Acquisition & Marketing Measurement and Data Analyst Product & Growth
Last Interview with our Chief of Staff and Head of Marketing


Perks & benefits of working at Cafeyn


🏥 Private health insurance – Euro Accident coverage with a SEK 750 deductible per claim
💰 Pension plan – 4.5% employer contribution on base salary up to 7.5 income base amounts, plus 30% on salary above this threshold
🛡️ Life insurance – Coverage of up to SEK 355,200 (2026)
⚕️ Disability insurance – Coverage of up to 30 Price Base Amounts (SEK 1,776,000 in 2026)
🌍 Easy access – All benefits and work contract are provided through Globalization Partners


You don’t have to match all the requirements, if you feel this offer could be a great opportunity for you, reach out anyways! We hire based on talent and we promote inclusivity inside Cafeyn and strongly believe that our culture is strongest when it is the most diverse.

Title: Rights Analyst - Data Management
Description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.




Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

At HBO Max, storytelling takes center stage. We’re one of the world’s most iconic entertainment brands — home to bold originals and unforgettable characters. While audiences binge award-winning content, breaking news, and sports around the clock, our teams stay busy at work creating what’s next in streaming. From Succession, Euphoria, and The Sopranos to global franchises like Game of Thrones and Harry Potter, our content sparks conversation and shapes culture.

HBO Max delivers boundary-pushing stories across genres and platforms, connecting millions of viewers across 90 countries globally— and we’re just getting started. We're home to the most talked about shows and movies, granting audiences access to the worlds of HBO, Harry Potter, DC, Warner Bros., ID, Adult Swim, A24, and more. Turn your streaming obsession into a career— we’re hiring!

Your New Role...As a Rights Analyst – Data Management, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and governance of rights data across EMEA. You will play a critical role in translating contractual terms into structured system data, enabling compliant content availability across HBO Max and HBO Europe.This role sits at the intersection of Content, Legal, and Operations and is key to enabling accurate rights usage across markets.This is a 12-month fixed term contract.If you are interested in working at the core of content rights management within an international streaming environment, we encourage you to apply.Your Role Accountabilities...
Own the accurate entry, validation, and maintenance of rights data within the rights management system, ensuring alignment with contractual agreements.
Interpret and translate complex legal rights into structured system data.
Perform quality control checks to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
Partner with Scheduling, Content Planning, Operations, and Localization teams to ensure rights availability supports timely content delivery.
Generate and maintain rights reports and dashboards for stakeholders using query tools.
Support cross-regional teams in tracking and validating rights across EMEA markets.
Identify and proactively resolve data discrepancies and inconsistencies.

Qualifications & Experience...
Advanced Excel skills with the ability to manage complex datasets.
Previous experience with rights management systems preferred.
Previous experience with reporting/query tools; SQL preferred.
Previous experience working with structured data in high-volume environments.
Understanding of TV/SVOD rights and content distribution preferred, with the ability to interpret contractual/legal documentation into operational data.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

Title: Power BI & Data Analyst
Description:
Vill du arbeta nära verksamheten och omvandla data till insikter som faktiskt leder till bättre beslut?

Vi söker nu en Power BI & Data Analyst som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för vår rapportering och analysmiljö och samtidigt vara med och utveckla hur vi arbetar med data framåt.

Hos oss får du en central roll mellan IT, Finance och verksamheten. Du kommer att arbeta både med befintliga rapporter och med att bygga nästa generation av vår analysplattform.

Är det dig vi söker?

Om rollen

Som Power BI & Data Analyst ansvarar du för att utveckla, förvalta och förbättra våra rapporter, datamodeller och analyslösningar.

Vi har idag en etablerad Power BI miljö med rapportering inom flera delar av verksamheten. Våra viktigaste datakällor är bland annat Salesforce och Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, med Microsoft Fabric som en viktig del av vår moderna dataplattform.

Rollen handlar inte bara om att bygga dashboards. Vi söker dig som förstår verksamhetens behov, kan strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data och omsätta den till tydliga insikter.

Du kommer också att vara en viktig del i vår fortsatta transformation där vi vill skapa bättre integration mellan våra system, automatisera fler processer och använda AI för att få ännu större värde från vår data.

Du kommer bland annat att:


Utveckla och förvalta rapporter och dashboards i Power BI
Bygga och vidareutveckla datamodeller och semantiska modeller
Arbeta med Microsoft Fabric och vår framtida dataarkitektur
Integrera och analysera data från bland annat Salesforce och Business Central
Säkerställa datakvalitet och skapa en tydlig och gemensam bild av våra viktigaste KPI
Arbeta nära Finance, Sales, Operations och andra delar av verksamheten
Förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till användbara rapporter och analyser
Vidareutveckla och modernisera befintliga rapporter och äldre lösningar
Identifiera möjligheter till automation, prediktiv analys och AI baserat på vår data



🌍 Life as a Power Shifter - Vad erbjuder vi dig


Möjligheten att Make an Impact – ditt arbete bidrar direkt till att fixa planeten och driva energiomställningen.
En värderingsdriven arbetsplats - läs mer om våra värderingar här.
Chansen att äga dina resultat - – väx, ta ansvar och power up i takt med att vi och energibranschen utvecklas.
En inkluderande kultur - olika perspektiv driver innovation, hos oss kan du vara dig själv och bidra med dina erfarenheter, identiteter och idéer.
Trygga villkor - Tjänstepension, 30 semesterdagar, friskvårdsbidrag, parkering m.m.
Flexibilitet/hybridarbete - jobba upp till två dagar i veckan hemifrån.



Vill du se hur livet hos oss faktiskt ser ut? Följ oss på Instagram: @LifeAtSveaSolar

Är vi en match?

Du har erfarenhet av Power BI och tycker om kombinationen mellan teknik, data och verksamhet. För oss är det inte viktigt att du kan allt från början. Det viktigaste är att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och har en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas i takt med att tekniken förändras.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:


Power BI
DAX och datamodellering
SQL och arbete med större datamängder
Microsoft Fabric eller liknande modern dataplattform
Power Query och transformation av data
Integration av data från olika affärssystem
Erfarenhet av analys, BI eller verksamhetsnära rapportering



Meriterande:

Har du erfarenhet av Salesforce eller Business Central ser vi det som ett plus.

Listan kan kännas lång, men ingen är bäst i alla kategorier. Sök om du känner igen dig någorlunda.😊

⚡Vilka vi är

Svea Solar är en av Sveriges - och en av Europas - ledande aktörer inom energiteknik samt leverantör av solenergi och smarta energilösningar. Vi hjälper våra kunder att optimera sin energianvändning med solpaneler, värmepumpar, batterier, laddboxar, elavtal och vår egen mjukvara. Vi kallar det The Power Shift. Och vi som driver det framåt? Power Shifters.

Om vår rekryteringsprocess


Alla kandidater bedöms på lika villkor, med strukturerade frågor och tester via Alva Labs för att säkerställa en rättvis och inkluderande process.
Läs mer om vår rekryteringsprocess här.



👉 Redo att bli en Power Shifter? Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din!

Title: Data Cleansing Analytiker, visstidsanställning, Stockholm – Martin & Servera Restauranghandel
Description:
Är du den vi söker? Nu söker vi en Data Cleansing Analytiker till vårt team Process & Utveckling Artikel. Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning till och med augusti 2027. Du blir en nyckelspelare i vårt arbete med data cleansing för masterdataobjektet artikel. Du kommer fokusera på analysarbete kopplat till data cleansing i PIM och ERP genom att ta fram analyser som möjliggör ökad grad av massuppladdning och minskat behov av manuell rättning i våra artikelmasterdata system.

Uppdraget innebär att metodiskt analysera stora datamängder utifrån givna datapunkter med utgångspunkt i de regler som projektet tagit fram. För att bearbeta artikeldatan så effektivt som möjligt ska du identifiera mönster och genomföra massrättningar i PIM såväl som ERP. Title: CRM Insights Analyst
Description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a CRM Insights Analyst to join on-site in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? 

The Role 

As a CRM Insights Analyst, you will work in the CRM team. Our job is to inform, engage and entertain customers through email, push notifications, and in-app messaging. Working with large-scale customer data, we help onboard, find new favorites to watch, learn to use features and much more – for positive effects on retention, sales, and reactivation. We have established strong personalization capabilities, and you'll play a key role in taking them to the next level through strategic thinking and data-driven innovation.

Your responsibility will be to support the team by creating monitoring, liveboards and reporting, developing them to enable efficient and constantly improving operations. You will also do hands-on analysis of various areas of the messaging and share insights and recommendations with the team and its stakeholders across the Nordics, on how to optimize.

As a CRM Insights Analyst your tasks will include: 


Support the team with hands-on analysis. Identify opportunities and proactively share knowledge and findings with the team and stakeholders based on your findings
Visualize and present results and recommendations in a clear, concise way
Build, own and develop liveboards and reports from multiple sources of data that empower the team to track progress and monitor operations
Oversee, recommend and visualize relevant KPI’s to focus operations on
Ensure that CRM runs on complete, reliable and fresh data. Suggest what items to track, spot anomalies and strive to always improve dashboards and reporting. Work with Data Science teams to make it happen!
Provide guidance on methodology and execution of performance enhancing initiatives such as e.g. A/B testing


We aspire to continuously improve and learn from everything we do. You’ll be challenged and have plenty of fun.

What we’re looking for 

As a CRM Insights Analyst, you will be at the heart of things. It’s essential to be structured, organized, and forward-leaning with a go-getter attitude. 

We are looking for a candidate who is highly analytical and has a business and performance mindset. The ideal candidate is someone who has a good understanding of extracting, wrangling and interpreting customer data to shape it into business recommendations and decisions. You are a proactive self-driven doer with experience from working with digital products in the Nordics and thrive in a collaborative environment, working alongside a highly skilled team and a range of stakeholders within Commercial, Data Science, Product, Content, Finance and more.

To be a successful candidate we believe that: 


You are a strong communicator with experience in visualizing customer data and creating impactful reports and liveboards
You are familiar with SQL, Python or R, and reporting tools such as ThoughtSpot or equivalent
At least two years of experience working with CRM Analytics or Customer Analytics
You hold a post-secondary degree in Business, Finance, Mathematics or a related field, and have 3–5 years of relevant experience
You are passionate about movies, TV series and/or sports
An analytical eye, able to search for constant improvements in messaging effects, process output etc. You are familiar with tapping into data and reports to understand and improve.
Fluency in English


Most of all, you are curious and keen to learn! 

What we offer you

We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.

Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.

A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.

Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

Hit play today 

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

Title: Customer Lifecycle Analyst
Description:
We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. With urban Comfort Hotel®, warm Quality Hotel™, stylish Clarion Hotel® and cosy Home Hotel and more than 40 unique independent hotels, our guests can pick and choose. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 120 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.


Are you a curious, fast-paced analyst who loves turning complex customer and lifecycle data into commercial impact? Do you thrive in an environment where your insights directly shape strategic decisions and customer growth - rather than dying in a presentation slide? If you're looking for a role with high autonomy, sharp colleagues, and the chance to build a true data foundation from the ground up, this is your place to thrive!







We find ourselves at an exhilarating position. We’ve grown to over 250 hotels, broken the historic 20 billion NOK revenue milestone, and transformed how marketing, loyalty, and commercial growth operate at Strawberry. Now, we are taking our lifecycle marketing and personalization capabilities to the next level. We need a proactive Customer Lifecycle Analyst to be the dedicated analytics bridge to our Omnichannel and CRM teams. 



Note: We are currently hiring three distinct analyst roles within our Commercial Insights & Personalization team. While all three share our passion for commercial data and high tempo, this specific role is dedicated to driving real commercial value across our customer lifecycle journeys and personalized CRM efforts.






What you will be doing


As our Customer Lifecycle Analyst, your main role is to be a trusted business partner and commercial challenger. You’ll dive into our customer data, map behavior across lifecycle stages (onboarding, engagement, retention, reactivation), and proactively bring new solutions to the table – including the ones we didn't know we needed. 



A core part of your mission will be to support and empower our Omnichannel team – led by Bjørnhild Kjørsvik (Head of Omnichannel) – providing them with the actionable insights, segmentation logic, and experimentation rigor needed to optimize relevance and customer lifetime value.



(We’re not looking for a static dashboard generator, but we do value foundational analytical hygiene. You own your data domain end-to-end: from building the pragmatic dashboards and streamlining monthly reporting that keep us grounded, to telling the commercial story behind the numbers.) 

Dig into the "why" behind customer behavior shifts, lifecycle drop-offs, and retention metrics (LTV, churn). You proactively spot anomalies and trends across our customer journeys and bring these insights to light. 
Streamline our recurring monthly lifecycle reporting and create clean, reliable dashboards/data structures that keep the Omnichannel team self-sufficient and aligned on core KPIs.
Independently design and analyze A/B tests and customer segmentations. Ensure statistical rigor and commercial impact while shifting CRM from tactical campaigns to data-driven lifecycle management. 
Drive initiatives proactively. Take full ownership. Spot opportunities, ask the brave questions ("Have we looked into this?"), and run with them.
Balance strategy & speed. Move seamlessly between fast ad-hoc questions and broader strategic projects. Spread data literacy across commercial teams, increasing the organization's appetite for analytics and data-driven decision-making.




Who we think you are


You are a curious commercial storyteller who naturally digs beneath the surface and has the confidence to translate raw data into persuasive business recommendations. You combine a solid technical, analytical foundation with a deep understanding of CRM and customer lifecycle mechanics. 



You are pragmatic, action-driven, and resilient. When you spot anomalous data or hidden patterns in the member base, you react with curiosity—using your analytical skills and proactive mindset to connect the dots and drive clarity. 

Proven experience in CRM Analytics, Lifecycle Analytics, or Customer Data Analytics (around 5+ years of experience). Solid grasp of customer lifetime value, retention strategies, and personalization frameworks
Proficiency in SQL, visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau, or GA4), and hands-on experience working with customer data platforms (CDP) or CRM automation tools (e.g., Braze, Salesforce, HubSpot)
Strong background in experimental design (A/B testing) and segmentation methodologies






Details: 
You will report to Dianne Robillos, as part of her Commercial Insights & Personalization team. Here, you get a solid data community of analyst colleagues to spar with, while acting as the primary bridge to daily commercial execution
Location: Stockholm (Solna) or Oslo (with flexibility through our hybrid office setup).
Working Language: Swedish, Norwegian, or English.






What we can offer you

A flat organization with trust and autonomy in your work. We are rebels that support innovation without imposing strict corporate rules.
The chance to be part of a passionate team with exceptional colleagues and an inclusive culture that believes every stay should be a story worth telling. 
Plenty of social events including smaller gatherings with your team and huge get-togethers with the whole Strawberry family! 
Great benefits! In addition to our collective agreement, we also offer staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 250+ hotels.

A core part of your mission will be to support and empower our Omnichannel team – led by Bjørnhild Kjørsvik (Head of Omnichannel) – providing them with the actionable insights, segmentation logic, and experimentation rigor needed to optimize relevance and customer lifetime value.

(We’re not looking for a static dashboard generator, but we do value foundational analytical hygiene. You own your data domain end-to-end: from building the pragmatic dashboards and streamlining monthly reporting that keep us grounded, to telling the commercial story behind the numbers.) 

  • Dig into the "why" behind customer behavior shifts, lifecycle drop-offs, and retention metrics (LTV, churn). You proactively spot anomalies and trends across our customer journeys and bring these insights to light. 
  • Streamline our recurring monthly lifecycle reporting and create clean, reliable dashboards/data structures that keep the Omnichannel team self-sufficient and aligned on core KPIs.
  • Independently design and analyze A/B tests and customer segmentations. Ensure statistical rigor and commercial impact while shifting CRM from tactical campaigns to data-driven lifecycle management. 
  • Drive initiatives proactively. Take full ownership. Spot opportunities, ask the brave questions ("Have we looked into this?"), and run with them.
  • Balance strategy & speed. Move seamlessly between fast ad-hoc questions and broader strategic projects. Spread data literacy across commercial teams, increasing the organization's appetite for analytics and data-driven decision-making.


Who we think you are

You are a curious commercial storyteller who naturally digs beneath the surface and has the confidence to translate raw data into persuasive business recommendations. You combine a solid technical, analytical foundation with a deep understanding of CRM and customer lifecycle mechanics. 

You are pragmatic, action-driven, and resilient. When you spot anomalous data or hidden patterns in the member base, you react with curiosity—using your analytical skills and proactive mindset to connect the dots and drive clarity. 

  • Proven experience in CRM Analytics, Lifecycle Analytics, or Customer Data Analytics (around 5+ years of experience). Solid grasp of customer lifetime value, retention strategies, and personalization frameworks
  • Proficiency in SQL, visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau, or GA4), and hands-on experience working with customer data platforms (CDP) or CRM automation tools (e.g., Braze, Salesforce, HubSpot)
  • Strong background in experimental design (A/B testing) and segmentation methodologies




Details: 
You will report to Dianne Robillos, as part of her Commercial Insights & Personalization team. Here, you get a solid data community of analyst colleagues to spar with, while acting as the primary bridge to daily commercial execution
Location: Stockholm (Solna) or Oslo (with flexibility through our hybrid office setup).
Working Language: Swedish, Norwegian, or English.


What we can offer you
  • A flat organization with trust and autonomy in your work. We are rebels that support innovation without imposing strict corporate rules.
  • The chance to be part of a passionate team with exceptional colleagues and an inclusive culture that believes every stay should be a story worth telling. 
  • Plenty of social events including smaller gatherings with your team and huge get-togethers with the whole Strawberry family! 
  • Great benefits! In addition to our collective agreement, we also offer staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 250+ hotels.

Title: CUSTOMER SERVICE ANALYST
Description:
Data Analyst, Customer Service

With millions of interactions each year, SAS Customer Service plays a fundamental role in shaping our passenger experience. We are now undertaking a significant transformation - leveraging digitalization, automation, and continuous process innovation to elevate service standards at every stage of the journey. To support us on this journey, we are seeking a Customer Service Data Analyst.

Challenges You Will Work On

In this role, you will work closely with development teams, process experts, business developers, and leaders to ensure that SAS Customer Service has access to clear, structured, and actionable data. Your insights will guide operational decisions, strengthen performance management, and directly support our strategic ambitions.

You will also play a key role in shaping our future data roadmap, helping SAS Customer Service become increasingly insight-driven, predictive, and proactive in how we serve passengers.

Main Responsibilities


Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses in Power BI
Continuously develop and improve our BI setup
Support metric development and performance tracking
Contribute to business case development
Analyze long-term trends and provide actionable recommendations
Lead initiatives to make customer service data accessible and actionable across the organization
Identify opportunities to use automation, AI, and predictive analytics to make Customer Service more proactive, efficient, and insight-driven
Engage and train business users to generate insights from data


To be successful we believe you have


A degree or relevant professional experience in statistics, data science, engineering, finance, or a related field
Strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including building data models and creating actionable reports and dashboards
Proven ability to analyze structured data from multiple sources and communicate insights clearly and effectively
Solid understanding of data modeling principles
Fluency in English
Curiosity and hands-on interest in using AI and automation to improve analytics, reporting, and business decision-making, combined with the ability to critically validate AI-generated insights


Nice-to-haves


Experience working with data from customer service, CRM, contact center, or digital channels
Experience with predictive analytics, forecasting, or anomaly detection
Familiarity with working in agile, cross-functional teams


As a person, we believe you are highly analytical, curious, and comfortable working with complex data sets. You are skilled at transforming data into clear, actionable insights and can communicate your findings in a pedagogical and accessible way, adapting your message to different stakeholders across the organization. You are proactive, self-motivated, and take ownership of your responsibilities. You also have a strong interest in how AI, automation, and new technologies can improve analytics, decision-making, and customer service. Strong collaboration skills are essential for success in this role, as you will work closely with teams across the business to drive continuous improvement and support our transformation journey.

Why SAS?

Benefits

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:


Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and
Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

Additional Information


Deadline for application: 30/08/2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
Desired start date: Asap
Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period
This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite.


If you have questions about this position, you are welcome to contact Andreas Broberg Henning, Head of Digital Customer Service & Analytics at andreas.henning@sas.se . Please note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email due to the GDPR regulations.

Title: Data & BI Specialist for Marketing Domain
Description:
Job Description



ABOUT THE TEAM

You'll join the Marketing Insights & Steering area within the Marketing Domain, where we enable data-driven decision-making across H&M's global marketing organisation. Our team plays a central role in understanding the impact of marketing, ensuring that investments across channels, markets and customer touchpoints are measurable, optimised and aligned with business goals.



We build and evolve the insights, measurement and reporting capabilities that help H&M understand how marketing drives customer behaviour and business results. By connecting data, technology and business needs, we enable smarter decisions and greater impact across the organisation.



Working closely with teams across Marketing, Marketing Tech and AI- Data & Analytics we help make trusted data more accessible and actionable across the business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Data & BI Specialist, you'll play a key role in transforming marketing data into actionable insights that shape decisions across H&M's global marketing organisation. Working at the intersection of business, analytics and technology, you'll help stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities and make more informed decisions.



You will:



Own and manage marketing reporting tools, ensuring they remain reliable, effective and aligned with business needs.
Build, develop and improve data models, dashboards, reports and analytical solutions that support decision-making across Marketing.
Translate business needs into scalable reporting solutions, intuitive visualisations and clear data requirements.
Optimise existing data models and reports to improve performance, usability and business value.
Identify opportunities to automate, streamline and simplify reporting processes to improve efficiency and consistency.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, identify opportunities and turn data into actionable insights.
Collaborate with data engineers, analysts and product teams to improve data quality, accessibility and governance.
Support the development of self-service capabilities that enable teams to access insights and make informed decisions more independently.
Contribute to the continuous development of H&M’s marketing data, reporting and analytics capabilities.

WHO YOU ARE

You are curious, analytical and motivated by solving business problems through data. You enjoy working at the intersection of business and technology and know how to translate complex information into clear insights that drive action.



You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy partnering with stakeholders across different functions. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking questions and continuously looking for better ways to use data to create business value.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR PEOPLE WITH



A degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or another quantitative field.
Experience within analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics or a related field.
Strong SQL skills and experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar visualisation tools.
Experience working with large datasets from multiple data sources.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH



Marketing and customer data.
Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery or Databricks.
Experience driving automation of analytical processes, reporting tools, and data models.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING



This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of marketing, analytics and business strategy. You'll help shape how H&M measures marketing performance globally and contribute to better decisions across media, customer engagement, brand building and commercial growth.You'll work with large-scale datasets, modern analytics platforms and stakeholders across one of the world's largest retail organisations, helping transform data into meaningful business impact.





Additional Information



This is a permanent full-time position based in Stockholm.



As collaboration and teamwork are important to us, we expect an in-office presence of four days per week.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE



At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer:



Global career and development opportunities
A value‑driven culture where you are encouraged to be yourself
Staff discount cards and benefits
Wellness and wellbeing benefits
Parental support
Opportunities to experiment, grow, and create tangible impact in a large‑scale tech organization.

Here, you are encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and grow — and as you flourish, so do we.



If you believe you can contribute to this role and want to join our team, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English.



We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter to your application.

Title: Data Scientist till Savings Performance
Description:
Har du en passion för att omvandla data till insikter som påverkar riktiga affärsbeslut? Vill du arbeta nära affären och bidra till att utveckla våra sparaprodukter och kundupplevelser genom datadriven analys?

Vi söker nu en Data Scientist till vårt Savings Performance-team inom Investment Center. Här får du en central roll i att analysera och utveckla Sparaaffären genom att kombinera datamodellering, analys och tydlig kommunikation av insikter.

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:


Arbeta end-to-end med data – från behovsidentifiering och datainsamling till modellering, analys och visualisering.
Analysera och följa upp Sparaaffären ur ett produkt-, kund- och organisationsperspektiv.
Identifiera mönster i data och omsätta dessa till konkreta, affärsnära rekommendationer.
Ta fram beslutsunderlag och presentera insikter till management och andra seniora stakeholders.
Bidra till och vidareutveckla datamodeller som möjliggör bättre uppföljning och styrning av affären.
Utveckla och vidareutveckla dashboards och applikationer i Power BI och Qlik som stödjer analys och beslutsfattande.
Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med olika team för att driva datadrivna initiativ.



I denna roll behöver du:

Grundläggande krav:


2–4 års erfarenhet av att arbeta som Data Scientist, analytiker eller liknande, med fokus på att ta fram insikter från data.
Stark erfarenhet av SQL och att arbeta med större datamängder.
Erfarenhet av Python eller motsvarande verktyg för dataanalys.
Erfarenhet av datamodellering och visualisering i BI-verktyg (t.ex. Power BI eller Qlik).
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med hela analysprocessen – från data till insikt och presentation.
God förmåga att kommunicera komplexa samband på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt.
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
Bosatt i Sverige, med placering i Stockholm med omnejd.
Relevant akademisk utbildning (t.ex. statistik, ekonomi, datavetenskap eller matematik.



Meriterande kvalifikationer:


Erfarenhet från arbete inom bank eller finansiella tjänster.
Kunskap om sparande, pension eller försäkring.
Förmåga att dela kunskap och bidra till teamets kompetensutveckling.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta affärsnära och omsätta analys till konkreta rekommendationer.



Hos oss kan du uppleva:


Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.
Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.
En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.
En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.
Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.



"Bli en del av vårt team och...

Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt dynamiska och ambitiösa analysteam. Tillsammans hjälper vi Swedbank att bli mer datadrivna och stärker vår position inom Sparaområdet.'' Elias Jakobson, din framtida chef.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-08-31.

Placeringsort: Sundbyberg

Rekryterande chef: Elias Jakobson

Vänligen observera att rekryteringsarbetet kan ta lite längre tid än normalt då det är sommarsemester.

Vi vill göra dig uppmärksam på att bakgrundskontroll och drogtest kan komma att genomföras för denna roll om du går vidare i processen.

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller säljare av andra rekryteringstjänster.

Swedbank är en inkluderande arbetsgivare och diskriminerar ingen utifrån kön, ålder, sexuell läggning eller sexuell identitet, etnicitet, religion eller funktionsnedsättning - alla är välkomna.

Title: Consumer Analyst
Description:
Are you passionate about building true consumer preference—turning data and insights into real user and business impact?

At Instabee, we are on a mission to become the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. We are now looking for a Consumer Analyst to join our Consumer Department. In this role, you will play a fundamental part in building the analytical foundation and insights required to ensure our organization is aligned, informed, and accountable for delivering a superior consumer experience across all markets.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.

About The Role

As Consumer Analyst, you will translate complex data and consumer signals into clear, actionable insights that can drive strategic and tactical impact. Partnering with teams across Data & Analytics, Product, Design, Operations, Strategy and Market to understand challenges, synthesize insights from diverse sources, and co-create solutions grounded in consumer and business relevance.

Your goal is to build a solid foundation for consumer, brand, and experience analytics, making insights accessible and actionable company-wide. Whether you are mapping the behavior of different consumer segments, uncovering what drives long-term retention, or tracking the impact of a new product feature, you will play a key role in guiding our journey toward becoming the undisputed #1 service in all our markets.

What You'll Do


Manage the Consumer Scorecard: Define and evolve our core KPIs (NPS, User ratings, Brand preference, CSAT, MAU, Consumer base metrics, Operational metrics etc.) to ensure a trusted, single source of truth for our performance across the full consumer journey and lifecycle.
Analyze Loyalty & Retention: Conduct cohort and retention analysis to identify the key drivers of consumer satisfaction and long-term loyalty. You’ll explore how different user segments behave and evolve, and translate user and service delivery insights into cross-functional guidance for the most effective ways to win, delight, and retain our consumers.
Analyze Consumer Behavior: Dive deep into user behavior across web, app, communications and customer service channels. You will analyze funnels and identify drop-off points to provide concrete product and experience recommendations. This includes proactively identifying tracking gaps and defining what needs to be measured and how, to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable data.
Translate Data into Action: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, actionable insights. You will provide a holistic lens to ensure we deliver a seamless and superior experience across the entire consumer journey.
Co-create Analytical Foundations: Partner with data and tech teams to ensure our data collection is high-quality, scalable, and reliable. You’ll help shape the tracking and data structures (e.g., GA4, BigQuery) required to turn digital behavior into trustworthy insights.
Drive Performance Insights: Enable data-driven decision-making through forecasting, trend analysis, and the development of automated dashboards in Tableau, Steep or similar tools.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the consumer analytics partner for teams across Instabee, helping them move past the "what" to understand the "why" behind consumer behavior.
Drive Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests—taking ownership from the initial hypothesis to the final conclusion and recommended next steps.


Your profile

You are an analytical problem-solver with a natural drive to uncover patterns and understand exactly what drives consumer behavior and business performance. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by creating real-world results rather than theoretical perfection. You don't just provide data; you see it as your mission to provide the actionable insights that enable our teams to deliver a great consumer experience and our business to grow.

Experience & Mindset


Analytical Experience: 4-5+ years of experience in consumer analytics, digital analytics or a related field - ideally within a fast-paced service or e-commerce environment.
Commercial Curiosity: You have a strong business acumen and a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers. You focus on what is relevant and actionable for the business, and proactively surface insights and opportunities.
Problem Solver: Strong analytical and numerical skills with a business-oriented mindset. You excel at bringing structure to ambiguous problems and can navigate complex datasets to find the most impactful answers.
Communication: You can translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable narratives for diverse stakeholders. You communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership.
Collaboration: Team player who enjoys working across Product, Tech, and Business teams to develop insights and build solutions together.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, IT, Statistics, Business, or other relevant field.


Analytical toolkit


Consumer Analytics: Proven ability to synthesize various internal and external consumer data into holistic consumer analytics and insights.
Digital Analytics: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, GA4, or similar behavioral tracking platforms.
Data Foundations: Proficiency in SQL and Python or similar, and experience working with large datasets.
Visualization: Ability to build and maintain clear dashboards and funnels that give our teams an ongoing view of consumer health (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Steep).
AI coding tools: Experience in using AI tools in your analytical work is an advantage.
Experimentation: Hands-on experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests is an advantage.
Tracking: Knowledge of digital tracking implementation and Google Tag Manager is an advantage.


What You'll Get

We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!

Benefits

Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:


Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


Get to know us

In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.

We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.

This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Through strategic acquisitions and fast organic growth, Sinch has turned into an international powerhouse serving enterprises across the globe and handling over 700 billion engagements per year. In fact, independent analysts say we're a CPaaS leader!

ABOUT SINCH
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses - including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others - rely on Sinch's Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email. Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey. At Sinch we "Dream Big", "Win Together", "Keep it simple", and "Make it Happen". These values are our foundation!

DESCRIPTION
At Sinch, our focus is on driving growth through data-driven commercial strategies. As a Data Analyst specializing in CRM reporting and analytics within our Data Analytics department, you will play an essential role in guiding our sales and marketing strategies and building operational efficiency. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Finance leaders to translate Salesforce and related CRM data into high-quality, actionable insights across the entire sales funnel. In this role, you will work closely with multifunctional teams and be part of a modern analytics setup using advanced tools like Snowflake, dbt, and Tableau.

Please note: This is a one-year fixed-term contract, covering colleagues on parental leave. The role is designed to ensure continuity in analytics delivery and stakeholder support during this period.

Key Responsibilities
CRM Reporting & Dashboarding: Design, build, and maintain robust dashboards and reports in Tableau and Salesforce to track KPIs related to sales pipeline, customer lifecycle, and sales team performance.
Sales Funnel Analysis: Analyze the entire sales and marketing funnel, identifying trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimization.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Finance leaders to deliver actionable insights that support strategic and tactical decisions.
Data Integrity & Governance: Act as a subject matter expert on CRM data, ensuring data quality and accuracy within Salesforce and related reporting environments.
Empower Sales Teams: Create and manage user-friendly dashboards that provide self-service analytics, enabling sales representatives and managers to monitor performance effectively.
Analytics Support & Culture: Act as a key point of contact for internal analytics users by managing support requests, investigating issues, and helping spread a strong data-driven culture by training and supporting stakeholders.
REQUIREMENTS
CRM & Visualization Tools: Proven experience working directly with Salesforce (or similar CRM), including report building and data models, plus at least 2 years of experience creating dashboards in Tableau.
Technical & Analytical Skills: At least 2 years of experience working with SQL (or a comparable track record in analyzing large structured and unstructured datasets) is a big plus.
Education & Professional Experience: A bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative or business-related field (e.g., finance, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering) is desirable, along with experience collaborating with commercial stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Finance).
Communication & Language: Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is required, with strong skills in expressing ideas and complex data insights clearly to diverse audiences.
Industry & Global Context: Experience working in a global company and/or within a Tech, SaaS, or B2B Telecom setting is highly preferred.
Professional Qualities: A growth-oriented, detail-oriented, and highly adaptable mindset, with strong emotional intelligence and collaboration skills to build effective working relationships.

Salary:

The monthly salary for this position is between 35,266 SEK - 44083 SEK. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.

OUR HIRING PROCESS
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.

Om tjänsten

Fortnox behöver förstå hur våra produkter skapar värde, och det börjar med data som går att lita på. Produktanalysteamet bygger den grunden, och vi söker en Analytics Engineer som äger den. Det du modellerar i dbt idag blir kontextlagret som AI-agenter konsumerar imorgon.

Vi söker en person som trivs i en teknisk roll och vill bygga datafundamentet för att:


Bygga datamodeller i dbt och BigQuery. Basmodeller som hela organisationen konsumerar. Tydliga namn, dokumentation och tester.
Få in och modellera event-data. Du tar Kafka backend-events och Piwik frontend-events hela vägen in i BQ/dbt och bygger affärslogiken ovanpå: aktivering, inloggning och hur kunder rör sig genom produkterna.
Äga produktdomänen i dataplattformen. Du ansvarar för struktur, standards och kvalitet för allt som rör produkt, så att andra team kan lita på modellerna.
Göra datan användbar för både människor och AI. Vi bygger en AI-driven pipeline för mätning. Du säkrar att modeller och events är dokumenterade så att relevanta stakeholders förstår dem, och så att en AI-agent svarar rätt på frågor om dem.
Hjälpa team hjälpa sig själva. Du bygger verktygen och kontexten som låter produktteam lägga till mätning och hämta data på egen hand.



Om dig

Du har erfarenhet av att bygga dbt-modeller i produktion, med SQL som primärt verktyg. Det som gör dig intressant för oss är att du vet skillnaden mellan en modell som råkar vara korrekt och en som faktiskt är användbar, för en analytiker, en produktägare eller en AI-agent.

Du har jobbat med event-data och vet hur stökig den kan vara: många events som triggas olika, och sällan dokumentation som reder ut det. Du förstår affären bakom datan och frågar "vilken affärsfråga besvarar den här modellen?" innan du bygger den.

Du kan förklara vad du byggt för någon som inte jobbar med data varje dag, och säga nej när det behövs.

Du bryr dig om kvalitet och reagerar när namngivning är inkonsekvent, dokumentation saknas eller en definition inte hänger ihop.

Du kommunicerar flytande i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.

Vi ser det även som positivt om du har: erfarenhet av BigQuery/GCP. Nyfikenhet på att bygga BI-as-code, istället för att klicka i ett BI-verktyg. Vi tittar på verktyg i den riktningen, som Lightdash eller Evidence, och på rapportering direkt via Claude. Vana att jobba med AI-verktyg på riktigt: bryta ner uppgifter, ge kontext, validera resultat. Lust att läsa i kodbasen för att förstå var events triggas och var datan kommer ifrån.

Vi jobbar med dbt, BigQuery, Piwik Pro och AI-verktyg för kodning och analys.

Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet

Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.

Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.

Behandling av personuppgifter

Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.

Om tjänsten

Fortnox behöver förstå hur våra produkter skapar värde, och det börjar med data som går att lita på. Produktanalysteamet bygger den grunden, och vi söker en Analytics Engineer som äger den. Det du modellerar i dbt idag blir kontextlagret som AI-agenter konsumerar imorgon.

Title: Advanced Data Analysis Engineer
Description:
Job Description

Coherent Corp is the global leader in photonics, designing and manufacturing advanced laser, optical, and materials technologies. Our innovations power semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure, advanced communications, and precision industrial systems worldwide. With a global footprint and cutting-edge manufacturing and R&D, we’re shaping the future of high-tech industries.

In Sweden, our teams operate Sweden’s only full-scale indium phosphide wafer fabrication facility, where we design, manufacture, and test some of the world’s fastest optical chips under one roof, supporting AI infrastructure, data centres, and global communications networks worldwide.

The Role

We are seeking a Data Analysis Engineer to join our Product Verification Group in Järfälla. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing complex device characterization data to support product development, process optimisation and technical decision-making across our advanced optoelectronic technologies.

You Will Be Responsible For


Analysing device characterization data across multiple design, process and operating factors to support design optimisation and process understanding.
Performing statistical analysis of device performance, including the impact of process variation, measurement uncertainty and test noise.
Identifying trends and relationships within complex datasets and providing clear, actionable insights to engineering and design teams.
Developing and improving automated data processing and analysis workflows to enhance efficiency and scalability.
Presenting technical findings through graphical visualisations, reports and technical documentation to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including Chip Design, Wafer Fabrication Process Engineering, Operations, Quality & Reliability and Project Management.


About You

You are an analytical and curious problem solver who enjoys working with complex datasets and transforming information into meaningful insights. You are comfortable working across technical disciplines and communicating findings to a range of stakeholders.

You Will Also Have


A Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related technical discipline.
Experience in data analysis, statistics, engineering data processing or a related field.
Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, data processing, automation and database technologies.
Experience analysing complex datasets and applying appropriate statistical and analytical methods.
An understanding of measurement variation, test uncertainty and noise analysis.
Experience with programming, scripting, databases or engineering analysis tools.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate assumptions, limitations and conclusions.
A structured approach to problem-solving, a strong sense of ownership and a continuous learning mindset.
Fluent English language skills; Swedish is considered a strong advantage.


We Offer


A dynamic and international working environment.
An appreciative and collaborative company culture.
Unique technical challenges supporting the products of tomorrow.
Competitive benefits and social programmes.


Ensure adherence to company's values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position:

🤝 Integrity – Create an Environment of Trust

✨ Collaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas

🎯 Accountability – Own the Process and the Outcome

🌍 Respect – Recognize the Value in Everyone

🚀 Enthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work

Application & Selection

Current employees who wish to apply should submit a cover letter detailing their interest in the position and how their skills and experience align with the requirements of the role.

At Coherent, recruitment is conducted on an ongoing basis. Candidates progressing to the final stage of the process will be required to complete alcohol and drug testing, background checks and reference checks as part of our standard recruitment procedures prior to employment.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the application process, please reach out to kris.cairns@coherent.com. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.

About Us

Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!

Note to recruiters and employment agencies: We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

Title: Data Analyst (Early Careers)
Description:
About the Role:

This entry-level role is your chance to turn raw data into critical insights that guide decision-making across our entire organisation. You'll collaborate directly with Sales, Product Owners, and Senior Management and others, gaining exposure to a wide range of business functions.

We are looking for a motivated, collaborative, kind, and humble individual to join our team. You'll get hands-on with our modern data stack—think GCP, BigQuery, DBT, and Airflow—to build robust data solutions. This is more than just running queries; you'll help teams define their data needs and build the data models and Looker dashboards that answer their most pressing questions.

For a recent graduate, this is a unique opportunity to apply your knowledge, master in-demand technologies, and see your work make a tangible impact. We foster a collaborative environment where you'll be encouraged to learn, communicate effectively, and leverage our AI-assisted development workflow to enhance analysis and build solutions more efficiently.




Responsibilities and impact:

OSTTRA has the largest financial institutions in the world as clients. We believe that long-term value to the client is the most important goal of our team, and technology is the tool to bring that value, and your contribution in the form of delivery, improvements and innovations can have a significant impact on the financial system.

Data Analysis and Interpretation:

Analyse and interpret complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their challenges and translate them into data requirements.

Report and Dashboard Development:

Design, build, and maintain interactive and user-friendly dashboards and reports in Looker.
Iterate on and enhance existing reports based on user feedback and evolving business needs.

Data Modelling & Transformation:

Use DBT to transform, model, and test data within our data warehouse, preparing it for analysis.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of our Airflow managed data pipelines to ensure data is accurate, timely, and reliable.
Work with data engineers to improve data quality, consistency, and ingestion processes.

Collaboration and Communication:

Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, present findings, and provide data-driven recommendations.
Clearly communicate complex insights and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Continuous Learning:

Stay curious and up-to-date with the latest trends in our tech stack (GCP, BigQuery, DBT, Looker) and the broader data analytics field.
Proactively seek opportunities for skill development and training, including leveraging our internal AI-assisted tools.




What's in it for you:

We strongly believe in individual growth and have long experience in guiding early careers engineers in our modern approach to software production, which includes:

Rapid, iterative and phased delivery, backed by automated testing and deployment frameworks.
Streamlined, autonomous and independent teams, optimised and supported for fast change.
Clean architecture for maintainable, scalable, and flexible code, aligned with the team structures and with clear boundaries and responsibilities.
Innovative culture with strong focus on exploration and prototyping, where failing fast is a virtue which drives technological and product improvements.




What we’re looking for:

Fundamental requirement:

Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
A genuine eagerness to learn, grow, and take on new challenges in the data field.




Additional preferred requirements:

Internship or academic project experience related to data analytics or business intelligence.
Familiarity with SQL, data modelling and data warehousing concepts.
Basic programming skills (e.g., Python).
Experience with a BI tool (like Looker, Power BI, etc.) from projects or internships.
Exposure to version control (e.g., Git) and cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure).




To be considered for this position, please upload both your resume and your official/unofficial academic credentials/transcripts (betyg). Applications missing these documents will not be processed.




The location: Stockholm, Sweden




Right to work requirements:

This role is limited to persons with right to work in Sweden.




Our Benefits: Global vision, local impact

At OSTTRA, our benefits philosophy offers a market-competitive package that reflects our position as an industry leader. We want to ensure you feel valued, secure, and empowered wherever you are in the world.

Our approach is built on three core pillars:

Global foundations: We provide a baseline of excellence across all our offices, focusing on comprehensive Health & Wellness, Financial Security, and Work-Life Balance. No matter your location, you are part of a culture that prioritizes your holistic well-being.
Locally tailored: We benchmark in each market to ensure our packages are genuinely competitive where you live and work.
Flexibility and growth: We empower you to work in a way that suits your life. This includes a hybrid working model, generous leave policies, and a commitment to your continuous professional development.




The Trust employee ownership plan

Every employee at OSTTRA is an owner, and a member of The Trust, our employee ownership programme. Our distinct culture encourages colleagues to think and act like owners and raise the bar constantly.

This plan reflects our belief that when we work together to build a stronger, more valuable organisation, then all colleagues should benefit from the value we create.




About OSTTRA

We build and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on. Launched in 2021, we have unified more than 20 years of heritage and expertise from four industry leaders into a single, integrated business.

Today,we operate a trusted network that connects thousands of market participants to streamline end-to-end workflows, from trade capture through portfolio optimisation.We translate industry change into workable process, engineering an open, intelligent ecosystem that removes friction and reduces risk for the global markets.




Our distinct ownership culture is underpinned by four behaviours: boldness, curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. In 2025 we were acquired by KKR, one of the world’s most successful private equity firms, and are on a journey of growth and impact.

Joining our team now is a unique opportunity - you will help to shape the next generation of post-trade, transform shared infrastructure into shared benefit, and accelerate your own career. Learn more at www.osttra.com.




Equal opportunity employer statement at OSTTRA:

We are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all colleagues have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasise fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain the best talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on.

Title: Customer Insights Analyst
Description:
Evidensia är norra Europas ledande veterinärkedja. Bakom varje besök finns mängder med operativ data, och vi letar nu efter dig som vill förvandla den till insikter som gör verklig skillnad i både vår och djurägarnas vardag.

Som BI Developer blir du en del av vårt etablerade Data & Analytics-team. Du arbetar nära verksamheten, både via centrala ledningsgrupper och lokala kliniker, och levererar insikter som driver beslutsfattandet. En del av ditt och teamets uppdrag är att ansvara för vår tekniska CRM-lösning (Customer Relationship Management). Här bidrar vi bland annat med segmentering, personliga kundresor och automatiseringar. Det ger dig möjlighet att vara med genom hela kedjan och att direkt se och testa resultatet av ditt arbete.

Vad du kommer att göra


Utveckla och förvalta Power BI-rapporter genom hela kedjan från datamodellering till visualisering
Arbeta med SQL för segmentering, datamodellering och ad hoc-analyser
Designa och underhålla segmenteringslogik, automatiseringsregler och dataflöden i vårt CRM-system, som till stor del är SQL-baserat
Proaktivt utforska data för att hitta nya förbättrings- och tillväxtmöjligheter


Vem vi söker

Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och affärsorienterad BI-utvecklare som trivs i gränslandet mellan teknik och verksamhet. Du gillar bredden i att äga en fråga hela vägen från datamodell till effekt, och har lätt för att förklara data på ett praktiskt och begripligt sätt, även för den som inte är teknisk. Att dessutom få arbeta hands-on i vårt CRM-verktyg ser du som en spännande möjlighet att omsätta dina insikter i praktisk verklighet.

Vi söker dig som har:


Eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område
2–5 års erfarenhet inom analys, BI, CRM eller liknande datadriven roll
Gedigen erfarenhet av Power BI
Goda kunskaper i SQL
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift – observera att detta är ett absolut krav för tjänsten


Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du en roll där ditt arbete syns direkt i verksamheten och påverkar hur kliniker möter sina kunder och patienter varje dag. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och etablerat data- och analysteam med hög kompetens, korta beslutsvägar och en kultur där nyfikenhet och eget ansvar uppskattas. Vi arbetar främst med Microsoft Azure, Power BI och övriga lösningar i Microsofts ekosystem.

Tjänsten är placerad på vårt supportkontor i Stockholm med hybridarbetsmodell.
