Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!




Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities




We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.




The role:

As a Senior Data analyst, you’ll be responsible for the team's quantitative insights. From understanding our data, identifying problems, to working with product, tech, and design on hypothesizing solutions. You’ll be the driver of our experimentation and learning efforts and will collaborate with different teams.




What you will do

Understanding Truecaller's data.
Taking ownership of quantitative insights for your team, playing a crucial role in product development.
Defining experiments, overseeing their setup, and analyzing their results to drive decision-making.
Developing and maintaining key performance indicators (KPIs) for the team, ensuring their tracking, reliability, and reporting.
Creating data pipelines and dashboards to measure the team's KPIs and effectively communicate insights to both the team and leadership.
Coaching and mentoring the team on experimentation and data-driven product development processes, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making.




What you bring in

4+ years of experience in Data Analytics
Experience in using SQL to extract, transform, and analyse data
Experience in data visualisation tools like Looker (preferred), QlikSense, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience in mentoring, coaching, and evangelizing about data in product development
Experience in digging into different data sources to understand why specific customer behaviours happen
Fluent in spoken and written English




It would be great if you also have

Big data query tools (we use BigQuery).
Experience with data from mobile applications.




What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:




A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.




Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.




Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/




Sounds like a great opportunity?




We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.




We only accept applications in English.

Title: Dataanalytiker registerkontroll
Description:
Vill du bidra till att rätt personer är en del av det mest skyddsvärda i Sverige? Som dataanalytiker i gruppen för registerkontroll bidrar du till att säkerställa lämpligt deltagande och minska risken för insiders i säkerhetskänsliga verksamheter. Välkommen med din ansökan.




Tillsammans skyddar vi Sverige.




Ort: Stockholm

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-08-23




Det här är ditt uppdrag

Vid Säkerhetspolisen är arbete med data och analys centralt. Nu söker vi dig som vill jobba med att utöka myndighetens förmåga inom dataintag och dataanalys.




I rollen arbetar du aktivt med data och dataanalys i olika faser och skapar värde för vår verksamhet. Du kommer arbeta tvärfunktionellt med analys och bedömning av data. Inhämtning av nya datakällor, samt aktivt bidra i arbetet med datakvalitet och datadefinitioner. I rollen ingår utveckling och införande av processer för t.ex. datakvalitet, och bedömning av analyserade datamängder. Arbetet kräver ett nära samarbete med andra områden inom myndigheten samt frekvent samverkan med andra myndigheter.




I rollen som dataanalytiker på registerkontrollen kommer du att bidra till att relevant information beaktas i registerkontrollprocessen, detta innebär bland annat arbete mot flertalet olika register. Du kommer att bidra till att utveckla verksamheten utifrån ett mer digitaliserat flöde. Du kommer även att ges möjlighet att bidra till planering av gruppens verksamhet samt medverka till att utveckla arbetsmetoder. Rollen innebär bred samverkan, samt kan komma att innefatta genomförande eller bidragande till utbildningsinsatser, både internt och externt. Vi ser gärna att du har kompetens som kan bidra till att utveckla vår informationshantering och det interna it-stödet i registerkontrollen.




Förändringar i reglering tillsammans med ett osäkert omvärldsläge gör att registerkontrollen kommer att få en allt större påverkan av skyddet för det mest skyddsvärda i Sverige. Du kommer bland annat vara en del av den säkerhetsprövning som verksamhetsutövare genomför innan deras personal deltar i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet.




Din placering är på huvudkontoret i Solna och arbetet utförs på plats, vilket innebär att du inte har möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Resor inom Sverige kan förekomma.




De här kvalifikationerna söker vi hos dig

Det är endast du som uppfyller nedanstående krav som kan bli aktuell för tjänsten.




Krav:

För tjänsten relevant eftergymnasial utbildning
Flerårig erfarenhet av kvalificerat analysarbete med fokus på större datamängder
Erfarenhet av att framställa underlag för beslut
Erfarenhet av process- och metodutveckling
Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i såväl tal som skrift
God förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i såväl tal som skrift




Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap.




Du som söker kan också ha kompetens som tillför bredd och kompletterande perspektiv. Kan du bidra med något eller flera av följande är det meriterande:

Relevant akademisk examen inom t.ex. dataanalys, informatik, statistik, systemvetenskap
Erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet, dataskydd/integritetsskydd eller juridik
Erfarenhet av att arbeta inom en organisation med höga säkerhetskrav
Kunskap och erfarenhet inom säkerhetsskydd eller samhällsviktig verksamhet
Erfarenhet av statlig förvaltning
Erfarenhet av arbete med säkerhetsprövning
Erfarenhet av projektledning eller förändringsledning




Det här är kollegan vi söker

I rollen som dataanalytiker krävs det att du är mål- och resultatinriktad och levererar utifrån gruppens uppdrag. Du är utvecklingsorienterad, strukturerad och har god analytisk förmåga. Du har en positiv och prestigelös inställning till samarbeten och uppdrag, och du bygger nätverk genom att skapa och upprätthålla förtroliga och professionella kontakter.




I rollen kommer du växla mellan längre och kortare uppdrag och det krävs därför att du har god förmåga att snabbt kunna sätta dig in i olika frågor. Du har förmågan att sammanfatta information för att identifiera det mest relevanta.




Säkerhetspolisen ställer höga krav på säkerhet och sekretess, därför förutsätter vi att du har ett högt säkerhetsmedvetande.




Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.




Anställningsvillkor och förmåner

Anställning vid Säkerhetspolisen innebär inplacering i säkerhetsklass som kräver svenskt medborgarskap. För anställning krävs också godkänt resultat i säkerhetsprövningen med registerkontroll, som genomförs i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.




Det här är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras.




På vår hemsida, www.sakerhetspolisen.se, kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss samt om våra förmåner.







Så tar du kontakt med oss

För information om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta HR, tfn 070-860 78 25 eller 010-568 70 06.

Tillsammans skyddar vi Sverige.


Ort: Stockholm

Det här är ditt uppdrag

Vid Säkerhetspolisen är arbete med data och analys centralt. Nu söker vi dig som vill jobba med att utöka myndighetens förmåga inom dataintag och dataanalys.


I rollen arbetar du aktivt med data och dataanalys i olika faser och skapar värde för vår verksamhet. Du kommer arbeta tvärfunktionellt med analys och bedömning av data. Inhämtning av nya datakällor, samt aktivt bidra i arbetet med datakvalitet och datadefinitioner. I rollen ingår utveckling och införande av processer för t.ex. datakvalitet, och bedömning av analyserade datamängder. Arbetet kräver ett nära samarbete med andra områden inom myndigheten samt frekvent samverkan med andra myndigheter.


I rollen som dataanalytiker på registerkontrollen kommer du att bidra till att relevant information beaktas i registerkontrollprocessen, detta innebär bland annat arbete mot flertalet olika register. Du kommer att bidra till att utveckla verksamheten utifrån ett mer digitaliserat flöde. Rollen innebär bred samverkan, samt kan komma att innefatta genomförande eller bidragande till utbildningsinsatser, både internt och externt. Du kommer bland annat vara en del av den säkerhetsprövning som verksamhetsutövare genomför innan deras personal deltar i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet.


Din placering är på huvudkontoret i Solna och arbetet utförs på plats, vilket innebär att du inte har möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Resor inom Sverige kan förekomma.

Du har en positiv och prestigelös inställning till samarbeten och uppdrag, och du bygger nätverk genom att skapa och upprätthålla förtroliga och professionella kontakter.


I rollen kommer du växla mellan längre och kortare uppdrag och det krävs därför att du har god förmåga att snabbt kunna sätta dig in i olika frågor. Du har förmågan att sammanfatta information för att identifiera det mest relevanta.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Till Trygg-Hansa Företagsmarknad söker vi nu en Senior Data Analyst som vill vara med och ta organisationens BI- och analysfunktion till nästa nivå.

Om jobbet | Ta data till insikter som gör skillnad för affären

Som Senior Data Analyst får du en nyckelroll i att driva utvecklingen av BI, analys och datadrivet beslutsfattande inom Företagsmarknad. Du utvecklar moderna rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI och gör data tillgänglig på ett sätt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Du arbetar nära beslutsfattare och specialister i verksamheten och omvandlar komplexa affärsfrågeställningar till värdeskapande rapporter, dashboards och dataleveranser som används i det dagliga beslutsfattandet.

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team av analytiker och data scientists som delar kunskap, utmanar varandra konstruktivt och samarbetar tvärfunktionellt med många delar av organisationen. Teamet har ett övergripande ansvar för Företagsmarknads rapportering och analys. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar rapporter och dashboards end-to-end, exempelvis inom försäljning och portföljutveckling. Teamet supporterar också organisationen med data och analys.

Exempel På Ansvarsområden


Identifiera möjligheter att öka användningen av data och BI i verksamheten samt driva förbättringsinitiativ
Omsätta affärsbehov till skalbara analysprodukter, KPI:er och dashboards
Utveckla och vidareutveckla rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI end-to-end
Bygga och förbättra dataflöden samt ETL-processer med moderna tekniker och verktyg
Säkerställa hög användarvänlighet och rätt design i våra rapporter och dashboards
Utveckla ett nära samarbete med stakeholders för att förstå organisationens behov
Ta ägarskap och aktivt bidra i planering av både kort- och långsiktig utveckling
Agera rådgivare till verksamheten i frågor kopplade till analys, rapportering och datadrivet beslutsfattande
Planera och genomföra demo av nya rapporter


Placeringsort är Stockholm och du rapporterar till Chef för Data, Analys & Rapportering.

Om dig | Senior analytiker som skapar insikter och förändring

Det här är en roll för dig som har gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av analys och BI, trivs med stort eget ansvar och vill utveckla lösningar som påverkar både affären, kundvärdet och hur organisationen arbetar med data.

För att kvalificera dig för rollen har du:


Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis Statistik, Matematik, Datavetenskap, Industriell ekonomi eller annat närliggande område
Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet inom dataanalys/BI i affärsnära roll
Mycket goda kunskaper i Power BI, från datamodellering till dashboard-design
Mycket goda kunskaper i statistisk analys och metoder
Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av Python, dbt, samt Azure, Databricks eller andra moderna data- och analysplattformar är meriterande
Erfarenhet av att omvandla affärsbehov till datadrivna lösningar som skapar konkret affärsnytta
Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift


Vi söker dig som har hög kapacitet, stark analytisk förmåga och vilja att bidra till ett team där ansvar, lärande och gemensam utveckling är viktiga delar av vardagen.

För att lyckas i rollen kombinerar du stark analytisk och teknisk kompetens med ett stort intresse för kund- och affärsnära frågor. Du uppskattar att själv arbeta hands-on med data, analys och visualisering samtidigt som du kan lyfta blicken, förstå verksamhetens behov och bidra till att sätta riktning och prioriteringar.

Om oss | Skapa värde med data i stark gemenskap

Trygg-Hansa är en av Sveriges mest välkända försäkringsaktörer och en del av Tryg-koncernen, en av Nordens största försäkringsgrupper. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där data, analys och kundinsikter spelar en allt viktigare roll för hur vi utvecklar affären och skapar värde för våra kunder. Vår kultur bygger på tillit, ansvarstagande och att skapa utveckling tillsammans, och vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när olika kompetenser och perspektiv får bidra – vi vet att olika erfarenheter och arbetssätt stärker vår förmåga att fatta bättre beslut. Därför arbetar vi aktivt för en inkluderande kultur där fler kan komma till sin rätt och göra ett hållbart och meningsfullt arbete.

Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss, möta några av dina framtida kollegor och ta del av mer information om våra medarbetarförmåner.

Ansökan | Vi ser fram emot att höra av dig

Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan. Då urvalet sker löpande ser vi gärna att du inkommer med din ansökan snarast möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-23.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Frank Svensson på via mail: frank.svensson@trygghansa.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Slutkandidaten kommer att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll.

Vi undanber oss kontakt från rekryteringsföretag angående våra annonserade roller.

Fackliga representanter

Akademikerföreningen: Cecilia Jarlstedt, cecilia.jarlstedt@trygghansa.se

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
Are you ready to be a key contributor within the Data & Analytics Engineering department at NOBA Bank Group? Your focus will be on advancing analytics capabilities, optimizing data workflows, driving innovation in the cloud, and unlocking the full potential of the organization’s most valuable asset – data.

About The Role

The Data & Analytics Engineering department comprises specialized teams focused on Data Infrastructure Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Management.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you'll play a central role in building and optimizing the organization's supporting analytics layer, collaborating across the bank. This role offers broad opportunities to grow and make a tangible impact!

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team-building, and enjoying fikas and after-work gatherings together!

Main Tasks


Design and implement efficient data models, focusing on analytics workflows and end-user usability.
Build robust and scalable data pipelines to support business intelligence and analytics needs.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, such as Risk, Finance, and IT, to ensure data solutions align with business needs.
Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the analytics lifecycle.
Drive technical improvements, introducing modern tools and processes to enhance analytics capabilities.
Partner with other engineers to align transformation processes for analytics purposes.


We Are Looking For Someone Who

Enjoys working with data & analytics engineering, modern data practices, and creating insights that drive decisions. We believe you are a detail-oriented and proactive person who thrives in a high pace enviroment and enjoy learning new technologies. You approach challenges with a “can-do” attitude and excel in analytical thinking and problem-solving.

For This Role You’ll Need


Work experience in a similar role within data engineering or analytics engineering
An academic degree related to analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar fields.
Proficiency in ETL processes, designing analytics-ready datasets, and ensuring clean and usable data for stakeholders.
Proficiency in Databricks, dbt (SQL), python and related reporting tools and languages.
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.
Fluency in English is required, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian.


It’s a Plus If You Have


Experience with Microsoft’s data stack (Azure, SQL, and other cloud services).
Experience working with on-prem solutions.
A background in data roles within the financial sector.
Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.


Our Offer To You


Freedom with Responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style.
Career Development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role.
Feedback Culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication.
Coaching Leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey.
A Caring Company Culture: We genuinely care about each other!


In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

Have you heard of NOBAVERSE?

In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly! ✨

Are you ready to be a key contributor within the Data & Analytics Engineering department at NOBA Bank Group? Your focus will be on advancing analytics capabilities, optimizing data workflows, driving innovation in the cloud, and unlocking the full potential of the organization’s most valuable asset – data.

About The Role

The Data & Analytics Engineering department comprises specialized teams focused on Data Infrastructure Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Management.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you'll play a central role in building and optimizing the organization's supporting analytics layer, collaborating across the bank. This role offers broad opportunities to grow and make a tangible impact!

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team-building, and enjoying fikas and after-work gatherings together!

Main Tasks

  • Design and implement efficient data models, focusing on analytics workflows and end-user usability.
  • Build robust and scalable data pipelines to support business intelligence and analytics needs.
  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, such as Risk, Finance, and IT, to ensure data solutions align with business needs.
  • Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the analytics lifecycle.
  • Drive technical improvements, introducing modern tools and processes to enhance analytics capabilities.
  • Partner with other engineers to align transformation processes for analytics purposes.

We Are Looking For Someone Who

Enjoys working with data & analytics engineering, modern data practices, and creating insights that drive decisions. We believe you are a detail-oriented and proactive person who thrives in a high pace enviroment and enjoy learning new technologies. You approach challenges with a “can-do” attitude and excel in analytical thinking and problem-solving.

For This Role You’ll Need

  • Work experience in a similar role within data engineering or analytics engineering
  • An academic degree related to analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar fields.
  • Proficiency in ETL processes, designing analytics-ready datasets, and ensuring clean and usable data for stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Databricks, dbt (SQL), python and related reporting tools and languages.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.
  • Fluency in English is required, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian.

It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Experience with Microsoft’s data stack (Azure, SQL, and other cloud services).
  • Experience working with on-prem solutions.
  • A background in data roles within the financial sector.
  • Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Our Offer To You

  • Freedom with Responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style.
  • Career Development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role.
  • Feedback Culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication.
  • Coaching Leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey.
  • A Caring Company Culture: We genuinely care about each other!

In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

Have you heard of NOBAVERSE?

In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly! ✨

Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page.

Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ.

We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health.

Read more about how we handle your personal data here.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

Title: Analyst
Description:
Analyst | Stockholm




Are you ready to accelerate your career? We are looking for two ambitious Analysts to join our Data & Intelligence team in Stockholm.




In this role, you’ll join an international environment where you won’t just analyze numbers, you’ll contribute to build our culture, drive client decisions, and shape our global business.




Who we are

Allshares is a fast-growing SaaS company and a leading expert in equity and incentive design and management. We provide advanced advisory services, software, and reporting tools to assist over 900 organizations across 60+ countries design, communicate, and manage their employee reward and share-based incentive programs.




Our team of 250+ specialists are located in the US, Finland, Sweden, Portugal, France and Switzerland. We’re dedicated to tailoring the desired incentive models for our clients as well as making compensation strategies simpler and more effective for companies of all sizes. Thanks to our recent growth, and corporate acquisitions, we are even better positioned to support our clients with innovative and scalable solutions.




About the Role

In this entry-level position, you will join an established advisory team driving technical and data-driven execution for clients ranging from high-growth scaleups to global Large Caps.




Your main responsibilities will include:

Research, collect, analyze and package data across our platforms and databases.
Conduct financial modeling, market research and quantitative analysis on equity programs.
Translate data into high-quality dashboards and client-ready presentations.
Taking ownership of workstreams, supported by mentorship from senior team members.
Support in benchmarking of compensation models and simulation of equity programs.




About You

We are looking for a fast-learning, self-driven talent with a practical, hands-on mindset who thrives in an ambitious environment.




To succeed in this role, you must have:

A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or similar field with strong academic results.
An analytical mindset, sharp problem-solving skills, ability to build structured logic and handle complex data with ease.
Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English (our corporate language).
Proactive and collaborative work style as you take ownership of specific tasks while supporting your team.
High adaptability and strong initiative qualities. You stay focused in dynamic environments, manage multiple priorities smoothly, and learn new business contexts fast.




Considered an advantage:

Comfortable presenting materials to senior colleagues and clients.
Expertise in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.




What we’ll offer

A possibility to work in a market leading and ambitious team in a fast growing global SaaS company
Monthly base salary ranging from 36 000 - 43 000 SEK depending on your background and experience
Participation in the company bonus program as decided annually
A benefits package, including wellbeing benefits, comprehensive healthcare, and support for cultural and sports activities
Inclusive international culture and working environment
Company- & team events and activities
Great possibility to develop yourself in the role along with the company’s growth journey




Employment: Full-time

Location: Stockholm

Apply by: On-going recruitment

We look forward to hearing from you. Send in your application today!




Please include a short section in your CV outlining your motivation and why you would be a great addition to our team.




If you have questions about the position, please reach out to careers@allshares.com.

Title: Management Consultant - Data & Analytics
Description:
Your role




Our Data & Analytics (D&A) team combine broad business understanding with technical expertise to help our clients make better data-driven decisions.




Expect to participate in projects ranging from advisory services to hands-on development of D&A solutions. We help our clients define a strategy, organize their D&A capabilities, and implement data platforms and analytical solutions. The analytical work ranges from business intelligence to Machine Learning and Generative AI.




Together with an ambitious and multidisciplinary team of colleagues, you will help our clients understand their current situation, risks, and opportunities and advise how they can use technology to solve their business needs. The type of projects will be varied, and you will have access to experts throughout our international community of consultants.




Your professional and personal growth will be supported by a Development Manager. As you deepen your expertise and grow as a consultant, you will take on greater responsibilities in our client engagements and our internal business activities. Such as team development, employer branding, developing new offerings, pitching to clients, and other activities.




What We Are Looking For In Our New Colleagues




You may have a background as a developer and now want to combine technical work with more business‑focused and strategic responsibilities. Alternatively, you may work in Consulting, have a strong technical interest, and want to deepen your expertise within data and AI.




We Expect Candidates To Have




Experience in data collection and analysis, along with a general understanding of business processes.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence solutions and Generative AI development, as well as programming proficiency in Python and SQL.
Some experience with Database design, ETL, and Data Visualization is also desirable.
Experience with Microsoft´s Data & Analytics tools is a plus (Fabric, PowerBI, SQL Server, Data Factory, etc.)
Ability to balance analytical rigor with practical, implementable recommendations.
Structured communication, adapting style to managers and operational teams and an ability to establish credibility quickly in new environments.
A master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other relevant field.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint to support daily business activities.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.




What We Offer




BearingPoint is a great place to work. We can offer you the opportunity to work for a company with a global reach and a unique culture that allows everyone to reach their highest potential. We also offer team-specific competency development opportunities and employee benefits such as:

Professional and personal growth, supported by your Development Manager.
An international, dynamic, and inspiring work environment.
A steep learning curve in client-facing roles with a high impact on the business performance of our clients.
Competitive compensation and benefits package, including but not limited to an occupational pension, health insurance, wellness grants, expanded parental benefits, and more.
Competency development opportunities include our First 1000-day program and other Nordic & Firm-wide training and boot camps (Grow with BearingPoint).
An annual curriculum of various social events and sports activities.




What Now?




Send us your resume in either Swedish or English, and we´ll get back to you shortly. A cover letter is optional, and Interviews will be held continuously.




During the interview process, you will meet various colleagues from the team and conduct case interviews.




Want to find out more about the team? Meet some of our colleagues here (Meet our Sweden team), or read an article with our D&A team lead Marcus Ehrndal here.




As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be subject to background checks. These checks help us ensure a safe and trustworthy workplace and may include verification of identity, employment history, education, and any relevant criminal records, in accordance with applicable laws.

Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management [Assistant/Regular/Senior]
Description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.


You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:


Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.


Your background and skills include:


Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
An interest in finance and technology.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 09/09/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Title: Nätanalytiker
Description:
Är du redo för att hänga med på vår spännande resa? Ellevio är ett av Sveriges största energibolag och tillsammans fortsätter vi att elektrifiera Sverige. Hos oss är du del av en trygg och viktig framtidsbransch samtidigt som du får möjlighet att göra skillnad, växa som individ och ha riktigt kul på vägen! Vi tror på en ljus och hållbar framtid, gör du?

Om rollen som Nätanalytiker

För att möjliggöra energiomställningen och möta framtidens behov av el krävs en djupare förståelse för hur elnätet behöver utvecklas för att möta förändrade laster och nya produktionskällor, såsom sol- och vindkraft. I rollen som Nätanalytiker kommer du att spela en central roll i att analysera och prognostisera var kapacitetsbegränsningar uppstår och hur de kan hanteras genom nätutveckling och flexibilitet. Du kommer att arbeta med att analysera och visualisera kapacitetsbehov samt utvärdera flexibilitetslösningar, både tekniskt och ekonomiskt.

En viktig del av arbetet är att visualisera och kommunicera dessa insikter till verksamheten, för att stödja beslut kring investeringar, drift och underhåll. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med verksamhetsutvecklare, data engineers och andra tekniska experter för att analysera elnätets framtida behov och leverera relevanta analyser och beslutsunderlag till verksamheten. Du kan även komma att ha kontakt med motsvarande funktioner hos andra nätägare.

Till din hjälp har du en modern analysplattform samt analysverktyg som Power BI, SQL och Python, men i denna roll ligger fokus också på systemanalys, att förstå och utveckla verksamhetens analysbehov samt strategisk planering.

Nyfiken på rollen och hur vi arbetar med analys?

Här kan du träffa några av våra medarbetare och få en inblick i rollen och hur vi arbetar med analys hos oss. Läs mer och se filmen här: Ellevio | Karriär | Dataanalys

För att du ska passa och trivas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har en ingenjörsutbildning, gärna inom energisystem eller elkraft, alternativt annan högre utbildning med dataanalys- eller analysinriktning, kombinerad med erfarenhet av elnätsverksamhet.

Det viktigaste är att du har en stark analytisk förmåga och ett intresse för elnätets roll i energiomställningen. Du har erfarenhet av kapacitetsanalyser, dataanalys eller annat arbete där du har analyserat elnätets behov och utveckling.

Du har ett systemperspektiv och förstår hur olika delar av elnätet hänger ihop, från produktion och konsumtion till styrning, investeringar och underhåll. Du deltar gärna i eller leder utvecklingsprojekt och är van att kommunicera och visualisera komplexa analyser på ett pedagogiskt sätt. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt och av att arbeta iterativt med utveckling av analyser och lösningar.

Du trivs i en roll med stor frihet att forma ditt arbete, men där mål och prioriteringar kan skifta över tid. För rollen krävs att du har god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Ellevio som arbetsgivare

På Ellevio får du möjlighet att utvecklas, påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt. Vi tror på nyfikenhet, samarbete och kontinuerligt lärande – och tillsammans arbetar vi för en ljus och hållbar framtid. Ett fint bevis på det är att vi 2026 blivit utnämnda till Karriärföretag - för sjätte året i rad!

Hos oss är jämställdhet, mångfald och inkludering en självklar del av vardagen. Genom initiativ som ELLE-nätet (Ellevios interna kvinnliga nätverk) och utbildningar inom kollektiv intelligens skapar vi förutsättningar för ett öppet och utvecklande arbetsklimat.

Våra kontor är viktiga mötesplatser för samarbete, innovation och kulturbyggande. Du förväntas därför tillbringa merparten av din arbetstid på kontoret. Vi erbjuder samtidigt ett flexibelt arbetssätt som värnar om en god balans i vardagen samt många andra fina förmåner.

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst - Vitamin Well Group
Description:
Vitamin Well Group develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.

As we continue expanding globally, we are strengthening our Commercial Operations team with a Commercial Operations Analyst who enjoys turning data into insights and driving better business decisions.

About The Role

Data and insights play an increasingly important role in how we make commercial decisions. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across Commercial, Supply Chain and Finance to provide reporting and insights that help us understand performance, identify opportunities and make better commercial decisions.

From distribution cost analysis and financial reporting to business cases and process improvements, you will transform data into actionable insights that improve the way we work and enable better commercial decisions across our global organisation.

What you'll do

Commercial Performance & Analytics


Own and continuously develop distribution cost reporting across our global markets.
Analyse logistics and distribution costs to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
Build business cases to support commercial negotiations and strategic initiatives.
Develop dashboards and performance reporting for stakeholders across the business.


Financial Control & Governance


Coordinate month-end logistics cost closing activities.
Validate invoices and support approval processes.
Monitor logistics spend against budgets and contracts.
Support accruals, forecasting and financial reporting.


Business Support


Provide analytical support for commercial negotiations, supplier reviews and tenders.
Support projects related to warehouse implementations and transportation optimisation through data analysis.
Deliver ad hoc analyses to support strategic and operational decision-making.


Continuous Improvement


Drive automation and standardisation of reporting processes.
Improve data quality and reporting accuracy, primarily in Power BI.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce manual work.


Who are you

You enjoy working with numbers but are equally motivated by understanding the business behind them. You are curious, structured and proactive, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights that support decision-making. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes rather than simply maintaining them.

You probably have:


2–4 years of experience in an analytical role within Supply Chain, Logistics, Commercial Operations, Finance or a similar function.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience with Power BI or another BI platform.
A good understanding of financial processes, including cost analysis, budgeting and month-end reporting.
Experience supporting commercial decisions through analysis and business cases.
Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.


How to apply

Application deadline: August 21st 2026

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.

Life at Vitamin Well Group

At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.

Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.

Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.

As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.

Title: Junior Commercial Analyst
Description:
Are you a recent graduate and eager to embark on your first full-time journey into the world of analytics? Or perhaps you're a junior specialist seeking new challenges and a fresh environment? Look no further than the opportunity to join our Commercial Excellence Team as a Junior Commercial Analyst at DANX Carousel Group.

This pivotal role within our Commercial Excellence department is tailor-made for individuals like you, hungry for learning opportunities and growth potential within our group. Whether you're just out of university or taking your initial steps along your career path, we're seeking candidates with a passion for analysis, sharp commercial acumen, and a drive to succeed.

As a Junior Commercial Analyst, you'll be at the forefront of revolutionizing the logistics industry through innovative solutions and data-driven strategies. We're searching for individuals with an analytical mindset, strong critical thinking skills, and a knack for meeting deadlines while efficiently managing their time.

Join us and kickstart your career with unparalleled opportunities for professional development and advancement within our dynamic organization.

Who We Are

DANX Carousel Group is a leading logistics specialist focused on time-critical solutions that aims to redefine industry standards. Our continuous focus on innovation, customer satisfaction, and market expansion has been instrumental in our growth. Our commercial entities operate across 35 countries, with offices strategically located throughout mainland Europe, the UK and Ireland. Through our constant commitment to ownership, learning, and care, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner within the European logistics space. Our vision is to become the leading pan-European specialist logistics provider, with the most comprehensive end-to-end solutions.

Key Responsibilities


RFQ data preparation: You drive crucial analyses and extract valuable insights based on customer data and requirements, used to make tangible commercial decisions, impacting the growth and profitability of the entire group, at the same time, ensuring that our customer-centric approach remains at the forefront of our business strategy.
Profitability simulations: You act as the conduit between operations, sales and senior management by facilitating business discussions and decisions on revenue/cost through flexible simulation models you will be building.
Market intelligence: You are at the forefront of logistics innovations, customer wishes and competitive dynamics through collecting micro- and macro-economical insights on the market internally and externally.


Your Skills And Qualifications


Minimum: a bachelor’s degree in economics, statistics, mathematics, industrial engineering, or any other quantitative relevant field.
Affinity for data analysis.
Advanced MS Excel proficiency and modelling:
Mastery of complex formulas, pivot tables, and data visualization.
Ability to create and maintain data models for in-depth analysis.
Macro- & micro-economic trends analysis and market research data collection:
Understanding of macroeconomic trends affecting the logistics industry.
Ability to analyse and interpret economic indicators, conduct interviews and other data collection methods to extract insights from the wider business (e.g. Sales, IT, Strategy, etc.).
Strong communication skills in English (spoken and written).
Problem-solving skills.
The ability to plan and work independently towards set goals.

Qualifications That Are Desirable


Previous experience in data analysis of large datasets and in pricing
Proven experience in RFQ (Request for Quotation) data analysis
Ability to conduct pricing, cost and profitability flexible simulations based on various factors.
Familiarity with advanced analytics tools and techniques (e.g., AI-driven pricing, machine learning, predictive modelling) for enhancing pricing strategies.
Master’s degree in relevant area.
Strong communication skills in one of the Nordic languages (spoken and written).

What We Offer

We offer you a familiar workplace where you become an essential part of our company. In our opinion, success is created through flexibility, good cooperation and commitment, where participation, responsiveness and the chance to influence drive us forward. We work in an open, positive, and inspiring environment with passionate colleagues who enjoy having fun at work. Something we are convinced benefits both profitability and ensures satisfied employees. We therefore organize kick-offs, Christmas dinners, and after-work events. Additionally, every month, we recognize outstanding achievements by crowning the Employee of the Month, as nominated by colleagues.

We have breakfast at all our locations in Sweden so that we can have a good start to the day together. We believe that an active life creates productivity and therefore encourage the use of the wellness allowance. We conduct exchanges between our locations and roles to create understanding, camaraderie, and educational opportunities. With us, there are great opportunities to grow and develop in the long run, where you set the limit for how far your ambitions can take you!

Practical Information


Start: The start date for the role is as soon as possible
Employment contract: Permanent with initial probationary period
Extent: Full-time.
Location: Månskärsvägen 5, 141 75 Kungens Kurva.
Recruiting process: We use competency-based interviews where your skills, knowledge and qualities relevant to DANX and the role will be assessed. After that, we carry out logical and personal tests that we go through together to build an even clearer picture of you as a candidate. We also do a background check on final candidate, as part of the process.
Application: If the position sounds interesting, send in your application today. Selection is being made on a running basis.
Contact: If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact our manager Leonel at leonel.andersson@danx.se or our HR department at HR@danx.se Please note that in line with GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.
Diploma: Please attach your university degree certificate (diploma) as proof of your qualification.


Please note that t he recruitment process may take longer than usual due to summer vacations.

We are processing this recruitment ourselves and do not wish for recruitment firms to contact us regarding this recruitment - nor interim consultancy firms. Thank you.

Description:
Vi söker en Volymanalytiker som genom analys och struktur bidrar till att vi har rätt volymer på rätt plats vid rätt tidpunkt – så att våra blommor alltid finns där kunden behöver dem. Title: CRM Analytics Lead
Description:
Gjensidige är ett av Nordens ledande försäkringsbolag noterade på Oslo Börs. Vi är verksamma i Sverige, Norge och Danmark och har totalt cirka 4600 medarbetare. I Sverige etablerades Gjensidige Försäkring år 2007. Här är vi cirka 300 medarbetare placerade i Stockholm, Luleå, Malmö eller Gävle och erbjuder försäkringsprodukter till privatpersoner och företag. Vi säkrar liv, hälsa och värden med utgångspunkt i vår vision "Vi ska känna kunden bäst och bry oss mest".

CRM Analytics Lead

Nu stärker vi vår CRM- och analysförmåga och söker en CRM Analytics Lead som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla datadrivna kundstrategier och avancerade analyslösningar. Vi är övertygade om att data, analys och AI kommer att vara avgörande för framtidens kundupplevelser och affärsutveckling inom försäkring.

Din roll

Som CRM Analytics Lead blir du en nyckelperson i allt från datautforskning till färdiga modeller i produktion. I rollen har du ett övergripande ansvar för kundanalys, insikter och modellering, och du samarbetar nära både affärens stakeholders och analytiker i andra delar av organisationen. Rollen passar dig som uppskattar variation, tar naturligt ägarskap och framför allt vill använda din kompetens för att skapa verkligt värde. Du kommer att tillhöra organisationen Marknad & Utveckling och rapportera till Chef CRM & Data.

Du kommer att:


Ta ansvar för hela kedjan: från datautforskning och modellutveckling till drift och uppföljning.
Utveckla och produktionssätta modeller för churn, retention, kundvärde, segmentering och NBO.
Analysera kund-, försäljnings- och försäkringsdata för att identifiera affärsmöjligheter.
Bygga robusta analyslösningar i Databricks med Python och SQL.
Utveckla dashboards och visualiseringar för ledning och verksamhet.
Arbeta med både stora datamängder och komplexa, ofullständiga dataset.
Utforska och implementera nya AI- och analysmetoder.
Vara en drivande kraft i utvecklingen av datadrivna arbetssätt och strategi inom CRM.



Vi söker dig som


Är självgående, tar egna initiativ och trivs med att äga både strategiska och operativa uppgifter.
Har erfarenhet av avancerad analys inom försäkring eller närliggande bransch.
Har erfarenhet av att bygga, validera och produktionssätta prediktiva modeller.
Har god förståelse för statistiska metoder och maskininlärning.
Trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt.
Omsätter idéer och analyser till handling och arbetar affärsnära för att skapa resultat.
Har en akademisk utbildning inom statistik, datavetenskap, matematik, teknisk fysik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande kvantitativ utbildning.



Därför ska du välja Gjensidige

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med några av försäkringsbranschens mest intressanta datautmaningar. Du får stort eget ansvar, moderna verktyg och möjlighet att påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt. Samtidigt blir du en del av en organisation där samarbete, utveckling och kundfokus står i centrum.

Vi hörs!

Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm.

Låter det intressant? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast den 13 september genom att skicka in ditt CV och svara på några frågor i samband med ansökan. Kontakta gärna rekryterande chef Andreas Stenberg, Andreas.Stenberg@gjensidige.se om du har funderingar om tjänsten. Intervjuer görs löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist
We're partnering with an established fintech that's using data science to solve complex business problems at scale. Operating in a highly digital environment, data sits at the centre of decision-making, giving the team the opportunity to test ideas quickly, measure outcomes, and create meaningful impact across the business.
As the company continues to invest in its Data & ML capabilities, they're looking for a Data Scientist to join a collaborative team where curiosity, analytical thinking and commercial impact are valued just as highly as technical expertise.
About the role:This is an opportunity to apply statistics, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve real business problems. You'll work closely with commercial teams to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities, and develop data-driven solutions that create measurable value.
The role has a particular focus on marketing and growth, but you'll be joining a wider Data Science function and working alongside experienced Data Scientists on a variety of business-critical initiatives.
This is a role for someone who enjoys asking the right questions, applying the appropriate analytical techniques, and taking ownership of problems from initial exploration through to models being deployed into production and delivering measurable impact.
What you'll do:Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.
About you:We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real-world business challenges.
You'll likely have:3+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.
Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
Why join?This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
You'll be joining a collaborative Data & ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving - and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact - we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Engineer / BI Consultant
Description:
Vill du kombinera data, AI och affärsutveckling?

Är du en erfaren Data Engineer eller BI-konsult som drivs av att skapa affärsvärde – inte bara bygga tekniska lösningar? Vill du arbeta nära företagsledningar och hjälpa några av Sveriges största företag att fatta bättre beslut med hjälp av data? Då kan detta vara nästa steg i din karriär.

Vår kund är ett väletablerat managementkonsultbolag med specialistkompetens inom verksamhetsstyrning, lönsamhetsutveckling och beslutsstöd. Nu söker de en Data Engineer som vill vara med och utveckla deras satsning inom Data & AI samt bidra till den fortsatta tillväxten av Stockholmskontoret.




Om rollen

Du kommer att arbeta i gränslandet mellan teknik och affär, där ditt uppdrag är att hjälpa kunder att omvandla komplex data till beslutsunderlag som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Rollen handlar inte enbart om att bygga dataplattformar och pipelines. Du kommer även att analysera verksamheters behov, ta fram relevanta KPI och utveckla datamodeller som ger ledningsgrupper bättre beslutsunderlag.




Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innebära att:

Utforma datamodeller och moderna datalager i Azure.
Bygga lösningar för analys, rapportering och visualisering i Power BI.
Arbeta med Python, SQL och moderna molnplattformar.
Delta i workshops och kundmöten för att förstå verksamhetens behov.
Ta fram KPI, styrmodeller och lönsamhetsanalyser tillsammans med kunden.
Bidra till utvecklingen av AI-baserade lösningar och hur AI kan skapa affärsvärde.
Samarbeta nära managementkonsulter och tekniska specialister i tvärfunktionella projektteam.




Vi tror att du har:

Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer, BI-konsult eller inom Data & Analytics.
Akademisk examen inom exempelvis Industriell ekonomi, Datavetenskap, Matematik, Teknisk fysik eller motsvarande.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL.
Erfarenhet av Azure och moderna dataplattformar.
Erfarenhet av datamodellering, ETL/ELT och Data Warehouse.
Erfarenhet av Power BI eller liknande analysverktyg.
Ett genuint intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas för att utveckla verksamheter.




Meriterande är erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Azure DevOps eller Databricks.




Vem är du?

Du trivs i skärningspunkten mellan teknik och verksamhet och motiveras av att förstå affären bakom datan.

Du är van att samarbeta med kunder och känner dig trygg i att diskutera lösningar med både verksamhet och ledning. Samtidigt har du ett stort tekniskt intresse och uppskattar att omsätta komplex data till tydliga beslutsunderlag.




Som person är du:

Affärsmässig och konsultmässig.
Kommunikativ och förtroendeingivande.
Prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad.
Analytisk och lösningsfokuserad.
Självgående med ett starkt eget driv.




Har du dessutom en grundläggande förståelse för ekonomistyrning, controlling eller finansiell rapportering är det ett stort plus.




Därför ska du välja den här möjligheten

Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett entreprenöriellt konsultbolag med korta beslutsvägar, stort eget ansvar och en kultur där varje medarbetare har möjlighet att påverka både kundernas utveckling och företagets framtid.




Du erbjuds bland annat:

Uppdrag hos några av Sveriges största företag och koncerner.
Möjlighet att kombinera management consulting, data och AI.
Stor frihet, ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.
Ett kompetent och prestigelöst team med hög kunskapsnivå.
Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och en tydlig karriärväg.
Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla ett växande Stockholmskontor.




Låter det intressant? Vi ser fram emot att berätta mer om företaget och rollen i nästa steg av processen.




Om anställningen:

Detta är en direktanställning där du kommer att bli direkt anställd av kunden.

Vår kund är ett väletablerat managementkonsultbolag med specialistkompetens inom verksamhetsstyrning, lönsamhetsutveckling och beslutsstöd. Nu söker de en Data Engineer som vill vara med och utveckla deras satsning inom Data & AI samt bidra till den fortsatta tillväxten av Stockholmskontoret.


Om rollen

Du kommer att arbeta i gränslandet mellan teknik och affär, där ditt uppdrag är att hjälpa kunder att omvandla komplex data till beslutsunderlag som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Rollen handlar inte enbart om att bygga dataplattformar och pipelines. Du kommer även att analysera verksamheters behov, ta fram relevanta KPI och utveckla datamodeller som ger ledningsgrupper bättre beslutsunderlag.

  • Bygga lösningar för analys, rapportering och visualisering i Power BI.
  • Arbeta med Python, SQL och moderna molnplattformar.
  • Delta i workshops och kundmöten för att förstå verksamhetens behov.
  • Ta fram KPI, styrmodeller och lönsamhetsanalyser tillsammans med kunden.
  • Bidra till utvecklingen av AI-baserade lösningar och hur AI kan skapa affärsvärde.
  • Samarbeta nära managementkonsulter och tekniska specialister i tvärfunktionella projektteam.

  • Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer, BI-konsult eller inom Data & Analytics.
  • Akademisk examen inom exempelvis Industriell ekonomi, Datavetenskap, Matematik, Teknisk fysik eller motsvarande.
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL.
  • Erfarenhet av Azure och moderna dataplattformar.
  • Erfarenhet av datamodellering, ETL/ELT och Data Warehouse.
  • Erfarenhet av Power BI eller liknande analysverktyg.
  • Ett genuint intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas för att utveckla verksamheter.


Meriterande är erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Azure DevOps eller Databricks.


Vem är du?

Du trivs i skärningspunkten mellan teknik och verksamhet och motiveras av att förstå affären bakom datan.

Du är van att samarbeta med kunder och känner dig trygg i att diskutera lösningar med både verksamhet och ledning. Samtidigt har du ett stort tekniskt intresse och uppskattar att omsätta komplex data till tydliga beslutsunderlag.


Som person är du:

  • Affärsmässig och konsultmässig.
  • Kommunikativ och förtroendeingivande.
  • Prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad.
  • Analytisk och lösningsfokuserad.
  • Självgående med ett starkt eget driv.


Har du dessutom en grundläggande förståelse för ekonomistyrning, controlling eller finansiell rapportering är det ett stort plus.


Därför ska du välja den här möjligheten

Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett entreprenöriellt konsultbolag med korta beslutsvägar, stort eget ansvar och en kultur där varje medarbetare har möjlighet att påverka både kundernas utveckling och företagets framtid.

  • Ett kompetent och prestigelöst team med hög kunskapsnivå.
  • Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och en tydlig karriärväg.
  • Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla ett växande Stockholmskontor.


Låter det intressant? Vi ser fram emot att berätta mer om företaget och rollen i nästa steg av processen.

Detta är en direktanställning där du kommer att bli direkt anställd av kunden.

Title: Advanced Pricing Analyst
Place: Vejle, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join AutoProff – Help Build Trust in the Price Models Powering Our European Growth! 🚗

We’re looking for an Advanced Pricing Analyst to join our team, based out of our Vejle headquarters.

At AutoProff, pricing is at the heart of how we serve customers and drive commercial performance. As our pricing capabilities continue to evolve, we need stronger ownership of how our price models perform in production. This role will be central to creating transparency around pricing quality, spotting issues before they become escalations, and ensuring we understand why our models behave the way they do.

As Advanced Pricing Analyst, you will own the reporting, monitoring, and investigation of price model performance across our production setup. You will help define the right benchmarks and reporting views to evaluate performance over time, identify weakspots or unusual behaviour, and support both existing and new model evaluations. You will also take the lead on investigating specific pricing cases raised by Pricing teams, using data and system-level understanding to determine whether issues stem from data quality, model behaviour, system integration, or whether the model output is in fact well supported by market observations.

This role sits at the intersection of pricing, analytics, and technical investigation. You will work closely with Pricing, Data Science, and other stakeholders to ensure that pricing behaviour is monitored, understood, and communicated clearly across the organisation. You will also contribute to building and strengthening the pricing setup that supports AutoProff’s continued growth across Europe.

Let’s dive into your key responsibilities, you will


Own the reporting and monitoring framework for price model performance in production, including defining the KPIs, benchmarks, and views needed to create a clear overview of model quality and behaviour.
Analyse model performance across segments, markets, and versions to identify weakspots, anomalies, drift, and other signals of deteriorating quality before they become business issues.
Lead investigations into unusual price outcomes and determine whether the underlying cause relates to data quality, model behaviour, system integration, or stakeholder interpretation.
Build a strong understanding of how price models are productionised and consumed through APIs, and validate that models are being supplied with the correct data, format, and values.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to Pricing, Data Science, and management, while supporting the quality assurance and benchmarking of existing and new price models.


The need-to-have skills


Strong SQL skills and experience working independently with large datasets to build reporting, monitor performance, and investigate pricing behaviour.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and visualisation skills, with the ability to structure investigations and turn complex findings into clear and actionable insights.
Hands-on Python experience for data investigation, exploratory analysis, and technical debugging.
A good understanding of how machine learning models work in practice, including how input quality, feature behaviour, formatting issues, or drift can affect outputs.
Comfort working with APIs, payloads, and technical system flows, combined with strong communication skills and confidence in challenging assumptions with data and evidence.


The nice-to-have skills


Experience working with pricing models, recommendation models, or other predictive models in production.
Experience investigating model-serving issues, feature quality issues, or data pipeline issues affecting live model outputs.
Familiarity with model monitoring concepts such as drift detection, segmentation analysis, and performance benchmarking over time.
Ability to reproduce or inspect price requests locally through technical tools, services, or APIs.
Experience working closely with Data Science teams and translating between analytical, technical, and business perspectives.


We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in 2013 with the aim to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

Title: Data & Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
On Behalf of Hobbii we are looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer




About Hobbii




Hobbii is Denmark's fastest-growing e-commerce company within yarn and handicrafts. From our base in Copenhagen, we've built a global brand serving passionate makers in more than 12 markets, with an ambition to become the world's leading online yarn universe. Driven by scalable technology, creative energy, and data-driven commerce, we're turning our passion for craftsmanship into a global success story.

This is a rare chance to join a small, dedicated data team at Hobbii and turn raw, complex data into trusted, business-ready answers the whole company relies on.




About the role

You’ll work with stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Tech, serving the business with their data needs and helping users make the most of our customer-centric data. You’ll have full ownership of your data products end to end, as well as talking to and educating the business.




Key responsibilities




• Work closely with Finance, Product and Commercial to understand what they need, and translate it into clear, trustworthy answers

• Own shared KPI definitions such as AOV, CLV, and Margin in our Cube semantic layer, so the business measures things consistently

• Contribute to maintaining and building SQL models and dashboards, and help key stakeholders understand the implementation

• Build useful Metabase dashboards and utilise coding and AI tools to help answer business questions effectively

• Contribute to the Data Dictionary so non-technical users understand what they are measuring and can explore data with confidence




Your profile

You’ve probably been the data person somewhere small before, so you’re used to owning things end to end and figuring them out yourself. You’re as curious about the business as the tech, you’d rather answer a real question than build something clever no one asked for, and you’re comfortable talking to stakeholders.




We imagine you bring:

• Genuine business curiosity and the instinct to translate stakeholder questions into practical solutions, this matters as much as the tech

• Experience with a modern data warehouse such as Redshift

• Interest in semantic modelling, KPI logic, or reusable business definitions. Cube, dbt, or LookML experience is a plus

• Curiosity about using AI and MCP for SQL support, documentation, or data exploration

• English fluency, written and spoken, our company language

• A relevant degree or equivalent practical background




Why join Hobbii?

At Hobbii you’ll join a tight-knit team building something global from Copenhagen, and as one of the first data hires, you’ll have unusual ownership and room to shape how we work. You’ll see the impact of your work across the business every week, with real room to grow as the data function grows. We move fast, support each other, and have a lot of fun along the way.




We offer:

Competitive salary based on experience and skills
Flexible work setup – hybrid (HQ in Nordvest, Copenhagen)
6 weeks of paid vacation
Health insurance and paid parental leave
Catered lunch, great coffee, and lively Friday bars
Legendary company events and a welcoming, informal culture
A great staff discount on yarn




Interested?

FACTOR 7 is managing the recruitment process. For more information, please contact Recruitment Manager Omar Kamel at omar@factor7.dk or on +45 30 22 09 02.
