Title: Business Intelligence (BI) Developer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
As Our Next Business Intelligence (BI) Developer You Can Play a Key Role in Shaping Our Company Strategy

You will work with diverse modern data platforms and support valuable data-driven decision-making. The role involves responsibility for designing, developing, and optimizing data pipelines while creating insightful reports and dashboards for a variety of stakeholders.

Get To Know Us

The RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies.

We are a global company of more than 325 employees, collaborating across borders while leveraging local market expertise in 17 locations. We combine deep underwriting expertise with hands-on, in-house claims handling, and high-quality internal business support, to deliver outstanding service and results to the market.

With us, you are trusted with responsibility. We invest in your development, value initiative, and give you the opportunity to shape your role, grow your expertise, and make a real impact.

About Your Team

You will join our Business Intelligence team, which currently consists of three members across Europe. You will join a small, highly skilled sub-team within our growing global IT function, working within the global Finance and Operations department. Our IT team brings together talented IT professionals across Denmark and the UK, combining strong technical talent with extensive insurance industry experience.

Your colleagues form part of our wider global IT team, operating across 17 countries, with 23 experts internationally.

What Will You Do?

Your work will directly to support data-driven decisions across the entire company and therefore we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented and a proactive problem-solver with strong communication skills.

You will collaborate with colleagues across the entire company and work closely with key stakeholders, including analysts, to ensure a solid understanding of data requirements and delivery of optimized reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights.

Key responsibilities include:


Collaborating with analysts & internal stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver optimized reports
Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data platforms to support various business needs
Implementing data integrations solutions using ETL tools
Ensuring data quality and integrity across all data platforms
Monitoring and troubleshooting data issues to maintain reliability
Staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends to continuously improve the data architecture and BI capabilities


This position is newly created to support our growth strategy and add further value to the team. You will have the opportunity to bring your experience and insights, whilst learning new skills, and developing your career.

This position will be based in Copenhagen and is office based.

About You

We are looking for someone with a strong technical background and a proven ability to deliver results that support the business, while working effectively with stakeholders across an international organization. You should be a self-starter, who is curious, comfortable working autonomously, and has ambition to drive change. An interest in coaching and developing others is also an advantage.

To be successful in this role, you should have:


A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
5 or more years of professional experience in BI development
An excellent understanding of SQL with professional experience on top data platforms (e.g., PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL, Snowflake)
Experience deploying and managing data solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
Proficiency in at least one programming language; e.g., Python, Go, or Java
Experience creating reports and dashboards using BI tools like Power BI, Terraform, or Tableau
Hands-on experience designing and implementing ETL processes
A strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and database design
A proven track record of working effectively in a team, communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and solving complex data problems


Experience with the following is preferred but not required:


Large-scale data processing technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Iceberg)
Modern data tools like Trino and dbt (data build tool)
Terraform for infrastructure as code
DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD pipelines, version control)


You must have current residency in Denmark with the necessary work and residency permits in place before applying.

Spoken and written fluency in English is essential for this role, ideally together with a basic understanding of Danish. Other languages are an advantage.

How Do You Apply?

We are looking forward to receiving your CV and responses to the application questions. Please apply in English.

Application will be handled by our partners at Whatever. Their expert recruiters will look at applications on a rolling basis, so encourage you to apply as early as possible.

For more information, please contact Zubair Sabir, CTO via *protected email*.

Please note that we do not accept applications via e-mail. All further communication will be in English.

About The RiskPoint Group

The RiskPoint Group is one of Europe’s largest Managing General Underwriters (MGUs), providing best in class insurance solutions to businesses and their advisors globally. The RiskPoint Group operates as RiskPoint in Europe and Asia and RP Underwriting in the rest of the world.

With 325+ employees and 18 locations in Europe, North America, and Asia Pacific, the RiskPoint Group employs expert underwriting and specialized, in-house claims teams within Accident & Health, Transactional Risk, Property & Construction, Renewable Energy, Offshore Upstream, and Liabilities, including Financial Lines, Cyber, and Casualty.

The RiskPoint Group is a Coverholder with Lloyd’s of London and is backed by a strong panel of well-reputed insurance companies. The RiskPoint Group core values are: trust, openness & honesty, respect & tolerance, drive & dedication as well as being part of a winning team in a competitive environment.

Title: Data Analytics Lead
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Please note: This is a full-time office-based role (5 days/week).




About the Role

As a Platform Data Analyst, you will own analytical workstreams end-to-end — from scoping and data modelling through to communicating findings and driving stakeholder action. You will work with large, complex datasets spanning customer orders, supplier transactions, asset utilisation, and operational data, contributing to KPI frameworks, experiment design, and AI/ML use case development — using AI tools where they genuinely accelerate work, not as a default. This is an individual contributor role: your impact comes from analytical craft, clarity of thinking, and your ability to influence decisions through insight rather than through line management or product ownership. You will sit close to platform product and engineering teams, but your remit is analytics.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics & Insight

Identify and quantify opportunities in platform data; translate findings into clear recommendations for product and business teams.
Design and maintain decision-oriented KPI frameworks accessible to front-line teams and senior management alike.
Conduct deep-dive analyses on product adoption, user behaviour, performance trends, and business impact — and design experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, significance testing) to test hypotheses that emerge.
Support benefit estimation and validation for platform product initiatives.

Data Craft & Self-Sufficiency

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, transform, and model data from multiple source systems.
Build reusable analytical datasets that support recurring analysis and reporting — working independently or alongside data engineering colleagues as needed.
Work within our Azure/Databricks cloud infrastructure, treating analytical datasets as data products: clear ownership, documented SLAs, versioning, and a feedback loop with end users.
Proactively identify data quality issues and work with upstream teams to resolve them.

Stakeholder Engagement & Delivery

Partner with product owners, Business users, and engineering teams to translate analytical needs into well-defined workstreams and communicate findings through data storytelling that connects insight to business priorities and drives action.
Own your analytical backlog — prioritise, set realistic expectations, and manage delivery independently.
Flag potential bias, fairness issues, or unintended consequences in analytical outputs and model inputs before they reach decisions.

AI/ML & GenAI

Build and maintain feature engineering pipelines and evaluation frameworks that enable AI/ML model development.
Use tools like Copilot (code completion) and Claude or ChatGPT (summarisation, documentation, data exploration) to accelerate analytical tasks — anchored to specific, validated workflows.
Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to ensure analytical outputs meet model input requirements (schema, distribution, data quality).

Skills & Experience

Education

Degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Natural Sciences, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

3–6 years in business analytics or data analysis, ideally in a complex, large-scale data environment.
Proven track record delivering end-to-end analytical projects — from scoping through to stakeholder action.
Experience working in or alongside product or platform teams.
Hands-on use of AI tools (Copilot, LLM-based analysis, prompt engineering) as part of analytical or engineering workflows is a strong advantage.

Technical Skills

Strong SQL proficiency for extraction, transformation, and modelling across large datasets.
Python for data manipulation, analysis, and automation (pandas, numpy, and similar libraries).
Azure and Databricks experience; familiarity with data pipeline development, data modelling concepts, and data quality best practices.
Power BI or equivalent, with the ability to build clear, decision-oriented dashboards.
Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and how analytical pipelines feed into model development; practical use of AI coding tools (Copilot) and LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for analytical tasks — with the judgement to validate outputs and know their limits.

Behaviours & Mindset

Proactive and self-directed — you identify problems before being asked and take ownership.
Structured problem-solver — you break ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical tasks and communicate findings to diverse audiences without losing rigour.
Collaborative and stakeholder-savvy — you understand that great analytics only creates value when trusted and acted upon, and balance high standards with pragmatism about what fits the decision at hand.
AI-critical — you use GenAI tools effectively but validate outputs, flag governance concerns, and apply your own judgement before acting on recommendations.

Title: Funnel Optimisation Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Job

As a Funnel Optimisation Analyst in the Marketing team at Flatpay, you'll own the testing and analysis behind our funnel from webform visit through to lead and booking, across all markets. You’ll work closely with both the Marketing team and the local sales teams to identify, test, and prove opportunities to improve visit-to-booking performance.

What You'll Do


Work with teams across markets to understand lead handling processes and identify growth opportunities
Design and analyse structured tests on our webforms including layouts, field order, and flow structure to improve visit-to-submission rate
Design and analyse operational tests to identify lead-to-sale optimisation opportunities
Use SQL and Python to transform and analyse large data sets relating to visit-to-booking performance
Ensure webform data is clean, consistent, and ready for ingestion into our data warehouse
Support with market-level performance analysis and performance monitoring dashboards


Who You Are

You are analytical, organised, and curious. You enjoy designing and analysing experiments that directly impact business growth, and you are comfortable turning messy or complex data into clear insights and recommendations.

Must-haves


1-3 years experience in a revenue growth, operations, analytics or other data focused role
Experience using SQL to query large datasets, perform analysis, and generate actionable business insights
Structured, hypothesis-driven approach to experimentation and problem solving
Comfortable working cross-functionally with stakeholders and sales teams across different markets.
Strong attention to detail and an interest in improving data quality and business processes


Nice-to-haves


Experience working with webforms, lead generation, or similar conversion funnels
Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks or a similar cloud data warehouse


We'd still love to hear from you if...

You don't check every box but you're a sharp, data-driven problem solver who's excited about experimentation and improving how leads move through the funnel. If you're analytical, curious and motivated by turning messy data into real business impact, we encourage you to apply!

Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

About Flatpay

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About Us

Complir is the AI platform for the product compliance lifecycle, built for retailers, brands, and manufacturers selling physical consumer products across multiple markets.

We believe getting a physical product to market shouldn't mean fighting spreadsheets, PDFs, and supplier emails just to prove it's safe and legal to sell. Product compliance should be continuous, automatic, and understandable, not a bottleneck that slows launches down. We're building the AI infrastructure that makes that possible.

We work with many of the world's largest retailers and brands across fashion, furniture, cosmetics, toys, electronics and many other product categories. We're backed by Y Combinator, and a roster of investors who see what we see: Product compliance is the next major infrastructure category, and we're leading it.

About The Role

Every product you've ever bought, from a kid's toy dinosaur to your electric toothbrush, had to clear a wall of regulation before it reached you. That wall is written down somewhere: scattered across hundreds of government portals, PDFs, and legal databases, in dozens of languages, updated on no schedule anyone agreed to.

Your job is to turn that chaos into structured, queryable data our product can act on. You'll be the person who makes the world's product regulations machine-readable.

The data layer everything stands on

This is not a role where you write Python scripts in isolation. You'll understand, crawl, and monitor regulatory sources across hundreds of jurisdictions, parse raw legal text into a normalized requirement schema, and catch changes the day they land, so every label, Declaration of Conformity, and risk assessment we generate is provably current.

The interesting problems are everywhere: government portals that were last redesigned when fax machines were current, legal text that means different things in different translations, amendments that quietly rewrite three other acts, and the question of how you prove to an enterprise customer that your data was correct on the day they shipped. LLMs make structured extraction over legal text possible for the first time; making it reliable enough to stake a product launch on is the engineering problem you'll own.

You'll do this sitting next to the founders, our AI engineers, and our in-house compliance experts at our Copenhagen HQ. No layers, no ticket queues. When a source breaks or a regulation changes, the fix ships in hours, not sprints.

What You'll Actually Do


Build and operate the crawling and monitoring layer across hundreds of regulatory sources: government portals, legislative databases, and official gazettes in dozens of languages
Parse raw legal text (HTML, PDFs, scans) into a normalized requirement schema, using LLM-assisted extraction pipelines you design, evaluate, and harden
Build change detection that catches new acts, amendments, and repeals the day they land, and triggers the downstream updates our customers depend on
Own data quality end to end: provenance, versioning, and coverage metrics, so every requirement in the platform traces back to its primary source
Work with our regulatory experts to evolve the schema and taxonomy as coverage grows from the EU to new jurisdictions
Shape the architecture, tooling, and data culture as the team grows


You will love this job, if you are:


An engineer with several years building data pipelines, crawling infrastructure, or large-scale extraction systems
Experienced with (or seriously hungry to go deep on) LLM-assisted extraction: structured outputs, evals, and the failure modes of models reading dense text
Someone who treats data correctness as sacred: provenance, versioning, and "how do we know this is still true?" are your favorite questions
Unafraid of messy sources: broken HTML, scanned PDFs, and legal prose in languages you don't speak are puzzles, not blockers
Product-minded: You understand that a quality manager will stake a product launch on your pipeline's output
Bonus points if you have worked with regulatory data before
Comfortable with ambiguity and speed: Small team, fast decisions, no spec handed down from above
Excited to work on-site in Copenhagen with the whole team
A builder at heart


What You Get


Ownership of the regulatory data layer, the foundation the entire product stands on
Zero layers: You sit next to the founders, the AI team, and the compliance experts whose domain you're turning into data
Ground floor of a category-defining company, backed by Y Combinator and investors betting on product compliance becoming the next big thing
Competitive salary and equity
An office where the pastries are mandatory


If you've read this far and thought "that's the data problem I want to own," we'd like to meet you.

Would you like to work for a company with solutions that contributes to Saab’s mission of keeping people and society safe?

Would you like to be a part of shaping the Future of Digital Engineering and building the Future of Engineering?

Engineering is evolving rapidly. Model Based Systems Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, connected engineering data, and digital collaboration are transforming how complex systems are designed and delivered.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help build the data foundation that enables modern engineering. You will connect engineering data, improve digital workflows, and prepare the organization for AI enabled engineering.

Your role

You will:


Develop data pipelines and system integrations across engineering tools
Improve data quality, consistency, governance, and traceability
Support Digital Thread and MBSE initiatives
Prepare engineering data for AI and advanced analytics
Design scalable data models and dashboards
Identify opportunities to automate engineering processes
Collaborate with engineers, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver practical solutions



Your Profile

You have experience in one or more of the following areas:


Data Engineering
Software Engineering
Systems Engineering
Data Science
Computer Science
Information Technology



Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, cloud platforms, Power BI, graph databases, engineering lifecycle tools, or AI technologies is an advantage but not a requirement.

More important than your exact background is your ability to solve complex problems, connect information, and turn data into business value.

We Are Looking For Someone Who


Thinks analytically and works in a structured way
Enjoys collaborating across technical disciplines
Is curious about new technologies and continuous improvement
Can translate engineering challenges into digital solutions
Takes ownership and delivers pragmatic results



Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, data, and emerging technologies.

Your work will help accelerate Digital Engineering, strengthen MBSE adoption, improve engineering efficiency, and establish the foundation for future AI capabilities.

If you want to build solutions that will influence how engineering is performed in the years ahead, we would like to hear from you.

Saab Danmark is a company that is growing and you will therefore experience a company that is dynamic and able to adapt. In the Saab group we have a saying” Business is done between people”, and this is also the environment you can expect here. We offer:


Initial learning process with mentorship and support
Good career and development opportunities in a professional company
A vibrant and international atmosphere with colleagues from all over the world
Benefits that support our employees’ wellbeing

Focus on our teams, good cooperation and giving our employees the ability to take ownership of their tasks.

Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About the Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."

Who You Are

A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)

 

What’s in it for you:

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms 
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

Title: Dataanalytiker
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
HOFOR arbejder målrettet med data, BI, AI og digitalisering som grundlag for bedre beslutninger, mere effektive arbejdsgange og større værdi på tværs af organisationen. Vi søger en dataanalytiker, som kan omsætte forretningsbehov til analyser, datamodeller og løsninger, der skaber reel værdi i praksis.

Analyse og udvikling af BI- og dataløsninger

Du bliver en del af sektionen AI & BI Udvikling og får en central rolle i at bygge bro mellem forretning, data og teknologi. Du skal identificere behov, kvalificere idéer og omsætte dem til analyser, dashboards og datadrevne løsninger, der understøtter beslutninger, optimerer processer og fremmer HOFORs digitale udvikling.

Dine opgaver bliver at:


Indsamle, analysere og visualisere data samt omsætte mønstre, afvigelser og tendenser til indsigter, der kan bruges i beslutninger og prioritering
Analysere årsager bag nøgletal og KPI’er
Udvikle, vedligeholde og optimere dashboards, KPI-overvågning og rapporteringsløsninger i Power BI
Arbejde med dataudtræk, transformation og indlæsning af data fra forskellige datakilder
Udvikle og dokumentere datamodeller, semantiske modeller, dataflows, processer og analyser
Sikre datakvalitet, validering, performance og governance i løsningerne
Samarbejde med IT om databaser, API-integrationer, connectorer og systemunderstøttelse
Bidrage til prioritering og kvalificering af BI-, data- og AI-initiativer



God forretningsforståelse og erfaring med dataanalyse og BI

Du har nogle års erfaring med dataanalyse, rapportering eller BI-udvikling. Du kombinerer gode analytiske evner med en solid teknisk forståelse og trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, data og teknologi. Du er nysgerrig på sammenhænge, ser bag om tallene og evner at omsætte dataindsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og handlemuligheder.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:


Har erfaring med Power BI, SQL, databaser, datamodellering, ETL-processer, Power Query og DAX
Kan omsætte forretningsbehov til relevante analyser, KPI'er, dashboards og anbefalinger
Har forståelse for datakvalitet, governance, integrationer og samspillet mellem forretning, data og IT-systemer
Kommunikerer dataindsigter klart og konstruktivt og trives i samarbejdet med mange forskellige interessenter



Dine dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen

Du får ni dygtige kolleger, du kan sparre og grine med i hverdagen og bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med AI- og UX-specialister, BI-udviklere og projektledere. Derudover bliver du også en del af et større digitaliseringsområde med 180 engagerede medarbejdere.

Vi værdsætter faglig forskellighed og prioriterer et sundt og fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø, der bl.a. giver plads og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale med nærmeste leder. Hos os er der plads til dig, og til at du har et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her .

Sådan bliver du vores kollega

Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 3. september 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge vores stilling, du skal derfor ikke skrive en ansøgning, men blot sende dit CV, hvor du sætter nogle ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her.

Vi afholder 1. samtaler den 10. og 11. september og 2. samtaler den 15. og 18. september.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Shadi Chreiteh på tlf. 34458460.

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen”.

Hos os får du plads

Vand, varme, hverdag. I HOFOR sikrer vi forsyningen i hovedstadsområdet. Men vores ansvar rækker længere: Vi skaber fremtidens bæredygtige byer. Det kræver overskud, og derfor giver vi dig plads. Plads til at forfølge de store ideer og til at hente de små. Plads til at dyrke de faglige detaljer og til at tegne de store linjer. Plads til at hjælpe hinanden og til at tænke nyt, når der er brug for det. Vi har plads til flere og til, at du kan være med.

HOFOR. Hos os får du plads. Til fællesskab, udvikling og et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Inkluderende kultur og rekruttering

I HOFOR arbejder vi på at skabe en inkluderende kultur, og vi leder efter dygtige kollegaer uanset udseende, køn, kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, etnicitet, religion, handicap, alder osv. Vi vil gerne skabe lige muligheder for alle samt sikre en retfærdig rekrutteringsproces. Undlad venligst at vedhæfte et billede.

Title: Finance Digital Analyst
Place: Dragør, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Om stillingen 

Vi søger en Finance Digital Analyst til Sunclass Airlines, som kombinerer stærke analytiske kompetencer med interesse for digitalisering og datadrevet økonomistyring.

Som Finance Digital Analyst bliver du en del af et dygtigt og engageret Finance team og får en central rolle med betydelig indflydelse på tværs af den bredere Finance funktion. I tæt samarbejde med forretningen, og det lokale Finance team, bidrager du til den fortsatte udvikling af økonomistyring og performance rapportering på tværs af vores forretningsområder.

Derudover, får du en central rolle i vores digitale transformationsrejse med fokus på udvikling og vedligeholdelse af automatiseringsløsninger. Dertil kommer forbedring af rapportering samt videreudvikling af Power BI og AI agenter i Finance funktionen. Formålet er at styrke datadrevet beslutningstagen og forbedre kvaliteten af finansiel indsigt.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Som vores nye Finance Digital Analyst vil dine primære ansvarsområder være at:


Drive udviklingen af Power BI, datamodellering i DAX, semantiske modeller og rapportudvikling
Udvikle Power Automate-løsninger og automatisering af processer
Videreudvikle rapporterings- og budgetmodeller ved brug af Power Query, pivottabeller, komplekse formler og generel opbygning af finansielle modeller
Drive udviklingen af AI-værktøjer, f.eks. Copilot Studio, Claude Code eller prompt engineering, og AI-understøttelse af forskellige arbejdsprocesser
Samarbejde med stakeholders på tværs af Sunclass Airlines og koncernen for at øge transparens, performance management og finansielt overblik
Deltage i måneds- og årsrapportering
Arbejde med både historiske data, budgettering og forecasts
Løbende sikre, at processer fungerer effektivt og lever op til vores krav og procedurer
Være aktiv i automatiseringen og digitaliseringen i vores Finance Excellence-program


Hvem søger vi

Vi Ønsker, At Du Opfylder Følgende


Minimum bachelorgrad inden for finans, økonomi, IT, dataanalyse, ingeniørvidenskab eller et tilsvarende relevant område
Erfaring med datamodellering, DAX, semantiske modeller og rapportudvikling
Erfaring med udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Power Automate-flows samt automatisering af finansielle processer
Erfaring med Power Query, pivottabeller, komplekse formler og generel opbygning af finansielle modeller
Flydende i dansk, svensk eller norsk i både skrift og tale
Flydende engelsk i både skrift og tale


Som person er du en stærk teamplayer, der værdsætter åben kommunikation og bidrager til et positivt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen. Du arbejder analytisk og løsningsorienteret og har evnen til effektivt at håndtere og omsætte store datamængder til værdifulde indsigter. Samtidig har du en metodisk tilgang til dine opgaver og et skarpt øje for detaljen, hvilket sikrer høj kvalitet i dit arbejde. Du er resultatorienteret og fokuseret på at skabe værdi gennem dine opgaver, samtidig med at du arbejder struktureret, proaktivt og selvstændigt i et dynamisk miljø. Derudover motiveres du af at arbejde med økonomiske problemstillinger og at identificere og implementere forbedringer af digitale processer.

Vi tilbyder 

Vi tilbyder et spændende og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, hvor du har mulighed for at gøre karriere internt i koncernen. Du får en varieret hverdag med fart over feltet, hvor vidensdeling og samarbejde er i højsædet – dette på et nordisk plan, da vi arbejder på tværs af de nordiske lande for at sikre de bedste uger på året for vores kunder i alle lande. Vi elsker vores arbejde og glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på vores rejse i Sunclass Airlines og Nordic Leisure Travel Group.

Vi tilbyder desuden en række personalegoder som sundhedsforsikring, kantineordning og personalerabat på rejser.

Vores kontor i Københavns Lufthavn Syd i Dragør er med gratis parkering og bus lige udenfor døren.

Øvrigt

Stillingen er fast fuldtidsansættelse. Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til funktionæroverenskomsten.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23. august 2026.

Start: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Kontaktperson: Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Manager Jesper Jensen på tlf: +45 20 21 21 74.

Vi søger en Finance Digital Analyst til Sunclass Airlines, som kombinerer stærke analytiske kompetencer med interesse for digitalisering og datadrevet økonomistyring.

I tæt samarbejde med forretningen, og det lokale Finance team, bidrager du til den fortsatte udvikling af økonomistyring og performance rapportering på tværs af vores forretningsområder.

Title: Portfolio Analyst
Place: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Just imagine shaping the portfolio behind future LEGO® play experiences. Then make it real.

This Portfolio Analyst role sits in Engineering & Quality Strategic Projects & Portfolio Management in Billund, with no relocation support offered. You'll turn portfolio data into clear choices for senior leaders.

Play your part in our team succeeding

Our team guides a varied portfolio of strategic initiatives across Engineering & Quality, from sustainability projects to new technologies and play experiences. You'll help the LEGO® team see where resources, budgets, risks and benefits connect, so the right work moves forward with clarity. Together, we'll explore, experiment and learn.


Core Responsibilities



Portfolio Data Management & Analysis Collect, structure, maintain and evaluate comprehensive data on the project portfolio, including resources, budgets, risks, benefits, delivery performance and others. Support scenario analysis and prioritization models, e.g. project intake process
Performance Tracking Develop, maintain and continuously improve project portfolio performance dashboards and reporting tools to track key portfolio metrics and enable data-driven decisions.
Decision Support Create clear, concise decision-making materials with compelling narratives tailored to senior management, enabling well-informed decisions. Communicate complex topics in a simple, easily understandable manner.
Operational & Strategic Support Take ownership of ad-hoc portfolio analysis, reporting, and other operational tasks where needed. Identify and proactively drive opportunities to streamline processes, enhance workflows, and improve operational efficiency.
Governance & Decision Framework Support and enforce governance structures, decision-making processes, and portfolio management standards that ensure accountability, consistency, and transparency.


Do you have what it takes?

We imagine you have a curiosity and eagerness to learn, aspiring to accelerate your career through practical experience and mentorship. You're driven to help make strategic decisions through impactful work. Additionally, you bring



Strong analytical skills, proficiency developing and data analysis tools and methods.
Experience from portfolio analysis, project coordination, strategy support or a similar data-focused role.
Comfortable using analysis tools and methods to turn information into useful recommendations.
Clear communicator who can explain complex findings in simple.
Collaborative approach, curiosity and readiness to learn new skills as the work evolves.
Proficient in English, both written and spoken.


Please note that relocation support is not offered for this role.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer
Place: Hillerød, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Help build and operate the future of Business Intelligence at Ellab




Ellab is on an exciting growth journey, and data is at the heart of our success. We are building a unified, company-wide Business Intelligence platform that will enable better decision-making across our global organization spanning 15 different countries with approximately 800 employees and 980 million DKK in turnover.




We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer who enjoys building things, solving problems and making data work in the real world.

If you like to get into the details, understand how operational systems work, turn raw data into reliable solutions and take ownership when something doesn't work as expected, this role is for you!

As part of our growing Business Intelligence team, you'll work alongside Data Engineers, BI Engineers and an analyst, owning the data value chain from operational source systems through to semantic models and reporting. You will help move Ellab from fragmented reports and ad hoc data extracts toward a centralized, scalable BI platform - while also making sure that the solutions we build work reliably in day-to-day operations.




What You'll Be Doing




This is a hands-on engineering role. You will spend your time building, improving, troubleshooting, and maintaining BI solutions, while working closely with the business to understand the problems behind the data.

You will:




Build, maintain and optimize semantic models in Power BI to enable reliable, scalable and compliant reporting, ensuring consistent data integrity and traceability across Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Field Services and Sales.
Develop and improve data solutions using SQL, Microsoft Fabric and ADF.
Work directly with operational data sources from Microsoft business applications such as Business Central and Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Field Service, Project Operations) and investigate data quality, integration, and reporting issues.
Troubleshoot problems and take end-to-end responsibility from idea to implementation and continuous improvement.
Work closely with stakeholders to translate business processes, needs and operational challenges into practical, robust BI solutions.
Continuously improve existing data models, reports, and ways of working in the team and the organization.
Help establish standards and best practices for BI development, data quality, and documentation.




What You'll Bring




You combine strong technical skills with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

You'll ideally have:




3+ years of experience working with Power BI, DAX and SQL.
3+ years of experience working with semantic layers, ensuring consistent metric definitions across business units.
Experience working with data from operational systems such as ERP and CRM
A track record of building and delivering working BI or data solutions, rather than primarily managing projects or coordinating others.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
The ability to understand a business problem, investigate the underlying data, and turn it into a practical solution.
A structured and pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
The ability to work independently and take ownership from problem identification through implementation.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.




It would be an advantage if you also have:




Experience with Microsoft Fabric and the wider Microsoft data ecosystem.
Experience working in complex, enterprise-scale environments.
Experience integrating data from multiple operational systems.
Exposure to multinational organizations and diverse business domains.
Knowledge of finance, supply chain, procurement, resource planning, manufacturing, or related business functions.




The Hiring Process




If you are ready to take on this exciting opportunity, apply now to join our team.

We aim to hire the best fit as soon as possible. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis until a mutually suitable match has been identified.

Title: BI Consultant
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in its Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. As part of this journey, we are modernizing how data is managed, governed, and leveraged across our global organization.

We are looking for a BI Consultant to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing expertise with a passion for partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful business value through data and analytics.

The role

As a BI Consultant, you will work closely with business stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to understand business challenges, define analytical requirements, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

You will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of our enterprise data and reporting landscape while contributing to the continued development of our BI and analytics capabilities built on Microsoft Azure and Power BI.

This role requires a consultative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify opportunities to create value through data and analytics
Designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
Translating business requirements into scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions
Contributing to the development and evolution of our Enterprise Data Platform and Data Warehouse
Ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data and reporting solutions
Supporting data governance, data quality, and master data management initiative
Driving adoption of self-service analytics and promoting best practices across the organization
Collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and other members of the Data & Analytics team


Suggested candidate profile

Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a relevant educational background within Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience delivering Business Intelligence and analytics solutions in a modern data environment.

You are someone who enjoys solving business challenges through data and turning complex requirements into meaningful insights. You are equally comfortable discussing business objectives with stakeholders and diving into the technical details of data models, reporting solutions, and analytics.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, and collaborative. You take ownership, build strong relationships across the organization, and maintain high standards for quality, professionalism, and data integrity.

More Specifically, You Bring


Around 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Warehousing, preferably from an international business environment
Strong experience with Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, and dashboard development
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with enterprise data warehouses
Experience gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions
Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing principles
Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Lake) is considered an advantage
Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management principles is beneficial
Familiarity with Agile ways of working is a plus


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process in August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: BI & Data Consultant
Description:
Join Our Digital Transformation Journey

At Palsgaard, we are continuing our digital transformation by strengthening the applications, data platforms, and integrations that support our global business processes.

To support this journey, we are looking for a BI & Data Consultant who will play a key role in developing and improving our data platform, BI solutions, integrations, and business application landscape. The role combines hands-on technical development with close collaboration across IT and the business to turn data, BI, digital opportunities, and AI into scalable solutions.

In this role, you will work across a focused portfolio of BI, data platform, integration, and business-critical application technologies, including:


Our central data platform, which consolidates business data for reporting, analytics, and integrations between applications.
Power BI, Fabric, semantic models, and Microsoft Copilot, helping strengthen reporting, AI adoption, and value creation across the organization.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365FO) and related integrations.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM), Work Point, and other business applications that support our global processes.


Our solutions are largely cloud-based and built on Microsoft Azure technologies. You will play an active role in maintaining, enhancing, and future-proofing our data platform, BI solutions, and related application landscape while ensuring strong collaboration between business stakeholders, IT, and external partners.

Your responsibilities:

As a BI & Data Consultant, you will be an important part of Palsgaard’s Global BI and Data Platform team in our global IT department in Juelsminde. You will contribute to strengthening the digital and data foundation that supports Palsgaard’s strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:


Develop, maintain, and further modernize our central data warehouse/data platform, including data ingestion, transformation, data modelling, and preparation of reliable data for reporting and analytics.
Develop Power BI reports from our backlog in close collaboration with global business stakeholders and the BI team, ensuring high-quality, scalable data models and clear analytical storytelling.
Contribute to improving how Palsgaard uses AI across the organization and how AI can support the development, documentation, automation, and quality of BI solutions created by the team.
Support daily operation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of BI, data platform, and integration solutions.

The role is a full time position based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Meet the Trading Quants team. We add value by being change enablers that drive transformation of the investment process as part of an agile value stream where we identify business problems, define and implement solutions, to generate tangible value for our clients.

Extend our data platform, adding new data sources and transformations in response to new business requirements.
Build internal tools to support our trading desks.
Assist with implementing AI use cases leveraging our data models.
Drive projects within a value stream, binding together business and technology, to ensure we deliver tangible outcomes for our clients.
Interact with internal and external stakeholders, and our technology providers.


You’ll join a motivated and experienced quant team that values a cooperative environment where you can draw on your teammates' expertise and commitment to excellence.

This is the right role for you if you are someone who takes ownership of your work and is driven to make a meaningful impact, while being comfortable sharing your opinions and challenging established ways of thinking. You bring a software engineering mindset to your data work, embracing practices such as everything-as-code and automated testing. You thrive on learning quickly, are interested in exploring alternative ways of working, and possess strong stakeholder management skills that enable you to build relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.

Your background and skills include:


Experience working in a data analytics or data engineering capacity ideally using Python.
Experience with SQL.
An interest in asset management and financial markets.
Fluent in English both verbal and written.


It would be ideal if you also:


Are familiar with Snowflake and dbt.
Have practical knowledge of using Apache Airflow e.g. building DAGs.
Have experience with AWS or other public cloud solution.
Have hands-on experience implementing AI use cases, or a demonstrable enthusiasm for leveraging AI to drive innovation and efficiency.


If this sounds like you, get in touch!

What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 07/09/2026.

For more information, you’re welcome to contact Simon Hørdum Bonde at simon.bonde@nordea.com.

Title: Asset Performance Analyst
Description:
Asset Performance Analyst – Customer and Commercial Excellence




Would you like to help strengthen the long-term performance and reliability of Copenhagen Metro?

Metroselskabet operates the Copenhagen Metro, a fully automated, driverless metro system. With a high degree of automation and extensive operational and maintenance data, we have a strong foundation for working systematically with asset performance, reliability and continuous improvement.

You will join Customer and Commercial Excellence, where we work to ensure that the metro and light rail systems perform according to customer needs and operational targets. We do this through close collaboration with our operator, a solid data foundation and a continuous focus on improving performance.




About the role

As Asset Performance Analyst, you will play an important role in developing how we monitor, analyse and assess the performance and condition of metro assets.




Finding meaningful signals in a system that already performs at a very high level demands a particular mindset: the ability to notice small deviations, ask why they occur, and recognise their potential significance before they become problems. That kind of attention – applied consistently and curiously across complex technical systems – is what drives improvement at this level.




The role has two closely connected dimensions:




1. Asset performance monitoring in HMAX

You will help develop our asset performance monitoring setup in HMAX, Hitachi’s asset performance management platform, which is currently being rolled out. Together with colleagues, our operator and Hitachi, you will configure monitoring logic, establish relevant baselines and thresholds, and ensure that the platform provides meaningful insight at system, subsystem and component level.

As HMAX superuser, you will also support the correct and consistent use of the platform within Metroselskabet and in collaboration with our operator. This includes supporting users, contributing to onboarding and acting as a link between business needs, users and platform capabilities.




2. Data analysis and asset condition assessment

In parallel, you will work directly with operational and maintenance data. You will build analyses and models that can identify patterns, degradation trends and anomalies that require investigation.

You will translate findings from monitoring and data analysis into asset condition assessments that support prioritisation of maintenance initiatives, improvement projects and long-term reinvestment decisions.




Your main responsibilities

Develop and maintain asset performance monitoring in HMAX, including baselines, thresholds and monitoring logic.
Work with the operator, Hitachi and internal technical specialists to configure HMAX for Copenhagen Metro’s operational context.
Act as HMAX superuser and promote correct, consistent and value-creating use of the platform.
Analyse operational, maintenance and asset data to identify degradation patterns, deviations and performance trends.
Investigate anomalies at system, subsystem and component level and assess their potential operational significance.
Translate analysis and monitoring findings into asset condition assessments and recommendations for reinvestment prioritisation.
Develop and contribute to improvement initiatives across technical disciplines and in collaboration with our operator.
Help strengthen Metroselskabet’s data-driven approach to asset management and continuous improvement.




About you

We expect that you:

Hold a relevant degree in engineering, data science or a similar technical field.
Have experience from the rail industry, preferably within signalling, operations, maintenance or asset management.
Have experience working with asset management, maintenance or operational performance data.
Are analytical, structured and curious about complex technical systems.
Have an eye for small deviations and are motivated to investigate their causes and potential implications.
Can work independently with open-ended analytical tasks while collaborating closely with technical and operational stakeholders.
Communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing.




It is an advantage if you have experience with:

Analytical coding and working directly with data, for example in Python, SQL or similar.
Asset performance management platforms, dashboards, monitoring logic or alert structures.
Reliability engineering methods, such as FMEA, root-cause analysis, failure trend analysis or Weibull analysis.
Collaboration in a contract-managed operating environment.




We offer

You will join a small, highly skilled team with an informal culture, significant professional autonomy and close collaboration across maintenance, engineering, operations and data disciplines.

You will work with high-quality operational and maintenance data from a complex, highly automated metro system. The role combines two complementary analytical disciplines: structure and monitor development in HMAX and carrying out independent, in-depth analyses of raw operational and maintenance data.

Your work will directly support the continued reliability and development of the Copenhagen Metro, including decisions on maintenance improvements and long-term reinvestments in critical public infrastructure.

We also offer an active social community with engaged colleagues.




Interested?

Please submit your application no later than the 28th of August. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the position, please contact Eva Duus at evd@m.dk or +45 7242 4864.

Title: Dataanalytiker med interesse for metode og dataanalyse
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være en del af et område med en høj politisk bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle analytiske modeller og andre dataunderstøttede løsninger, der skal bidrage til en mere effektiv inddrivelse af offentlig gæld? Har du stærke metodiske og dataanalytiske evner, og har du lyst til at afprøve dem på store datamængder? Så er du måske vores nye dataanalytiker i Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller.




I Center for data, analyse og modeller udvikler vi analytiske modeller og andre dataløsninger. Modellernes beregninger anvendes dels som input til at sætte den strategiske retning for inddrivelsesområdet og dels til at optimere driften via en datadreven optimering af inddrivelsesprocesserne.




Området har en høj grad af politisk bevågenhed, så forandringer er en del af hverdagen. Vi søger nye kolleger med et højt ambitionsniveau og en god metodisk og dataanalytisk faglighed, som vil være en del af vores team.




Vi arbejder med dataanalyser og analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet

Du bliver en del af et kontor, der kombinerer høj faglighed med tæt samarbejde i mindre grupper. Vi har en uformel omgangstone med højt til loftet. Kontoret består af mange fagligheder - fra fysikere til sociologier – alle dog med den fællesnævner, at vi interesserer os for metode og dataanalyse samt formidling af resultater til et bredt publikum.




Med udgangspunkt i et datawarehouse, der samler store mængder register- og transaktionsdata fra forskellige systemer, udfører vi dataanalyser og udvikler analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet. F.eks. udvikler vi modeller vedrørende skyldnersegmentering, fremskrivning, kursværdi, forældelse og produktionsstyring. Modellerne anvendes blandt andet til at belyse forskellige problemstillinger og konsekvenser, der er knyttet til områdets politiske og strategiske beslutninger.




Dine arbejdsopgaver vil være at:

Håndtere og kombinere data og gennemføre dataanalyse på store datamængder
Udvikle eller videreudvikle vores statistiske/analytiske datamodeller
Belyse problemstillinger på inddrivelsesområdet og præge faglige drøftelser om opstilling af analysedesigns, metodevalg m.m.
Formidle forretningsviden og analyseresultater i eksempelvis notater eller præsentationer
Koordinere og styre processer ift. leverancer til vores interessenter.




Selvstændig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og grundig profil

Vi forestiller os, at du ved ansættelsestidspunktet har afsluttet en akademisk uddannelse på kandidatniveau indenfor et samfundsfagligt eller naturvidenskabeligt område. Du kunne fx være økonom, politolog, sociolog, matematiker eller fysiker.




Det er vigtigt, at du:

Via dit studie eller tidligere arbejde har praktisk erfaring med at håndtere og analysere data ved brug af kvantitative analysemetoder, fx via SQL, SAS, SPSS, Matlab, R, Python eller lignende værktøjer
Interesserer dig for dataanalyse og analytiske metoder, og at du er hurtig til at sætte dig ind i nye programmeringssprog
Er grundig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og kan arbejde selvstændigt på projekter med en lang tidshorisont.




Det er en fordel, hvis:




Du har en stærk analytisk sans, som gør dig i stand til at fordybe dig i komplekse problemstillinger indenfor databehandling og -analyse. Dertil har du en politisk forståelse, så du kan se konteksten, hvori dit arbejde indgår. Endelig er du i stand til at formidle dine resultater i et klart sprog, og du trives i et nogle gange travlt arbejdsmiljø, der stiller krav til både hastighed og præcision.




Grundig introduktion og oplæring

Du kan se frem til et fagligt udfordrende job med samfundsrelevante arbejdsopgaver på en arbejdsplads, som lægger stor vægt på faglighed og samarbejde. Som nyansat vil du indgå i et grundigt introduktions- og oplæringsforløb, for hurtigt at komme ind i arbejdsopgaverne. Udover introduktionsforløbet vil du blive tildelt en fast kollega fra teamet, som vil kunne hjælpe dig og besvare spørgsmål i opstartsfasen.




Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send din ansøgning med CV, eksamensbevis og andre relevante dokumenter via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest søndag d. 30. august 2026. Spørgsmål besvares gerne af kontorchef Troels Verge på telefon 72 38 93 56 eller analytiker Sofie Scholl på telefon 72 37 82 59 eller mail sofie.scholl@gaeldst.dk.




Vi forventer at afholde 1. og 2. samtaler i løbet af uge 36 og 37. Der kan indgå en case og/eller person- og logikanalyse i rekrutteringsprocessen.




Forud for ansættelse foretager vi restancetjek for så vidt angår restancer til det offentlige. Vi indhenter straffeattest og referencer forud for ansættelsen.

Vil du være en del af et område med en høj politisk bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle analytiske modeller og andre dataunderstøttede løsninger, der skal bidrage til en mere effektiv inddrivelse af offentlig gæld? Har du stærke metodiske og dataanalytiske evner, og har du lyst til at afprøve dem på store datamængder? Så er du måske vores nye dataanalytiker i Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller.


I Center for data, analyse og modeller udvikler vi analytiske modeller og andre dataløsninger. Modellernes beregninger anvendes dels som input til at sætte den strategiske retning for inddrivelsesområdet og dels til at optimere driften via en datadreven optimering af inddrivelsesprocesserne.


Området har en høj grad af politisk bevågenhed, så forandringer er en del af hverdagen. Vi søger nye kolleger med et højt ambitionsniveau og en god metodisk og dataanalytisk faglighed, som vil være en del af vores team.


Vi arbejder med dataanalyser og analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet

Du bliver en del af et kontor, der kombinerer høj faglighed med tæt samarbejde i mindre grupper. Vi har en uformel omgangstone med højt til loftet. Kontoret består af mange fagligheder - fra fysikere til sociologier – alle dog med den fællesnævner, at vi interesserer os for metode og dataanalyse samt formidling af resultater til et bredt publikum.


Med udgangspunkt i et datawarehouse, der samler store mængder register- og transaktionsdata fra forskellige systemer, udfører vi dataanalyser og udvikler analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet. F.eks. udvikler vi modeller vedrørende skyldnersegmentering, fremskrivning, kursværdi, forældelse og produktionsstyring. Modellerne anvendes blandt andet til at belyse forskellige problemstillinger og konsekvenser, der er knyttet til områdets politiske og strategiske beslutninger.


Dine arbejdsopgaver vil være at:

  • Håndtere og kombinere data og gennemføre dataanalyse på store datamængder
  • Udvikle eller videreudvikle vores statistiske/analytiske datamodeller
  • Belyse problemstillinger på inddrivelsesområdet og præge faglige drøftelser om opstilling af analysedesigns, metodevalg m.m.
  • Formidle forretningsviden og analyseresultater i eksempelvis notater eller præsentationer
  • Koordinere og styre processer ift. leverancer til vores interessenter.


Selvstændig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og grundig profil

  • Via dit studie eller tidligere arbejde har praktisk erfaring med at håndtere og analysere data ved brug af kvantitative analysemetoder, fx via SQL, SAS, SPSS, Matlab, R, Python eller lignende værktøjer
  • Interesserer dig for dataanalyse og analytiske metoder, og at du er hurtig til at sætte dig ind i nye programmeringssprog
  • Er grundig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og kan arbejde selvstændigt på projekter med en lang tidshorisont.

Du har en stærk analytisk sans, som gør dig i stand til at fordybe dig i komplekse problemstillinger indenfor databehandling og -analyse. Title: BI Specialist - turn healthcare data into better care decisions
Description:
BI Specialist – turn healthcare data into better care decisions
Would you like to develop and deliver data-driven solutions for critical healthcare systems in Danish municipalities? As a BI Specialist, you'll work with the entire BI solution, from customer dialogue to implementation and support. Sounds exciting? Apply now!

The job
As a BI Specialist, you'll join the department responsible for the Cura BI solution. More than 30 municipalities use the solution to gain insights from elder care and social care data, budget and invoice home-care activities, and validate data sent to Statistics Denmark (DST). We're a small, close-knit team where you have real co-determination and influence over how our solutions develop.

As our new colleague in Columna Cura, you'll take on a broad role in the continued development of our SaaS-based BI solution, which is built on data from the Cura EHR system (an ERP-like system). You'll work with a complete Microsoft technology stack and engage with both backend and frontend. You can look forward to:


Taking co-responsibility for the continued development of the BI solution end to end, from requirements specification with customers to back- and frontend development, quality assurance, and implementation
Having dialogue with customers and colleagues about further development of solutions and requirements
Responding to customer enquiries and BI-related questions



You must be able to communicate in both Danish and English, spoken and written.

Joining the team
In our team, we work with only three releases a year. This gives you a predictable daily routine and the opportunity to delve deeply into our solutions. It's naturally busy at times, but the rhythm leaves room for both professional immersion and life outside of work. The team is part of Cura Projects & Service, where we ensure successful implementation projects and deliver services as needed. Read more about our Columna Cura portfolio here.

Your Qualifications
We're looking for a technical profile with experience from the BI world. You have a couple of years' experience in a similar position, and your educational background could be a master's degree in healthcare technology, Cand.Merc. (BI), IT Product Development, Information Science, or similar.

You have knowledge of the Microsoft technology stack, covering Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, and DAX. It's an advantage if you have worked with Targit before, but it's not a demand.

You're excited to take on a broad role covering both frontend and backend of our BI solutions, developing into a BI Swiss Army knife. With more than 10 years behind us, we've built a complex solution, so there's ample opportunity to dive into the technology and work with advanced BI challenges.

Healthcare domain knowledge is an advantage but not a requirement. However, a desire to work with healthcare data and build knowledge of the domain is essential to succeed in this role.

As a person, you are:


Thorough and detail-oriented - you don't leave things until they're properly worked through
Reliable and conscientious - people can count on things being done right, not just fast
Good at listening and building relationships, taking the time to understand what the customer actually needs before shaping the solution
Calm by nature and take things at your own pace, including when it comes to getting to grips with new and complex material
Motivated by making a real difference for others through good collaboration and a steady, persistent work effort



We don't expect you to master every part of this from day one. You'll be onboarded gradually, paired with experienced colleagues, and given time to grow into the full scope of the role. What matters most is your willingness to learn and your interest in the domain.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus
At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks, from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. In addition, we offer several employee benefits, such as paid home internet, health insurance, and a company pension scheme.

Never stop developing
Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international, and proudly rooted in Denmark, with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there's room to be professional and personal. It's not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here
We'll be assessing applications on an ongoing basis, as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you're always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Rasmus Bach Andersen, Senior Project Manager.

Get in touch

Mads Ole Sørensen

Talent Acquisition Partner
