Da distanceledelse i forvejen er en integreret del af vores hverdag, skal du hvile i at samarbejde på tværs af geografisk afstand, ligesom der må forventes rejseaktivitet til fællesaktiviteter i Hjørring.


Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send ansøgning med CV, uddannelsespapirer samt yderligere relevant materiale via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest mandag den 17. august 2026 kl. 12.


Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Anders Melchiorsen på telefon 72 37 98 35 eller souschef Dorota Macdonald på telefon 72 37 01 56.

Vi forventer at holde første samtalerunde fredag den 21. august 2026 og anden samtalerunde fredag den 28. august 2026. Der vil som led i ansættelsessamtalerne indgå en analytisk case, der skal løses hjemmefra og derefter præsenteres til en samtale. Derudover forventer vi at gøre brug af en personanalyse i rekrutteringsforløbet.


Forud for ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.


Hvis du går videre til ansættelse i rekrutteringsforløbet, skal du være opmærksom på, at vi foretager en undersøgelse af, om du har gæld, der er sendt til inddrivelse hos det offentlige. Vi undersøger ligeledes, om du har afgjorte kontrol- og/eller straffesager på skatte- og afgiftsområdet. Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.


Du skal være opmærksom på, at din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne sikkerhedsgodkendelse under din ansættelse i stillingen. Hvis du allerede er sikkerhedsgodkendt i en anden offentlig myndighed og bliver tilbudt stillingen, ønsker vi at overtage din sikkerhedsgodkendelse fra din nuværende arbejdsplads, hvis forudsætningerne for det er opfyldt.


Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Arbejdsstedet kan være Parallelvej 11, 9800 Hjørring, Lyseng Allé 1, 8270 Højbjerg eller Engelholm Alle 1, 2630 Taastrup.


Skat er ikke enkelt. Derfor har vi brug for dig.

I Skattestyrelsen bliver du en del af et fagligt og mangfoldigt fællesskab, hvor du får ansvar, udvikler dig gennem komplekse opgaver og får tæt sparring med dygtige kolleger – alt sammen inden for fleksible rammer.

Skattestyrelsen lægger vægt på at understøtte fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøftes mellem leder og medarbejder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.

Din udvikling betyder meget for os, og hos os får du gode muligheder for læring og en karrierevej, der er fleksibel og tilpasset dig, uanset hvor i livet du befinder dig.

Vi samarbejder på tværs af generationer, uddannelser, baggrunde og landsdele om at løse vores kerneopgave. Vores opgaver kræver viden, ekspertise og fordybelse. Din læringskurve vil derfor være stejl, og du styrker din faglighed og opbygger kompetencer, der følger dig videre i dit arbejdsliv.

Skattestyrelsen spiller en vigtig rolle i samfundet ved at sørge for, at ingen betaler hverken for meget eller for lidt i skat. Det er ikke en enkel opgave, men den er vigtig, og vi er stolte af at sikre finansieringen af den offentlige sektor. Skat er alles ansvar – og så er det vores arbejde. Og det kan også blive dit.

Skattestyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Title: Logistics & Data Coordinator - Waste Management
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Corporate Facilities (CFa)

Bagsværd, Denmark

Are you passionate about using data to understand and improve daily operations? Do you have a good understanding of logistics and enjoy working close to the operational reality behind the numbers?

We are looking for a Logistics & Data Coordinator to join our Waste Management team in Corporate Facilities at Novo Nordisk. In this role, you will combine data and logistics with active involvement in daily waste operations across Novo Nordisk sites in Denmark – turning data into practical improvements while helping the team keep operations running smoothly.

Your new role

This role offers a diverse mix of analytical, operational and collaborative tasks. As our Logistics & Data Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring a solid data foundation for our waste management activities. You will be responsible for the upload, consolidation and quality assurance of operational data in our Waste Management system, including maintaining accurate information on containers and related services. You will structure, validate and analyse data to identify trends and deviations that support our daily operations.

With your analytical mindset and understanding of logistics processes, you will monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to optimise collection frequencies, fill rates, transportation needs and container solutions.

The role goes beyond data and analysis. You will be an active part of our day-to-day operations, coordinating orders and operational requests, collaborating closely with colleagues, internal stakeholders and external suppliers, and acting as a key point of contact for resolving waste- and logistics-related issues.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Ensure accurate data foundation for finance, invoicing, reporting, and internal controls ‌
Maintain and update operational and master data
Collect, validate, analyse, and present operational data and insights
Work with colleagues and suppliers to coordinate activities, solve issues, and improve operations
Help optimise collection schedules, transport needs, fill rates, and container solutions


Your Skills And Qualifications

We are looking for someone with strong numerical and analytical skills who is motivated by combining data with logistics and daily operations. You are an advanced Excel user, comfortable working with data and able to translate it into practical operational insights.

Ideally, You Bring


Experience with data processing and analysis in an operational or business context.
Experience with or a good understanding of logistics and operational processes.
A structured and analytical approach with the ability to identify patterns, deviations and improvement opportunities.
The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and take ownership of your responsibilities.
Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues, stakeholders and external suppliers.
Good written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.
Experience with or knowledge of the waste area is an advantage, while analytical capabilities, logistics understanding and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in the role.


You have good system understanding and are comfortable learning and working with digital tools. Knowledge of Power BI or similar tools is an advantage.

You are operationally minded and enjoy being close to the daily operations. You are curious about the connection between data and operations and able to turn insights into practical improvements.

Your new department

The Waste team, based in Bagsværd, is responsible for waste operations across Novo Nordisk sites in Denmark. We work to ensure stable and efficient waste management while contributing to Novo Nordisk's environmental and climate ambitions.

Our work combines daily operations, logistics, data and continuous improvement and requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

We value teamwork and shared responsibility. You will have your own areas of responsibility while being part of a team where we support each other in solving both day-to-day operational tasks and more complex challenges.

The Waste team is part of Corporate Facilities, which enables Novo Nordisk to focus on its core business by providing solutions and services related to physical infrastructure, workplaces and facility operations.

What We Offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary: Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 437,600.00 to 643,200.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Sr. Manager Charlotte Ahrens at cnxa@novonordisk.com.

Deadline


August 2026


Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that you do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, include a few sentences in your CV outlining your motivation for applying. To support a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly ask candidates not to include a photo in their CV.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to enhance productivity.

Experience with monorepo codebase.
Experience with data privacy engineering technologies and best practices in handling sensitive data.

Title: Associate, Business Intelligence & Reporting
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for a Business Intelligence & Reporting Associate to join us in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Team
You will become part of a global team responsible for a broad range of commercial and strategic initiatives. The team plays a central role in providing business intelligence insights and works closely with colleagues across the organization.

You will join an international and diverse group of 60+ professionals representing 15 nationalities and a wide range of professional backgrounds, including private markets, investment banking, management consulting, and law. Team members are based across Europe, North America, and Asia.

Role
As our new Business Intelligence & Reporting Associate, you will support the business by conducting data analysis, business intelligence, and reporting activities and initiatives. You will help produce, manage, and evolve the various reports used to "run the business" and enable informed decision-making. This will also include systems and applications (e.g. CRM, Power BI or equivalent, underlying data sources, data warehouse, etc.).

This role is instrumental in (i) driving a robust approach to data-driven decision-making; (ii) generating actionable insights; (iii) creating predictive models; and (iv) supporting fundraising and investor engagement processes.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

Coordinating and producing weekly management reports and analytics for the ExCom and Senior Partners to inform strategic decision-making
Supporting with development, implementation, and visualization of best-in-class processes and procedures
Developing and maintaining systems and applications to ensure functionality aligns with business evolution
Ensuring accurate data collection, pipelines, and databases to establish data integrity, and implementing governance frameworks across all relevant areas
Transforming raw data into actionable insights using statistical techniques, dashboards, and trend interpretation, including benchmarking and competitive positioning
Building and validating models, leveraging AI to predict trends and behaviours for informed decision-making
Designing dashboards, automating reports, providing real-time visualisations, and delivering insights (e.g., investor sentiment, profile, and pipeline status)
Advising on business strategy by providing insights on investor behaviour, market trends, operational efficiencies, and growth opportunities
Partnering with IT, Investments, Capital Formation, Finance, and other CIP functions to align data initiatives with business priorities and address specific challenges
Ensuring compliance with regulations (e.g., GDPR), maintaining data security, and promoting ethical data practices in collaboration with relevant CIP functions


You
We are looking for a motivated and collaborative candidate holding a relevant degree in Data Science, Engineering, Business Management, or related fields, with 0–2 years of experience in a similar role. You could come from an in-house strategy or consultancy role focusing on business intelligence and financial advisory. Experience with fundraising and business development in a similar industry is beneficial but not a requirement.

We look for the following in the candidate:

An analytical mindset with experience in developing models, interpreting trends, and delivering actionable insights
Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills
A client-first mindset and the willingness to go the extra mile to exceed expectations of external and internal clients alike
A genuine interest in AI tools and leveraging them to achieve better and faster results
Attention to detail and a structured approach to data management and reporting
Experience with Client Relationship Systems (e.g., Salesforce, DealCloud)
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work cross-functionally
The ability to work well in a time-sensitive environment
Knowledge of private markets or financial services is helpful, but not required


The process
Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

Building value that matters
Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

You will join an international and diverse group of 60+ professionals representing 15 nationalities and a wide range of professional backgrounds, including private markets, investment banking, management consulting, and law. Team members are based across Europe, North America, and Asia.

Role
As our new Business Intelligence & Reporting Associate, you will support the business by conducting data analysis, business intelligence, and reporting activities and initiatives. You will help produce, manage, and evolve the various reports used to "run the business" and enable informed decision-making. This will also include systems and applications (e.g. CRM, Power BI or equivalent, underlying data sources, data warehouse, etc.).

This role is instrumental in (i) driving a robust approach to data-driven decision-making; (ii) generating actionable insights; (iii) creating predictive models; and (iv) supporting fundraising and investor engagement processes.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:
  • Coordinating and producing weekly management reports and analytics for the ExCom and Senior Partners to inform strategic decision-making
  • Supporting with development, implementation, and visualization of best-in-class processes and procedures
  • Developing and maintaining systems and applications to ensure functionality aligns with business evolution
  • Ensuring accurate data collection, pipelines, and databases to establish data integrity, and implementing governance frameworks across all relevant areas
  • Transforming raw data into actionable insights using statistical techniques, dashboards, and trend interpretation, including benchmarking and competitive positioning
  • Building and validating models, leveraging AI to predict trends and behaviours for informed decision-making
  • Designing dashboards, automating reports, providing real-time visualisations, and delivering insights (e.g., investor sentiment, profile, and pipeline status)
  • Advising on business strategy by providing insights on investor behaviour, market trends, operational efficiencies, and growth opportunities
  • Partnering with IT, Investments, Capital Formation, Finance, and other CIP functions to align data initiatives with business priorities and address specific challenges
  • Ensuring compliance with regulations (e.g., GDPR), maintaining data security, and promoting ethical data practices in collaboration with relevant CIP functions

You
We are looking for a motivated and collaborative candidate holding a relevant degree in Data Science, Engineering, Business Management, or related fields, with 0–2 years of experience in a similar role. We look for the following in the candidate:
  • An analytical mindset with experience in developing models, interpreting trends, and delivering actionable insights
  • Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills
  • A client-first mindset and the willingness to go the extra mile to exceed expectations of external and internal clients alike
  • A genuine interest in AI tools and leveraging them to achieve better and faster results
  • Attention to detail and a structured approach to data management and reporting
  • Experience with Client Relationship Systems (e.g., Salesforce, DealCloud)

  • The ability to work well in a time-sensitive environment
  • Knowledge of private markets or financial services is helpful, but not required

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

Building value that matters
Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

Title: Portfolio Systems Associate
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Turn portfolio data into decisions that shape the future of digital health, and see your analytical skills drive real impact across a global R&D organisation.

Your new role

As a Portfolio Systems Associate in the Portfolio Management Group within AI & Digital Innovation (ADI), you will be the engine behind portfolio transparency, collecting, structuring and translating complex data into clear insights that inform prioritisation, governance and strategic decision-making across our digital portfolio.

Key Responsibilities Include


Collecting, validating and maintaining digital portfolio data across product teams, finance and portfolio systems to ensure one reliable view of status, progress, risks and performance
Building and updating portfolio dashboards, reports and analyses in Power BI that give leadership clear visibility on progress, financials, dependencies and value realisation
Translating portfolio data into concise insights and recommendations that support prioritisation, trade-off discussions and governance reviews
Identifying data gaps, quality issues and process inefficiencies, and proposing practical improvements to tools, templates, automation and reporting flows
Coordinating with stakeholders across the ADI matrix to secure timely input, alignment and follow-up on portfolio reporting and governance materials
Supporting portfolio governance processes, including meeting preparation, decision documentation and action follow-up
Contributing to automation opportunities using Power Platform, AI-enabled tools and modern analytics to make portfolio management more scalable and transparent


Your new department

In Research & Development, you'll be part of a unit that explores bold scientific ideas and advances them into clinical testing. We combine curiosity, AI tools, and human data to develop transformative therapies. Through collaboration and operational excellence, we shape and deliver an innovative pipeline to meet future patient needs.

Within R&D, the Portfolio Management Group (PMG) in ADI is responsible for enabling data-driven portfolio management across digital products and initiatives. The team drives portfolio transparency, governance support and continuous improvement, ensuring that leadership has the insights needed to make informed decisions about where to invest, prioritise and scale. You will join a collaborative, improvement-oriented team working at the intersection of data, analytics and strategic decision-making.

Your Skills & Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is analytically sharp, digitally curious and energised by turning messy data into clear direction.

You'll Bring With You


A Master’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related quantitative/technical field
1–2 years of relevant experience in portfolio management, business analytics, reporting, data management, consulting, finance or a similar analytical role
Strong proficiency in Excel and Power BI, with hands-on experience building dashboards, KPIs and management reporting that support decision-making
Ability to structure, clean and validate data from multiple sources, translating findings into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Experience working across functions in a global matrix organisation, with strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Familiarity with Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot or similar AI/low-code tools is an advantage, as is experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or regulated industries
Relevant certification in Power BI, Power Platform, AI productivity tools or project management (e.g. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum, SAFe) is a plus


Working at Novo Nordisk

At Novo Nordisk, your analytical work connects directly to something bigger, ensuring the right digital investments reach patients faster. Here, curiosity and a drive to improve are valued as much as technical skill. You will join a company where collaboration across disciplines is the norm, where data-driven thinking shapes real decisions, and where your growth is supported through exposure to global stakeholders, cutting-edge tools and a culture that encourages you to reach further. When you join us, you become part of a century-long mission to defeat serious chronic diseases, now powered by digital ambition and AI-enabled ways of working.

What We Offer

Beyond meaningful work and a globally connected team, you'll find competitive benefits designed for your life stage, real investment in your professional development, and an environment where diverse perspectives strengthen our collective impact.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600 to 734,400 DKK corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives And Benefits

The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Deadline

Please submit applications by 1st September 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Title: Senior Analyst, In-Field Repair Quality
Description:
As the largest global shared micromobility business, Lime is on a mission to build a future where transportation is shared, affordable and carbon-free. A Time Magazine 100 Most Influential Company, Lime has powered more than one billion rides in close to 30 countries across five continents, spurring a new generation of clean alternatives to car ownership. Learn more at li.me.

Lime is hiring a Senior Analyst to join our Global Operations team. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of improving in-field repair quality performance— developing key metrics, building tools that drive real-time visibility, and delivering targeted analysis that informs operational decisions and strategic opportunities.

You'll serve as the functional bridge between Local Operations and our Product organization, translating operational needs into structured data requirements and tooling improvements. You'll collaborate closely with Local Operations, Product, Data Science, and Hardware teams to help shape the future of Lime's in-field repair quality across all of our operations as we continue to scale.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, technically strong, and passionate about using data to solve complex problems. You're equally comfortable partnering with local operations teams and product or engineering stakeholders — and you know how to both structure a process and build a dashboard. If you have 3+ years of experience in business analytics or operations, strong data analysis and visualization skills, and a drive to influence outcomes through insight, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a hybrid role open to candidates based anywhere in Europe (London, Berlin, Paris, Munich, or Copenhagen preferred), within 120 minutes of a Lime warehouse. The role requires occasional travel (~10%) to Lime warehouses or other locations for team meetings.

What You’ll Do


Improve visibility into in-field repair quality: Define and maintain metrics to track repair performance, effectiveness, compliance, efficiency, and ROI — and build tooling to surface these insights in real time across operations
Build models and dashboards: Use SQL, Tableau, and spreadsheets to develop repair volume forecasting models, quality compliance dashboards, and performance reports for local operations teams — with robust logic, clearly defined assumptions, and intuitive interfaces
Monitor trends and diagnose performance gaps: Track repair efficiency and quality compliance over time, identify root causes behind variances or emerging trends, and recommend actionable solutions at both tactical and strategic levels
Turn operational complexity into structured clarity: Bridge Local Operations and Product/Tech by converting messy, real-world business needs into crisp specs, user stories, data requirements, and SOPs that teams can actually execute against
Formalize and improve operational processes: Map and document quality workflows, surface inefficiencies, and partner with Local Operations to define and roll out improved standard operating procedures
Collaborate with partner teams to improve efficiency: Provide insight and targeted analysis to troubleshoot issues or highlight opportunities. Partner with Operations leadership and local teams to land recommendations and drive action through to resolution
Drive continuous improvement in data analytics capabilities across global operations: Contribute to a culture of data-driven decision making and analytical excellence through peer collaboration, knowledge sharing, and support


About You


Extremely strong proficiency in data analytics, including advanced SQL, spreadsheet modeling, and data visualization (e.g. Tableau or equivalent).
Bachelor's degree in Business, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience
3+ years of experience in business analytics or operations analytics, with demonstrated ability to build reports and dashboards used by operational stakeholders
Experience translating business needs into functional data and reporting requirements, ideally working closely with a Product or Engineering team
Ability to structure and document operational processes, comfortable with ambiguity and working from first principles when standard frameworks don't exist
Curious mindset to spot trends in data, deep-dive root causes, and generate proposals for both tactical and strategic solutions
Clear verbal and written communicator, with strong collaboration and influencing skills across both field teams and technical stakeholders


Preferred Experience


Python, Google Apps Script, or other automation/scripting capabilities are a strong plus
Previous experience in a fast-paced, scaling operations environment (gig economy, last-mile, field services, or similar)
Experience working closely with Product or Engineering teams on tooling/product improvements


If you want to make an impact, Lime is the place for you. Not sure if you meet all the qualifications? If this role excites you we encourage you to apply. Explore all opportunities on our career page.

Lime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to building and developing a team that reflects a wider range of backgrounds, abilities, identities, and experiences. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or hiring process, please email recruiting-operations@li.me for assistance.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst
Description:
About Shine

Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

Data at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Product/Revenue Analytics. This structure ensures you spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value growth levers.

The Product Analytics team partners closely with Product to drive discovery, experimentation, and measurable impact. We are now looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to lead the strategy for our Banking domain—the technical and financial heart of Shine’s value proposition.

What's in it for you?


Strategic Discovery: You will lead "Phase 0" of the product lifecycle, sizing opportunities for new banking features and identifying friction points in the user journey before a single line of code is written.
End-to-End Experimentation: From power-calculating sample sizes to interpreting complex A/B test results, you own the validation of our product hypotheses.
High-Stakes Influence: You will translate “Data-speak” into “Business-speak,” presenting findings directly to Product Leads and the Head of Product Analytics to help the company pivot or persevere on key initiatives.
A Mature Stack: Work with a best-in-class modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python, and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across the globe
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam, or Berlin


Your Responsibilities


Strategic Partnership: Partner directly with Banking Product Managers to define North Star KPIs and influence the long-term roadmap.
Deep-Dive Analysis: Lead sophisticated analyses on user activation, transaction velocity, retention, and feature adoption within the banking ecosystem.
Data Governance: Own and continuously improve analytical datasets and core Banking KPIs, ensuring reliability, scalability, and clear documentation.
Enablement: Build actionable, self-service dashboards and mentor junior analysts to foster a high-performance data culture.
Best Practices: Contribute to evolving our internal analytics standards, from SQL styling to peer-review processes.


📍 Job located in Berlin, Madrid or Copenhagen with the possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You


Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, with a proven track record in a fast-paced, product-driven environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with DBT (modeling, testing, and documentation).
Product Mindset: You think in terms of user value and business outcomes, not just "queries completed."
Domain Expertise: Prior experience in Banking, FinTech, or regulated environments is highly valued.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English; excited to work in a diverse, international setting.


Our Recruitment Process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with your potential lead, to dive deeper into your experience

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Title: Forretningskonsulent
Description:
Vil du arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem lovgivning, data, forretning og teknologi? Hos Bankdata får du en central rolle i at omsætte regulatoriske krav og komplekse datamodeller til løsninger, der hjælper pengeinstitutter med at træffe robuste og velfunderede beslutninger.

Missionen: Skab klarhed i kompleksiteten

Som forretningskonsulent bliver du en del af Økonomi og Risiko, hvor vi udvikler løsninger til pengeinstitutter inden for blandt andet rating, scoremodeller, kredit- og modelrisiko samt nedskrivninger.

Din rolle er at skabe sammenhæng mellem komplekse regulatoriske krav, pengeinstitutternes behov og de tekniske løsninger, vi bygger. Du driver analyse- og afklaringsarbejdet i tæt samarbejde med Product Owner, udviklere, arkitekter og pengeinstitutter, så teamet kan omsætte krav og data til robuste løsninger.

Vi arbejder agilt med daglige check-ins, planning, refinement og retrospectives. Kulturen er præget af åbenhed, faglig sparring og et godt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og giver konkret feedback.

Dit bidrag: Fra regulatoriske krav til datadrevne løsninger

Du får en rolle med både faglig dybde og bred kontaktflade. Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder bliver at:


analysere og omsætte lovgivning og regulatoriske krav til løsninger, der understøtter pengeinstitutternes behov
drive analyse- og afklaringsarbejde fra problemforståelse til færdigt løsningsdesign i tæt samarbejde med Product Owner, udviklere og arkitekter
udarbejde prototyper, løsningsdesigns og beskrivelser af forretningslogik som grundlag for udvikling
analysere og validere data, beregningslogikker og datakvalitet på tværs af relevante datakilder ved hjælp af blandt andet SAS, SQL og Python
planlægge og gennemføre forretningsmæssige tests, så løsningerne lever op til både regulatoriske og forretningsmæssige krav



Du bliver et vigtigt bindeled mellem pengeinstitutter, Product Owner og udviklingsteam. Derfor er det centralt, at du kommunikerer klart, identificerer risici og uklarheder tidligt og bidrager med konkrete forslag til næste skridt. Du er med til at sikre, at løsningerne er robuste, skalerbare og tager udgangspunkt i både forretningsbehov og datamuligheder.

De første 6–12 måneder vil du:


opbygge en solid forståelse for teamets produkter, domæne og arbejdsform
bidrage aktivt til planlægning, refinement, test og udvikling af nye løsninger
arbejde med SAS, SQL, Python og andre relevante værktøjer i dit daglige arbejde med data
udvikle dine kompetencer på vores nye dataplatform, Databricks, og bidrage til at bygge nye løsninger herpå
anvende relevante AI-værktøjer og agenter til at øge effektivitet, styrke produktudviklingen og forbedre servicen over for vores kunder



Din profil: Struktureret, samarbejdsorienteret og nysgerrig på teknologi

Vi leder efter dig, der kan omsætte komplekse krav, data og forretningsbehov til klare løsninger. Du trives i samarbejdet med både faglige specialister, udviklere og forretningen – og du tager ansvar for at skabe fremdrift, også når opgaven kræver afklaring undervejs.

Vi forestiller os, at du har:


mindst 3 års relevant erfaring fra eksempelvis kredit, økonomi, risiko, finansiel IT eller forretningsanalyse
erfaring med eller interesse for rating, scoremodeller, kreditmodeller, risikostyring, nedskrivninger eller lignende områder
praktisk erfaring med SAS og SQL – og gerne kendskab til Python eller motivation for at lære det
erfaring med at forstå og omsætte kompleks lovgivning eller regulatoriske krav
en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund eller tilsvarende erfaring fra finanssektoren eller en IT-virksomhed



Som person er du nysgerrig, struktureret og samarbejdsorienteret. Du deler viden, bygger relationer og har lyst til at eksperimentere med nye teknologier og smartere måder at løse opgaver på.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Bankdata bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle både dig selv og de løsninger, vi bygger. Du får blandt andet:


en central rolle i et område, hvor regulering, data og teknologi mødes i løsninger med stor betydning for danske pengeinstitutter
mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt gennem sparring, 1:1-dialoger, LinkedIn Learning, kurser, certificeringer, konferencer og faglige netværk
en hverdag med tæt samarbejde, fleksibilitet, agile arbejdsformer og kolleger, der gerne deler viden og gør hinanden bedre



Vil du være med til at bygge løsninger med betydning?

Så send os dit CV via nedenstående link. Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt, og vi behandler ansøgninger løbende. Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Manager Rikke Brogaard Pedersen på rbp@bankdata.dk eller 21414749

Velkommen til Bankdata

Bankdata bygger software til finanssektoren. Vi er næsten 1000 kolleger på holdet, og vi udvikler digitale produkter, platforme og infrastruktur, som ca. hver tredje dansker, 200.000 virksomheder og flere tusinde bankansatte bruger hver dag.

Vi tror på struktureret personlig udvikling, et solidt kollegialt fællesskab og på, at ambitiøse medarbejdere med fleksible og bæredygtige arbejdsliv præsterer bedre. Bliv klogere på arbejdslivet i Bankdata her.

Hos Bankdata arbejder vi målrettet med at fremme mangfoldighed og diversitet blandt vores medarbejdere, og vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset kønsidentitet, alder og kulturel baggrund til at søge job hos os.

Bankdata er en af Danmarks vigtigste teknologivirksomheder. Vi går på arbejde for at finde teknologiske svar på finanssektorens forretningsproblemer. For at udvikle og bygge fremtidens digitale bank.

Title: Quantitative Developer
Description:
About the Opportunity:




Koda Staff is partnering with a leading systematic investment manager that combines technology, quantitative research and data science to build sophisticated trading strategies across global financial markets.




This is an opportunity to join a highly collaborative quantitative engineering team working alongside Researchers, Traders and Cloud Engineers to develop the technology that powers research, analytics and live trading. The environment is fast-paced, highly technical and focused on solving complex problems through engineering excellence and data-driven decision making.

If you're passionate about Python, quantitative development and building scalable data platforms, this could be an excellent next step in your career.




The Role:

As a Python Quantitative Developer, you'll play a key role in designing and developing production-grade applications and research infrastructure that directly supports quantitative research and trading activities.




Working closely with researchers and trading teams, you'll build scalable software, quantitative tools and cloud-native data platforms that enable better investment decisions.




Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain cloud-native Python applications supporting quantitative research and trading workflows.




Build applications including:

Market data dashboards
Risk analytics
Profit & Loss reporting
Weather analytics
Performance analysis tools
Develop quantitative tooling, including:
Backtesting frameworks
Optimisation libraries
Pricing libraries
ETL pipelines
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for both research and production environments.
Integrate, validate and process large alternative datasets
Monitor, troubleshoot and continuously improve existing research and trading infrastructure.
Collaborate closely with Quantitative Researchers, Traders and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality production software.




What We're Looking For:




3+ years of commercial Python development experience.
Strong knowledge of Python and numerical computing libraries, including:
NumPy, Pandas, Polars, Xarray
A strong quantitative mindset with an interest in financial markets and systematic trading.
Experience building scalable production software.
Experience developing ETL pipelines and processing large datasets.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including:
Git, Automated testing, Packaging, CI/CD and deployment
Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
Knowledge of object storage technologies.#
Comfortable working independently while collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders.




If you are located in Aarhus and this sounds like you, please apply directly.

Title: Analyst, Portfolio Management
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Drive Meaningful Change

Are you ready to drive meaningful change in the Danish pharmacy market? As an Analyst, Portfolio Management in our BD DK team, you’ll work closely with the Specialist, Portfolio Management to develop and maintain our DK Pharmacy portfolio. You’ll combine supportive responsibilities with ownership of initiatives that drive growth and improve performance, focusing on pricing, portfolio analysis, market-tool development, and automation of workflows.

Get a Glimpse of Our World

At Abacus Medicine, you’ll join our BD DK team consisting of dedicated professionals and student analysts working together to make a real difference in the Danish pharmacy- and hospital market. We’re ambitious and aim to set the standard for excellence in our field.

We value a supportive environment, personal development, and teamwork. Here, you’ll have the chance to take responsibility, challenge how things are done, and grow as part of a caring and driven team.

Realize Your Opportunities as a Portfolio Analyst

As an Analyst, Portfolio Management, you’ll play a key role in developing and expanding our DK Pharmacy portfolio. You’ll work closely with the Specialist, Portfolio Management, taking ownership of initiatives that drive growth and improve performance.

Your Main Responsibilities Include


Supporting and developing the DK Pharmacy portfolio
Setting prices in collaboration with the Pricing team, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Analyzing portfolio performance and sharing insights with internal and external stakeholders.
Helping to develop and improve tools for market analysis.
Automating portfolio workflows using coding and data collection.
Supporting product launches and lifecycle decisions with evidence-based analysis.
Preparing performance reports, forecasts, and ad-hoc analyses.
Monitoring market and regulatory developments, escalating risks, and proposing solutions.


Fuel for your success in the role

The ideal candidate is driven to get better every day and motivated by the ambition to help our team become the leader in the Danish pharmacy market. You’re curious, structured, and eager to learn—always looking for ways to sharpen your skills and contribute your share to our common goal.

You have a genuine interest in technical solutions and automation. Here, you’ll have the freedom and responsibility to use or develop your coding skills to automate tasks and support data-driven decisions that give us a competitive edge.

You thrive in a busy environment, enjoy working with a variety of tasks, and know that your actions make a real difference for the team and the business.

Furthermore, We Hope That These Factors Describe You


You hold a Master's Degree in business, economics or a related field.
Proficiency in data analysis tool and Microsoft Excel.
Fluency in English and Danish or another Scandinavian language.


Can you see yourself becoming our new Analyst, Portfolio Management?

If you want to apply for the position, please follow the link and attach your CV and cover letter. The Application deadline is the 7th of August but applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Interested?

Follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn and get an insight into everyday life at Abacus Medicine. For job openings, check our Career page.

Moving Healthcare. Moving You.

In Abacus Medicine Group, you’ll experience the power of Moving Healthcare. With our change mindset, we're moving the industry and improving healthcare as we broaden access to medicine.

But it's not just about moving healthcare, it's about Moving You. You’ll be part of a caring community of more than 1,750 people across the World. With us, you will be valued, empowered, and have a direct impact on driving change. Let's access the future of medicine and make a difference together. Your move.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med data og rapportering i en virksomhed, der er i gang med at skabe det rigtige datafundament til fremtidens krav og behov? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.




Vi er ved at skabe et fælles datafundament for hele Ejner Hessel - én sammenhængende model af data på tværs af forretningsområder, i Microsoft Fabric. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor du bidrager til både datamodellen og den rapportering, der gør data til reel indsigt, og hvor der er rig mulighed for at lære og vokse ind i opgaverne sammen med os.




Det kommer du blandt andet til at arbejde med:

Bygge og vedligeholde rapporter og dashboards i Power BI, der giver forretningen overblik og indsigt
Skrive SQL og lave datatransformationer, der understøtter vores datamodel
Være med til at oversætte forretningens spørgsmål til data og målinger, i dialog med afdelingerne
Bidrage til datakvalitet, dokumentation og god struktur i vores platform
Lære vores kanoniske model og dataarkitektur at kende og vokse ind i mere ansvar over tid




Du kommer til at arbejde med teknologier som Microsoft Power BI, SQL og T-SQL, Python, Microsoft Fabric og Azure.




Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund. Det kunne fx være cand.merc. i Business Intelligence, datalogi, datavidenskab eller en anden analytisk/teknisk retning.
Har en solid forståelse for SQL og lyst til at arbejde med data i dybden
Har erfaring med Power BI og datavisualisering
Forstår grundlæggende datamodellering og rapporteringsbegreber
Er nysgerrig på dataarkitektur og cloud og har lyst til at vokse ind i det
Kan oversætte data til noget, forretningen kan handle på, og kommunikerer godt med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske kolleger




Du er måske nyuddannet eller har et par års erfaring - det vigtigste er, at du har fundamentet på plads og lyst til at udvikle dig. Det er en fordel, hvis du kender bilbranchen men ikke et krav.




Som person er du nysgerrig, grundig og drevet af kvaliteten i dit arbejde. Du har sans for detaljen og for at sikre, at data er til at stole på. Du bevarer overblikket, når der er mange opgaver, og du er god til at prioritere. Du trives med en bred vifte af opgaver, tør stille spørgsmål og komme med idéer, og du er en holdspiller, der både kan arbejde selvstændigt og bidrage til fælles mål.




Sådan ser vi succes i rollen:

Du bygger pålidelige, veldokumenterede rapporter og datamodeller, som forretningen kan stole på
Du kommer hurtigt ind i vores værktøjer og datamodel og tager gradvist mere selvstændigt ansvar
Du bidrager aktivt til teamets fælles opgaver og til, at vores dataplatform vokser
Du bruger feedback konstruktivt og er drevet af at udvikle dig fagligt




Vi tilbyder en central plads i opbygningen af noget nyt, tæt samarbejde på tværs af dygtige kollegaer i Data, Digital og forretningen, og gode muligheder for at lære og udvikle dig - med reel indflydelse på, hvordan vi arbejder. Stillingen vil være tilknyttet vores kontor i Tilst.




Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Joakim Momme på j.momme@hessel.dk eller +45 5355 0593.

  • Skrive SQL og lave datatransformationer, der understøtter vores datamodel
  • Være med til at oversætte forretningens spørgsmål til data og målinger, i dialog med afdelingerne
  • Bidrage til datakvalitet, dokumentation og god struktur i vores platform
  • Lære vores kanoniske model og dataarkitektur at kende og vokse ind i mere ansvar over tid


Du kommer til at arbejde med teknologier som Microsoft Power BI, SQL og T-SQL, Python, Microsoft Fabric og Azure.


Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund. Det kunne fx være cand.merc. i Business Intelligence, datalogi, datavidenskab eller en anden analytisk/teknisk retning.
  • Har en solid forståelse for SQL og lyst til at arbejde med data i dybden
  • Har erfaring med Power BI og datavisualisering
  • Forstår grundlæggende datamodellering og rapporteringsbegreber
  • Er nysgerrig på dataarkitektur og cloud og har lyst til at vokse ind i det
  • Kan oversætte data til noget, forretningen kan handle på, og kommunikerer godt med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske kolleger


Du er måske nyuddannet eller har et par års erfaring - det vigtigste er, at du har fundamentet på plads og lyst til at udvikle dig. Det er en fordel, hvis du kender bilbranchen men ikke et krav.


Som person er du nysgerrig, grundig og drevet af kvaliteten i dit arbejde. Du har sans for detaljen og for at sikre, at data er til at stole på. Du bevarer overblikket, når der er mange opgaver, og du er god til at prioritere. Du trives med en bred vifte af opgaver, tør stille spørgsmål og komme med idéer, og du er en holdspiller, der både kan arbejde selvstændigt og bidrage til fælles mål.


Sådan ser vi succes i rollen:

  • Du bygger pålidelige, veldokumenterede rapporter og datamodeller, som forretningen kan stole på
  • Du kommer hurtigt ind i vores værktøjer og datamodel og tager gradvist mere selvstændigt ansvar
  • Du bidrager aktivt til teamets fælles opgaver og til, at vores dataplatform vokser
  • Du bruger feedback konstruktivt og er drevet af at udvikle dig fagligt


Vi tilbyder en central plads i opbygningen af noget nyt, tæt samarbejde på tværs af dygtige kollegaer i Data, Digital og forretningen, og gode muligheder for at lære og udvikle dig - med reel indflydelse på, hvordan vi arbejder. Stillingen vil være tilknyttet vores kontor i Tilst.


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Joakim Momme på j.momme@hessel.dk eller +45 5355 0593.

Title: Vil du være dataanalytiker og søger du en hverdag, der kombinerer dine evner inden for kodning og analyse med reel værdiskabelse?
Company: Styrelsen for International Rekruttering og Integration (SIRI)
Place: Valby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Så har du nu mulighed for en karriere i Styrelsen for International Rekruttering og Integration (SIRI). Hos os får du en central rolle i en statslig styrelse med højt til loftet, fokus på faglig udvikling, nærværende ledelse og fleksible rammer for tilrettelæggelsen af din arbejdstid.







Din nye arbejdsplads

Du bliver en del af Økonomi og Analyse, som har ansvaret for at skabe de bedst mulige forudsætninger for anvendelsen af SIRIs ressourcer. Vi arbejder bl.a. med videns- og analysearbejde, registerkontrol, driftsunderstøttende ledelsesinformation, regnskab, indkøb, gebyradministration, tilskudsforvaltning, kontrakter og udbud, samt økonomistyring og finanslovsarbejde.





Du bliver en del af teamet Kontrol og Data, hvor du kommer til at arbejde med syv erfarne kolleger og to studentermedhjælpere. Teamet udvikler analyser, ledelsesinformation og dataløsninger, der understøtter både den daglige drift og den strategiske udvikling af SIRI.





SIRI behandler hvert år mere end 100.000 sager og har omfattende kontakt med borgere og virksomheder. Det giver et stærkt datagrundlag, som vi bruger til at forbedre kvaliteten, effektiviteten og styringen af vores opgaver. Du får en central rolle i det arbejde ved at bidrage til, at SIRI står på et solidt datagrundlag.





I SIRI er digitalisering en vigtig del af vores hverdag. Vi arbejder med nye teknologiske muligheder (AI mv.) og søger aktivt efter nye muligheder for at styrke og effektivisere vores opgaveløsning, herunder at skabe øget værdi for borgere, virksomheder og medarbejdere.





Du kan læse mere om kontoret og SIRI her.







Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får ansvar for egne opgaver og bliver samtidig en aktiv medspiller i teamets samlede opgaveportefølje. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, deler viden og sikrer en solid og fleksibel opgavedækning.





Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:






Databearbejdning og klargøring af interne data til videre analyse og anvendelse (i regi af vores SAS-baserede datamiljø), særligt ift. SIRIs sagsbehandling, tværgående ressourcestyring og kontrolindsats.


Registersamkøring på tværs af forskellige datakilder i staten


Opgaver inden for drift af eksisterende og udvikling af nye SAS og PowerBI rapporter, samt gennemførelse af interne automatiserings-projekter, der sætter strøm til manuelle arbejdsgange.






I SIRI arbejder vi datadrevet hele vejen rundt, og har stor appetit på mere – du vil derfor møde en organisation der værdsætter dine kompetencer, og hvor du får rig mulighed for at sætte dem i spil. Vi arbejder med AI, machine learning og store datasæt, og du vil spille en vigtig rolle i at understøtte styrelsens arbejde med at sikre smidig adgang for udlændige til det danske arbejdsmarked samt overholdelse af vilkårene herfor.







Om dig

Du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse – eksempelvis inden for IT, økonomi, matematik, statskundskab eller sociologi. Der kan være mange veje ind, men fælles er evnen og ønsket til at arbejde med data.





Du har gerne et par års erfaring fra en offentlig myndighed, en større privat virksomhed eller et konsulenthus, men vi hører også gerne fra nyuddannede med stærke analytiske kompetencer og lyst til at lære.





Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:






Er proaktiv, ansvarsfuld og i samarbejde med dine kollegaer sikre, at vi får omsat data til beslutninger


Har god dataforståelse, herunder blik for transformationsprocessen fra kilde til visualisering


Har ønske om at dygtiggøre dig inden for håndteringen af komplekse datastrukturer og fx har erfaring med, eller har lyst til at lære det


Har erfaring med dataudtræk og beregning fra relationelle databaser (SQL) og kuber samt erfaring med Excel, SAS, R, SQL Server, Power BI eller andre udtræks- og visualiseringsværktøjer


Har erfaring med, eller mod på hurtigt at udvikle kompetencer inden for kodning i SAS


Finder det naturligt at drive processer fremad, er løsningsorienteret og selvstændigt kan bidrage med at identificere nye vigtige indsatser inden for dit ansvarsområde


Evner at skabe gode relationer og bidrager til en god stemning i kontoret






 

Hos os får du

Du kan se frem til tæt sparring med en ambitiøs og nærværende ledelse, som prioriterer trivsel, fleksibilitet og kompetenceudvikling højt. Vi har tillid til vores medarbejdere og giver dig mulighed for at følge dine opgaver fra idé til færdig løsning.





Derudover tilbyder vi dig en fleksibel arbejdstid med betalt frokostpause og en arbejdsplads med fokus på samarbejde, faglighed og balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv.







Yderligere information

Har du spørgsmål i øvrigt, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Morten Thaning Thulstrup på telefonnummer nr. 72 14 24 20 / e-mail mott@siri.dk, eller souschef Mads Emil Kjersgaard, på telefonnummer nr. 72 14 28 28 / e-mail maek@siri.dk.







Er du vores nye kollega?

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, CV, eksamensbevis mv. senest tirsdag den 25. august 2026.





Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 36.





Der vil være en skriftlig faglig test i forbindelse med en eventuel 2. samtale. Testen tager ca. en halv time og skal løses uden hjælpemidler hos SIRI forud for samtalen.







Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten og vil blive indplaceret som fuldmægtig eller konsulent på baggrund af dine kvalifikationer og erfaring. Der er mulighed for at forhandle tillæg, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.





Ansættelsesområdet er Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet med tilhørende institutioner, og arbejdsstedet er Styrelsen for International Rekruttering og Integration, Carl Jacobsens Vej 39, 2500 Valby.





Stillingen er en fast stilling på fuldtid med gennemsnitligt 37 timer om ugen.





Du skal være sikkerhedsgodkendt til ”TJENESTEBRUG” for at arbejde i denne stilling og kunne opretholde denne under hele din ansættelse. Du kan læse om, hvordan vi behandler dine persondata her.





Ligestilling i alle dens aspekter er vigtig. Derfor opfordres alle interesserede uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, køn, alder og lign. til at søge stillingen. Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet er medlem af Foreningen Lige Adgang.

Title: Data Management Consultant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & Technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include


Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.
Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.


About You

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:


ETL and Database technologies.
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.


Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Title: Data & Analytics Engineer for NAM Trading Quants
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 5318

Are you ready to be the driving force behind a modern data platform that shapes how trading decisions are made? We are looking for a skilled Data and Analytics Engineer who is passionate about building robust, scalable data infrastructure and data modelling solutions that unlock meaningful analytics and insights across our trading organization.

The role is a full time position based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Our Team

Meet the Trading Quants team. We add value by being change enablers that drive transformation of the investment process as part of an agile value stream where we identify business problems, define and implement solutions, to generate tangible value for our clients.

Drive Meaningful Change

Are you ready to drive meaningful change in the Danish pharmacy market? As an Analyst, Portfolio Management in our BD DK team, you’ll work closely with the Specialist, Portfolio Management to develop and maintain our DK Pharmacy portfolio. You’ll combine supportive responsibilities with ownership of initiatives that drive growth and improve performance, focusing on pricing, portfolio analysis, market-tool development, and automation of workflows.

Get a Glimpse of Our World

At Abacus Medicine, you’ll join our BD DK team consisting of dedicated professionals and student analysts working together to make a real difference in the Danish pharmacy- and hospital market. We’re ambitious and aim to set the standard for excellence in our field.

We value a supportive environment, personal development, and teamwork. Here, you’ll have the chance to take responsibility, challenge how things are done, and grow as part of a caring and driven team.

Realize Your Opportunities as a Portfolio Analyst

As an Analyst, Portfolio Management, you’ll play a key role in developing and expanding our DK Pharmacy portfolio. You’ll work closely with the Specialist, Portfolio Management, taking ownership of initiatives that drive growth and improve performance.

Your Main Responsibilities Include


Supporting and developing the DK Pharmacy portfolio
Setting prices in collaboration with the Pricing team, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Analyzing portfolio performance and sharing insights with internal and external stakeholders.
Helping to develop and improve tools for market analysis.
Automating portfolio workflows using coding and data collection.
Supporting product launches and lifecycle decisions with evidence-based analysis.
Preparing performance reports, forecasts, and ad-hoc analyses.
Monitoring market and regulatory developments, escalating risks, and proposing solutions.


Fuel for your success in the role

The ideal candidate is driven to get better every day and motivated by the ambition to help our team become the leader in the Danish pharmacy market. You’re curious, structured, and eager to learn—always looking for ways to sharpen your skills and contribute your share to our common goal.

You have a genuine interest in technical solutions and automation. Here, you’ll have the freedom and responsibility to use or develop your coding skills to automate tasks and support data-driven decisions that give us a competitive edge.

You thrive in a busy environment, enjoy working with a variety of tasks, and know that your actions make a real difference for the team and the business.

Furthermore, We Hope That These Factors Describe You


You hold a Master's Degree in business, economics or a related field.
Proficiency in data analysis tool and Microsoft Excel.
Fluency in English and Danish or another Scandinavian language.


Can you see yourself becoming our new Analyst, Portfolio Management?

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About the Role

We’re seeking a driven Data Scientist to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and bring predictive modelling, experimentation, and applied AI into a team that already understands the business deeply. This is a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.




Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and the Data Platform team. You’ll help move the organisation from “what happened” to “what will happen” - translating business questions into statistical or ML problems, building and validating models, and delivering outputs that plug into the day-to-day work. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.




Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:

Build, validate, and explain predictive models (classification, regression, time-series forecasting, cohort and churn analysis) that connect directly to a business process.
Apply NLP and LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows and unlock new capabilities - prompting, fine-tuning, and deploying language models where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Deliver model outputs in a consumable format, building and enhancing Power BI reports on our Microsoft Fabric data platform for management and internal stakeholders.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations, causal inference) to test what works before scaling.
Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.




What We Are Looking For In You:

1+ years of experience with data science, advanced analytics, or an analytics engineering role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Able to build, validate, and interpret classification and regression models.
Applied NLP and LLM experience. Comfortable prompting, training, and deploying language models to solve real problems.
Experience building predictive models that were actually used in production or by business stakeholders - not just academic exercises.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis or a well-scoped modelling problem.




Why Join Us?

Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.




Great to Have (But Not Required)

Deeper ML & AI intuition - e.g. cross-validation strategy, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, gradient-based optimization, model calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and RAG vs. fine-tuning for LLM work.
Exposure to Power BI, DAX, and/or Power Query.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing.
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort pulling data directly from a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).




What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.




Who we are at OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Description:
Har du interesse for data og analyse, som understøtter tusindvis af kunders behov og vigtige beslutninger i Jyske Bank-koncernen? Og motiveres du af at arbejde tæt på både forretningen og de tekniske løsninger? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Jobbet: gør data til værdi

I Business Intelligence arbejder vi hver dag på at omsætte data til indsigt, handling og forretningsmæssig værdi. Vi udvikler dashboards, analyser og intelligente dataløsninger, som bruges bredt i koncernen, fra bank og realkredit til stabsfunktioner og kundevendte områder i såvel Privat som Erhverv.

Som analytiker får du mulighed for at præge hele processen. Du er med fra de første idéer og dialoger med forretningen til udvikling, implementering og forankring af løsninger, der skaber konkrete resultater. Du kommer tæt på beslutningstagerne og får mulighed for at se dine analyser blive omsat til handling.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team bestående af 9 specialister og 2 studentermedhjælpere, som deler en passion for data, problemløsning og høj faglighed.

Dine primære opgaver


Udvikle og formidle dashboards og datadrevne løsninger, der understøtter forretningens beslutninger
Sparre med interessenter om mulighederne i data og analyser
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til brugbare og værdiskabende løsninger
Bidrage til indberetninger til offentlige myndigheder, blandt andet Nationalbanken og Finanstilsynet
Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og interessenter på tværs af hele koncernen


Din profil

Du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og får energi af at løse komplekse problemstillinger. Du er analytisk dygtig, nysgerrig og trives med at dykke ned i data for at finde svar og nye muligheder. Det kan være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra en lignende rolle.

Derudover Forestiller Vi Os, At


Du har gode kompetencer inden for dataanalyse, datamodellering og programmering
Du har solid erfaring med SAS eller lignende værktøjer
Du har erfaring med at bruge AI-værktøjer som fx Copilot eller lignende, og kan forholde dig kritisk til outputtet
Du har evnen til at formidle komplekse analyser på en enkel og forståelig måde
Du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse, eksempelvis cand.polit., cand.scient.oecon., cand.merc.IT, cand.scient. i matematik eller tilsvarende


Ansættelsestype: fastansættelse, fuldtid. Arbejdsstedet er København V.
