Title: Data Ops Analyst
Description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking for Data Ops Analyst to join its Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting the reliability and performance of its Databricks-based enterprise data platform. The role focuses on monitoring data pipelines, managing incidents, coordinating releases and production handovers, and ensuring data products are well-governed, scalable, and operationally ready. Working closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, you'll play a key role in delivering trusted data solutions while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as Data Ops Analyst

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:


Support the operation and reliability of Primark’s modern data platform helping manage Databricks, dbt Cloud and Azure data services while ensuring data products are production-ready, supportable and aligned with engineering standards.
Monitor and maintain critical data pipelines and platform services proactively identifying failures, delays, data quality issues and operational risks while coordinating incident triage, escalation and resolution to minimise business impact.
Coordinate releases, deployments and production handovers managing environment readiness, promotion activities, change governance, operational checklists, release schedules and service readiness documentation to ensure smooth delivery.
Drive operational excellence through governance and documentation maintaining runbooks, support guides, monitoring dashboards, service catalogues and reporting on platform health, SLA performance, deployment activity and support trends.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Platform, Cloud, Security, BAU and SIAM teams supporting access management, environment support, platform issue resolution, service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability and supportability.
Contribute to Primark’s data platform modernisation journey supporting the migration from Teradata to Databricks, validating production readiness, improving monitoring and automation capabilities and helping embed modern DataOps practices across deployment, observability and support processes.


What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


2-4 years’ experience in Data Operations, Application Support, Platform Support, Data Engineering Support or a similar operational role supporting business-critical systems and data platforms in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of modern data platforms and DataOps practices with exposure to Azure DevOps, Databricks, dbt Cloud, Azure data services, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, job scheduling, monitoring, observability and deployment automation.
Experience supporting production environments and service operations including monitoring, alerting, incident management, ticketing systems, release management, environment management, change governance and enterprise support processes.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate incidents methodically, identify root causes, assess business impact and drive issues through to resolution while maintaining high operational standards.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, Governance, SIAM, Analytics and business teams while clearly communicating technical issues and recommended actions.
Proactive, detail-oriented and continuous improvement focused with experience maintaining operational documentation, runbooks, handover materials and support processes while identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce recurring issues, increase automation and enhance overall platform supportability.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Title: Customer Data Analyst
Description:
Salary: Competitive plus benefits

Working Pattern: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

About Matalan

From humble beginnings to disruptive innovations in the retail industry, find out about how Matalan is ever-evolving here.

We know as a team, we are stronger together – we champion equality for all and make lasting connections that go beyond work. We thrive off our inclusive culture, encouraging our colleagues to bring their true selves to work and contributing to collective creativity, open-mindedness and growth.

We want give every candidate the opportunity to perform at their best throughout the application and interview process and then ultimately in their role. If you require any adjustments during our recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

In the event that a high volume of suitable applications are received, the post may close prior to the specified closing date. Please apply as soon as possible if interested.

About The Role

As a Customer Data Analyst, you’ll turn data into meaningful insight that drives real business impact. Sitting at the heart of our Customer, Ecommerce and Marketing functions, you’ll use data to shape smarter decisions, stronger campaigns and better customer outcomes.

You’ll take ownership of projects end-to-end, working with semi-structured data to uncover trends, answer key business questions and influence strategy.

What You’ll Be Doing


Owning and delivering analysis that goes beyond reporting to provide clear, actionable “so what” insights
Writing efficient, scalable SQL to unlock value from complex datasets
Applying structured analytical thinking to solve problems with minimal direction
Designing and building intuitive Power BI dashboards that bring data to life for stakeholders
Using testing and measurement techniques to evaluate performance and optimise campaigns
Ensuring data accuracy by understanding and managing data lineage end-to-end
Identifying data challenges and proactively improving data quality and reliability
Creating clear, accessible documentation so work can be easily reused and scaled
Partnering with Ecommerce and Marketing stakeholders to support decision making and performance


About You

You’re a curious, commercially minded analyst who enjoys digging into data and uncovering the story behind it. You’re confident working independently, but equally comfortable collaborating with stakeholders to drive impact.

You bring both technical expertise and a strong understanding of how data supports real business decisions.

What You’ll Bring


Strong SQL skills, with experience writing complex queries in a commercial environment
A solid understanding of analytics, testing and statistical methods
Experience translating data into clear, engaging insights using tools like Power BI
The ability to communicate complex findings in a simple, compelling way
Experience working with semi-structured data, ideally in a retail or B2C environment
A proactive approach to problem solving, with a focus on quality and accuracy
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and influence
A natural curiosity and desire to understand the “why” behind the data
A mindset of continuous improvement, always looking to develop and add more value


Benefits

In addition to competitive salaries, we also offer the below core benefits:


20% staff discount, which increases with length of service
Thrive Recognition Scheme
Wellbeing support provided by the Retail Trust
Life Assurance
Retail Rewards platform offering discounts for other retailers
Pension Scheme
Access to a wide range of career development
Additional benefits may apply depending on your role and area of the business

Title: Data Analyst (24-Month FTC)
Description:
We’re looking for a Supply Chain Performance Data Analyst to support the development, management and improvement of Logistics and Materials data while helping Northern Powergrid prepare for and transition to Oracle Cloud.




This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys combining project-based data work with ongoing operational analysis. You’ll support data migration, validation and cleansing activities while helping our Logistics and Materials teams improve reporting, strengthen data maturity and make better use of digital tools.




Working across Logistics, Materials Management and the Oracle transformation project, you’ll help ensure our supply chain data is accurate, accessible and used effectively to support operational and strategic decisions.







Along with a competitive salary of between £34,344 - £39,671 we also offer;

Enrolment onto our pension scheme
25 days holiday
Flexi-Time
£3,500 Retention Bonus







Key Responsibilities:




Supporting the cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation and migration of Logistics and Materials data into Oracle Cloud.
Developing performance reports, dashboards and management information that identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
Improving data quality, ownership, governance and reporting standards across Logistics and Materials Management.
Supporting system testing and validating data and reporting outputs.
Helping teams digitise and automate manual processes using Microsoft 365, Co-pilot and other available digital tools.
Working with operational teams, subject-matter experts and project colleagues to translate business needs into practical data solutions.
Supporting colleagues to adopt new systems, reports and data-led ways of working.







Key Competencies:




Experience analysing, cleansing, validating and presenting operational or supply chain data.
Excellent Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Excel and Power BI, with experience using tools such as Power Query, Power Automate, SharePoint and Microsoft Lists.
Experience using Microsoft Co-pilot or other AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, reporting, productivity or business processes.
Experience producing dashboards, performance reports and management information from large or complex datasets.
Strong numerical, analytical and root-cause analysis skills, with excellent attention to detail.
The ability to communicate data clearly and work effectively with operational, project and technical stakeholders.
Experience supporting data migration, systems implementation, process digitisation or automation.
Knowledge of Logistics, Materials Management, inventory or warehouse operations.
Experience of Oracle Cloud SCM, Oracle E-Business Suite or another enterprise resource planning system.







Qualifications and Experience




Essential

Educated to A-level standard )or equivalent), with a minimum of two A-Levels. (In Mathematics or a related subject).
Experience of data manipulation and report writing.
Experience working with performance-reporting software tools.
Experience of report verification and contributing to the development of data-quality and performance tools.
A full, clean UK driving licence.

Desirable

A HND or equivalent qualification in Business, Procurement, or a related subject.
Experience of supply chain performance management and reporting.







Additional Information




The successful candidate’s appointment is subject to a satisfactory credit check

Location: Billingham




Applicants are considered on the basis of their suitability for the post irrespective of sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender re-assignment, race, age or disability, in accordance with the Equality Act 2010.

Title: Digital Consultant
Place: Newcastle Upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Location/s: UK-wide

Recruiter contact: Danielle Judd

Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices.

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant.
About The Business Unit
Mott MacDonald’s Advisory and Programme Delivery (APD) unit delivers both project, programme & commercial management (PPCM) services and advisory solutions across the built environment, defence, energy, water, environmental, transportation, health and care sectors.

We deliver tailored solutions that directly address our clients’ key challenges, combining our world-leading project expertise with unrivalled programme delivery capabilities and advisory services.

APD delivers services to projects ranging in scale and complexity up to £20bn, through the technical disciplines of programme management, project management, project controls, scheduling, cost management, estimating, infrastructure finance, management consulting, digital consulting and education, health and care management. 

Specialist advisory
Our industry-leading specialist advisory teams offer a range of transformational services that support our core project, programme, and commercial offering, as well as supporting our clients in addressing their business needs. These includes climate change, estimating and cost intelligence, health, safety and wellbeing, land advisory, planning PMO, quality management and risk management.

The specialist advisory team brings together multiple critical services in a connected offering, drawing on cross-sector best practice and expertise. We add huge value to our clients through our integrated approach, whilst relentlessly focus on excellence and our passion for improving society.

Overview Of The Role
We are looking for a Digital Consultant to deliver practical digital and data-enabled solutions across major projects and programmes. Working within the Digital PMO / project controls environment, the successful candidate will turn complex business, reporting and information needs into useful, maintainable outputs.

The role will own defined work packages and work directly with stakeholders to understand processes, validate requirements, assess data sources and agree success measures. Responsibilities include designing, prototyping, building and testing Power BI dashboards, data models, reporting pipelines, workflow automation and SharePoint-based collaboration structures.

The role requires independent delivery in complex environments. The successful candidate will document solution architecture, data lineage, assumptions, controls, testing and handover information; support training and adoption; and apply proportionate data quality, information management, assurance and governance principles.

The role will collaborate with project controls disciplines and wider delivery teams, contribute reusable assets and lessons, and provide practical advice and support to less experienced colleagues. This is a digital/data enablement role embedded in delivery rather than a standalone IT post.

Candidate specification
Essential:

Experience delivering Power BI reporting or analytics solutions, including data preparation, modelling, DAX and visualisation
Ability to work with limited supervision on complex assignments and own delivery from discovery through testing and handover
Experience capturing stakeholder requirements and translating business needs into practical, testable digital or data outputs
Working knowledge of Power Query / ETL and SQL, with experience integrating varied data sources
Strong communication and documentation skills, including supporting adoption and explaining solutions to non-specialists
Organised and delivery-focused, with experience in a project, programme, PMO or consulting environment

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About Us

BGA is a dynamic and rapidly growing automotive parts manufacturing and distribution company serving both UK and international markets. With a strong focus on innovation, technology, and continuous improvement, we use data-driven decision-making to support our growth and enhance operational performance.

As part of our ongoing digital transformation, we are investing heavily in data, systems, and analytics capabilities. This is an exciting opportunity to join a forward-thinking business where your work will directly influence strategic decisions, operational efficiency, and future business growth.

Position Overview

We are seeking a talented and analytical Data Scientist to join our growing Data & Technology team. This role offers the opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, including advanced analytics, predictive modelling, machine learning, business intelligence, and process optimisation.

A key part of the role will involve supporting the implementation of Oracle ERP and Warehouse Management Systems, helping shape the future data architecture, reporting capabilities, integrations, and business insights across the organisation.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with commercial awareness, enabling them to transform complex data into meaningful insights that drive business performance and support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models to solve business challenges and improve decision-making.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualisations that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the business.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for data-driven improvements and innovation.
Support the implementation of Oracle ERP and WMS, contributing to data migration, reporting design, data structures, and system integrations.
Develop predictive analytics and statistical models to optimise business processes and improve operational efficiency.
Work alongside software developers to create intelligent, data-driven applications and systems.
Maintain and improve ETL processes and data pipelines to ensure reliable and accurate data availability.
Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to the development of a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics, reporting, and data governance.


About You


Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a Data Science, Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related role.
Degree qualified in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, machine learning, and automation.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, subqueries, window functions, and query optimisation.
Experience developing dashboards and visualisations using tools such as Power BI.
Strong understanding of machine learning techniques, predictive modelling, and statistical analysis.
Experience building, maintaining, and improving ETL processes and data pipelines.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with strong attention to detail.
Ability to translate business requirements into practical analytical solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


Desirable Experience


Experience supporting ERP implementation projects, particularly Oracle ERP solutions.
Exposure to large-scale data migration and systems transformation programmes.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Knowledge of object-oriented programming languages such as Rust or C#.
Understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Experience within manufacturing, distribution, automotive, or supply chain environments.


Why Join Us


Opportunity to play a key role in a major business transformation programme.
Work with modern technologies and contribute to innovative, data-driven solutions.
Be part of a growing organisation that values technology, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Collaborative and supportive working environment.
Career development opportunities within a rapidly expanding international business.
Competitive salary and benefits package.


Benefits


Free onsite parking
Workplace pension
28 days holiday including bank holidays
Additional holiday entitlement linked to long service
Free tea and coffee
Flexible working opportunities
Ongoing training and professional development


If you are passionate about data, enjoy solving complex business problems, and want to make a meaningful impact within a growing international organisation, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV and cover letter outlining your experience and suitability for the role. We look forward to welcoming you to the BGA team.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
We’re VIVID! -We offer a vibrant, friendly, inclusive culture that supports, develops and attracts the best people!

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to develop and maintain high-quality reporting, semantic models and analytical solutions that support business decision making across VIVID. Working closely with Data Engineers, stakeholders and decision-makers, you'll ensure our data is accessible, reliable and delivers meaningful business insight.

Contractually based out of our Basingstoke office, this is a full-time permanent role working 37 hours per week and allows for a mix of office and home working.

On top of a competitive salary, you will also benefit from:


26 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the opportunity to buy or sell annual leave
A productivity-related bonus scheme to enhance your take-home
A generous contributory pension of 6%. We’ll match employee contributions between 7% and 10%
Life assurance paid at x 3 annual salary
Private medical insurance
Health care cash plan called Medicash
Enhanced pay for maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave
Access to counselling, legal and financial information
Electric car scheme
Huge variety of in-house & e-learning courses and a range of coaching and mentoring programmes


Here’s The Facts About The Role

The Analytics Engineer will primarily focus on Power BI development while working alongside Data Engineers to develop sustainable, analytics-ready data models, support data migration and validation activities, and contribute to improving data quality and consistency

You'll design, build and maintain Power BI semantic models, datasets and reporting solutions that provide reliable, actionable insights to support business decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the organisation, you'll gather reporting requirements, translate business needs into analytical solutions, and communicate findings in a clear and meaningful way.

Using SQL extensively, and with opportunities to develop your Python skills, you'll help create reusable data products that enable self-service reporting and analytics. You'll also play a key role in driving continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for automation, enhancing reporting processes, staying up to date with developments in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, and exploring emerging capabilities in AI and advanced analytics. Throughout your work, you'll ensure compliance with relevant legal, regulatory and organisational requirements while helping to build a modern, scalable analytics environment.

To succeed in this role, you'll have proven experience developing Power BI semantic models, reports and dashboards, as well as working closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into effective reporting solutions. We are seeking someone who can combine technical expertise with a strong understanding of business needs, ensuring data is accessible, reliable and delivers real value. Strong communication skills, a collaborative approach and a passion for continuous improvement will help you succeed in this role.

If you’re an Analytics Engineer with strong Power BI development skills and a passion for turning data into meaningful business insights, we’d love to hear from you. Click to apply today!

Interviews are due to take place WC 7 September (subject to change).

Title: Data Management Coordinator
Description:

Here at GXO, we’re seeking a Data Management Coordinator to join our Hinckley Point C site. You’ll be responsible for delivering accurate, insightful reporting to both internal and external stakeholders. You’ll analyse operational data, develop enhanced reporting solutions, and help drive business performance through data-led decision making. Working alongside operational leaders, customers and continuous improvement teams, you’ll play a key role in identifying trends, opportunities and efficiencies across the operations.

This is a full-time, permanent position. You will work Monday to Friday, 08:00 till 16:00, with the ability to work from home 1-day per week.

Pay, benefits and more:

We’re looking to offer a salary of up to £37,000 per annum, and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays). Your benefits package includes a company sponsored pension scheme, life assurance and access to our benefits platform, including retail discounts

What you’ll do on a typical day:



Own and manage operational KPI reporting, providing accurate and timely business insights
Analyse performance trends and conduct Root Cause Analysis to identify improvement opportunities
Develop and enhance management information reporting, dashboards and presentations for internal and customer stakeholders
Support continuous improvement initiatives by providing data analysis that drives efficiencies and cost savings



What you need to succeed at GXO:



Strong experience working with data, reporting, analysis and business intelligence tools
Advanced SQL and relational database knowledge, including data extraction and quality management
Experience working with Data Warehouse and ETL processes, alongside formats such as CSV, JSON and Parquet
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence decision-making at all levels of the business
Successful candidates must be able to obtain and maintain security clearance prior to commencement, including providing a minimum of 3 years’ UK employment, education and residential history

Ability to tackle challenges with positive attitude

Previous experience within a similar role

Title: Insight Analyst
Description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking an Insight Analyst to join its Applied Insights & Analytics team, helping transform data into actionable insights that drive better business decisions and commercial value. Working across areas including Trading, Buying & Merchandising, Supply Chain, Retail Operations, Finance, and Customer teams, the role involves analysing data, identifying opportunities, answering key business questions, and delivering clear, data-driven recommendations. As part of Primark’s innovative technology function, the successful candidate will collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to support business growth, leveraging strong analytical skills and commercial awareness to turn complex data into meaningful outcomes.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as Insight Analyst

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:


Deliver impactful business insights by partnering with stakeholders to understand commercial challenges, frame key business questions, and translate data into actionable recommendations that drive better decision-making.
Analyse and interpret complex datasets using SQL, insight applications, and reporting tools to uncover trends, identify risks and opportunities, and support decisions across Trading, Customer, Retail Operations, and other commercial functions.
Create compelling data-driven stories by turning complex analytical outputs into clear, concise insights, visualisations, and recommendations that are easily understood by both technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions, including dashboards, scorecards, and management reporting packs, ensuring outputs are accurate, consistent, user-friendly, and focused on delivering measurable business value.
Drive continuous improvement by identifying manual processes, recurring business questions, and opportunities to streamline, standardise, and optimise reporting and insight delivery across the organisation.
Collaborate with cross-functional Data & Analytics teams, including Business Partners, Senior Analysts, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists, while maintaining strong data quality standards and ensuring trusted, insight-led outcomes that support commercial growth and operational performance.


What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


Experience in analytics, insights, reporting, or commercial analysis within retail, apparel, grocery, FMCG, or other fast-paced consumer-focused environments, with strong SQL skills and the ability to confidently query, analyse, and interpret data to support business decisions.
Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and analytics tools, with experience creating insightful dashboards, scorecards, KPI frameworks, and performance reporting that drive measurable business outcomes.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect data and analysis to sales growth, conversion, margin improvement, markdown optimisation, stock availability, customer performance, and operational effectiveness.
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to transform complex analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives, visualisations, recommendations, and decision-support materials for a wide range of stakeholders.
Proven stakeholder management and commercial partnering experience, working collaboratively to understand business priorities, challenge assumptions constructively, shape analytical requirements, and deliver actionable insights linked to tangible value and benefits realisation.
A proactive and solution-focused mindset, comfortable working with imperfect data, applying appropriate quality checks, improving reporting processes, simplifying decision-making, and identifying opportunities to enhance productivity, reporting efficiency, and overall business performance.


Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Title: Data & Tracking Analyst (Dunfermline)
Description:
Data & Analytics team

3 days a week in the office, Leeds, Liverpool or Dunfermline

£35,000 To £45,000, Depending On Experience

Velstar is a full-service eCommerce agency working across DTC and B2B. We build on Shopify Plus, and on our own proprietary platform, for complex B2B requirements that need greater scale, reliability and compliance. Our Data & Analytics team is growing, and we're hiring a Tracking & Reporting Analyst to build out the tracking, reporting and data work our clients rely on to trade properly. Live client accounts, live budgets, live deadlines, not a training sandbox.

What You'll Own


Implementing and auditing GA4 and Google Tag Manager setups, including consent configuration, event tracking and custom dataLayer events
Setting up and validating performance marketing conversion tracking across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads and LinkedIn Ads
Maintaining server-side tracking, including tools like Stape, and migrations from client-side setups
Diagnosing tracking discrepancies and data quality issues using live GA4 and GTM data
Building client-facing reports and dashboards, using tools like Looker Studio, and AI tools such as Claude to speed up analysis
Picking up ad-hoc tickets and one-off projects across our client base


How you'll grow


Direct access to our Head of Data & Analytics for the calls that actually matter, not layers of process to wade through
Autonomy that scales with what you can already do, not a fixed review timeline
Exposure across DTC and B2B, Shopify, custom and headless builds, so your experience broadens rather than narrows
Client-facing from day one, sitting in scoping and delivery calls as the technical authority in the room


You'll be a good fit if


You understand how eCommerce sites work commercially, product pages, checkout, conversion funnels, not just marketing analytics in the abstract
You can commit to 3 days a week in our Leeds, Liverpool or Dunfermline office
You communicate clearly, with technical and non-technical people alike
You can plan and prioritise your own workload without being told what's next
You follow things through to completion, not just the interesting bits
You keep a level head under pressure, calm and considered rather than rattled, whether that's a broken pipeline or a client on the phone
You've worked in, or genuinely want, a fast-paced, commercially focused environment, not a quiet one


What you'll bring


1 to 3 years' hands-on experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager
Solid experience with conversion tracking across multiple ad platforms, not just one
A genuine appetite for troubleshooting, not just implementing
Confidence using AI tools like Claude to support analysis and reporting, or a genuine willingness to learn how we use them


What you'll get


Support and mentoring to build skills in server-side tracking, attribution and multi-platform conversion setups
Growing autonomy as your skills develop, from supported delivery to owning tickets and projects independently
Hybrid working, 3 days a week in the office
Flexi-time
28 days holiday, including bank holidays, rising to 33, plus your birthday off
Option to roll, buy or sell up to 5 days each year
Career development support
Vitality Health cover from day including mental health support, therapy and virtual GP
Salary sacrifice pension, so more of what you pay in reaches your pension rather than the taxman

Title: Technical Data Analyst (SQL)
Description:
Job Summary:

The Technical Data Analyst is responsible for maintaining investment data for clients. This role involves tasks such as analyzing and organizing raw data, building data systems and pipelines, conducting complex data analysis, and presenting information through data visualization techniques. Additionally, the analyst collaborates with clients and project management teams to grasp customer and company needs. This role requires the ability to merge data from various sources and present it in alignment with customer/company requirements, while also striving to improve data quality and reliability.




Responsibilities:

Utilize your analytical expertise to decipher and organize raw data, transforming it into valuable insights.
Build efficient and robust data systems and pipelines, ensuring seamless data flow.
Dive into complex data sets, conducting thorough analysis and delivering insightful reports on outcomes.
Showcase your findings using cutting-edge data visualization techniques, making data come to life.
Harness the power of multiple data sources, combining raw information into comprehensive and actionable insights.
Continuously explore innovative methods to improve data quality and reliability, contributing to the highest standards.
Develop and implement analytical tools and programs that empower teams to make data-driven decisions.
Collaborate closely with system architects and product development teams, fostering an environment of innovation and excellence.




Required Skills:

Familiarity with cloud platforms and big data technologies (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Understanding of database design and data warehouse principles.
Strong understanding of investment data, good to have
Knowledge of one or more programming languages (e.g. Java, Python, VBA).
Proficiency in data manipulation and data cleansing techniques.
Knowledge of data governance and best practices in data management.
Continuous improvement mindset for self and team.
Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.
Ability to work with large datasets and perform data mining tasks.
Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organisational and interpersonal skills.
Exceptional problem-solving abilities.




Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, statistics, accounting, computer science, or related discipline.
4+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, reporting, and visualization.
Hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases
Experience with data integration and exchange, transfer, load processes.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or D3.js.
Familiarity with dbt/Prophecy good to have, but not essential

Bibby Financial Services are growing, and we’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Team in Banbury. As a Data Analyst you will play a pivotal role in shaping the data strategy and analytical capabilities of the organisation. This role will be responsible for delivering high-impact insights, building scalable data solutions, and laying the foundation for a growing data function. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders across the business to understand data needs, develop reporting frameworks, and support decision-making through robust analysis.




At Bibby Financial Services (BFS), we’ve been helping small and medium-sized businesses thrive and grow since 1982. Working across 9 countries, we provide the funding and support that give our clients the confidence to take their next step, whether that’s expanding, innovating or breaking into new markets. We’re proud to be part of Bibby Line Group, a long-standing family business and one of the UK’s oldest independent companies

Ensure reporting solutions are scalable, accurate and aligned with business requirements
Adhere to standards and processes around PowerBI and automated report development
Design develop and maintain dashboards and automated reports to support operational and strategic decision making
Translate complex data findings into clear and concise recommendations
Proactively explore data to uncover opportunities for process improvement and business growth
Work closely with the data engineering team to ensure availability, accuracy and reliability of data reports and BI dashboards
Design and maintain robust data models that support efficient querying, reporting and advanced analytics
Work closely with stakeholders across departments to gather requirements, understand business challenges and deliver tailored analytical solutions
Act as a trusted advisor on data-related matters

Previous experience as a data analyst
Experience translating business problems into analytical solutions
Experience of data modelling principles, including dimensional modelling, relational databases and business logic design.
Previous experience with:
PowerBI (or equivalent) for data visualisation and dashboard creation
SQL for data extraction and manipulation and analysis
Python or R for analysis and automation
Experience carrying out complex analysis of business data to deliver key business goals




What you’ll get in return:

25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, increasing with service, with buy/sell options
Performance Bonus

Company pension scheme

Plus, much more!

Title: Learning Data Analyst
Description:
Hours: Permanent, full time, 37 hours per week (1.0 FTE)

Salary: Band 4 - £33,002 to £36,636 per annum (pay award pending)

About The Post

Join our creative, collaborative Directorate of Education and Student Experience at the University of Suffolk as we innovate in learner analytics and evaluation to enhance the student experience.

About The Team

Our vision is simple: we are passionate about student success. We work in partnership with staff to transform learning and teaching, empowering students to become engaged, independent, and employable. Joining our friendly, forward-thinking directorate means working in an agile, supportive environment that values curiosity, innovation, and shared success where your ideas can help shape the University’s use of learning analytics and data reporting capacities.

Based in the Directorate of Education and Student Experience, you will work closely with colleagues across the institution (including academic course teams, Student Life, Registry, Access and Engagement, Research and Evaluation, and Educational Development team) to support course evaluation and monitoring processes and review the impact of interventions and longer-term support programmes.

You will support the directorate in the delivery of services which contribute to continuous monitoring of the quality of the student experience and outcomes. Your support contributes to essential mechanisms which ensure we provide a consistently high-quality learning experience and comply with regulatory standards.

About You

We are looking for a Learning Data Analyst who under the supervision of the Head of Quality Enhancement and TEF, will collect and analyse data from across institutional platforms and systems and develop mechanisms to enable accurate and timely monitoring of student progress, satisfaction, and outcome measures. You will work with colleagues across the institution to support evaluation and monitoring processes and review the impact of quality enhancement interventions. You will thrive in an evolving environment and knowledge and experience of selecting and applying a wide range of statistical techniques accurately, creating and maintaining data dashboards, delivering detailed analyses and comprehensible reports to stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who is flexible and with a solutions-focused attitude who can respond to fast paced and changing environment.

Benefits


Generous annual leave entitlement of 25 days for Bands 1-4 and 30 days for Bands 5 and above, plus 8 bank holidays and any university closure days.
Enjoy an extra day of paid leave on your birthday, subject to qualifying/service conditions.
Flexible working, including family friendly policies.
Competitive workplace pension scheme (USS) - with an employer contribution rate of 14.5%, tax relief on contributions and life cover.
Staff discounts at a number of local amenities in Ipswich.
Discounted membership at Adastral Park Leisure and Sports.
Access to a range of high-quality learning and development opportunities.
Discounted rates for staff approved to study a UoS undergraduate or postgraduate course, subject to a set of criteria and conditions.
Cycle to Work scheme.
Electric vehicle salary sacrifice.
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).
Staff recognition annual awards.


Closing Date: Friday 11 September 2026

Interview Date: Monday 21 September 2026

For an informal conversation about the role, please contact Markus Copping, Head of Quality Enhancement and TEF (m.copping@uos.ac.uk)

Thinking of using AI to help with your application?

AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, etc) can help you get started and prepared for your interview but please remember that AI generated applications, CV and supporting information can easily be spotted. The applications that stand out most are the ones that feel genuine and reflect your unique self. Please see our Job Application Guidance for more information on the use of AI by job applicants.

Please note: We recommend that you apply as soon as possible, even if the closing date is in the future.

Applications received may be reviewed before the closing date and should we receive a high number of applications for this post, or high-quality applications which demonstrate suitability, we reserve the right to close the vacancy early. We may hold interviews as and when applications are received, and we reserve the right to offer to a candidate prior to the closing date.

We are a values driven organisation, committed to ensuring we remain a beacon for aspiration and achievement, while providing a great environment to work and study. We are committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community and we encourage applications from under-represented groups.

Contract: Permanent

Location: Nottingham Support Office




Join Our Team as a Clinical Trials Analytics Manager – Data Science & Analytics at Boots!

Are you passionate about data and its power to transform healthcare? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your insights can make a real difference? If so, we want to hear from you!




About Us

At Boots, we’re dedicated to building a brilliant workplace for our people, empowering them to make a difference for our customers and colleagues every day. Our Data Science and Analytics team is at the forefront of this mission, using our world-renowned Advantage Card Data and other first-party sources to create actionable insights that drive value and enhance customer experiences.




The Role

As a Clinical Trials Analytics Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our clinical trials proposition. You’ll work closely with our Life Sciences and Clinical Trials team, leveraging Boots’ extensive patient data to deliver insights that support biopharmaceutical requests and improve trial strategies. Your analytical skills will help identify target audiences, optimise campaign performance, and present compelling findings to stakeholders.




What We’re Looking For

We’re seeking a numerate, logical individual who is curious about customer data and passionate about creating actionable insights. You should have:

A relevant degree or experience with strong quantitative elements (e.g., Maths, Physics, Psychology).
The ability to translate complex business questions into analytical problems and develop scalable solutions.
Strong verbal and written communication skills to present findings to diverse audiences.
A proactive approach to career development and a drive to challenge the status quo.




Why Join Us?

At Boots, we believe in you! You’ll be part of a supportive team that values collaboration and inclusion. Here’s what you can expect:

Generous Employee Discounts: Enjoy discounts for you and a family member.
Retirement Savings Plan: Benefit from up to 12% company contribution.
Enhanced Leave: Enjoy enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption leave pay.




Our Values

We pride ourselves on being a place where everyone feels welcome and valued. Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, and continuous learning. We encourage you to bring your authentic self to work and contribute to a positive and inclusive environment.

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and make a meaningful impact, apply now! Our team will be in touch to discuss your application and the next steps. People

Reporting to: Chief Football Officer

Closing Date For Applications: 25th August 2026

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Head of Football Intelligence to lead the club’s Football Intelligence provision across the First Team, Academy and Women’s programme.

Reporting into the football leadership team, the successful candidate will be responsible for the continuous development of the club’s data and insights strategy, ensuring these are integrated into decision-making processes. This role will combine a mix of strategic leadership and hands-on delivery, supporting performance analysis, recruitment, squad planning and other key football projects.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Access to high street and gym discounts.
  • Discount within our Club shop.
  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

People

  • Lead, develop and mentor the Football Intelligence team, helping to create a collaborative and forward-thinking culture.
  • Build and manage strong relationships across the football operation, including recruitment, performance analysis, medical and sports sciences, and football leadership.
  • Communicate complex data insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support the continuous development of the First Team, Academy and Women’s programme.

Product

  • Lead the development of key projects including recruitment models, player and squad profiling, recruitment lists, pre- and post-match analysis, benchmarking frameworks, reporting and other decision-support tools.
  • Deliver data-informed insights and key recommendations to the football leadership team, actively supporting recruitment, squad planning and decision-making.
  • Oversee and manage the club’s football data ecosystem, ensuring that all pipelines, reports, infrastructure and tools support the club’s long-term strategy and goals.

Process

  • Working in close collaboration with the senior football leadership team, define and implement a long-term Football Intelligence strategy and vision.
  • Work with and across all football departments to integrate data-informed insights into existing workflows and decision-making processes.
  • Where required, manage data budgets, contracts and relationships with external data providers, ensuring scalable and sustainable insights delivery.

What are we looking for:

Essential

  • Relevant qualification in Data Science, Sports Science, Performance Analysis or equivalent.
  • Significant experience working within elite football in a football analytics role.
  • Proven experience translating complex football data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of recruitment, match analysis and key decision-making processes.
  • Experience developing decision-support tools including player profiling and reporting.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python and/or R.
  • Experience working with data visualisation platforms and web apps.
  • Experience leading projects and collaborating across multidisciplinary football departments.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Strong understanding of technical and tactical aspects of football.

Desirable

  • Previous experience leading or mentoring a data insights team at elite level.
  • Experience managing the development of football data infrastructure and ETL pipelines.
  • Experience working with event, tracking and physical performance datasets.
  • Experience working with football data providers and other external solutions.
  • Evidence of continued professional development through relevant certifications, research or industry engagement.

Forest For Everyone

Title: Product Business Analyst (Structural)
Description:
Joining Arup

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

Oasys Structural is part of the Product Engine within Arup's Digital Technology Group and is responsible for the development and delivery of a portfolio of structural engineering software products and digital workflows, including GSA, AdSec, Compos and Grasshopper-based engineering solutions. The team brings together structural engineers, software developers, product managers and technical specialists to create tools that help engineers solve complex design and analysis challenges around the world.

The team follows a product-led approach focused on understanding user needs, delivering impactful solutions and continuously improving how engineers work through software, automation and digital technology. The team collaborates closely with engineering practitioners across Arup's global business, ensuring that product development remains grounded in real engineering challenges and opportunities.

The Opportunity

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

As a Business Analyst within the Oasys Structural team, you will work at the intersection of structural engineering, software development and product management, helping shape products and digital workflows used by engineers across Arup and the wider engineering industry. Working closely with structural engineers, software developers, technical leads and product managers, you will help identify the right problems to solve and translate complex engineering challenges into high-quality software solutions.

You might spend one day facilitating workshops with engineers to understand emerging workflows and opportunities for automation, and another working with developers and technical leads to refine requirements for new capabilities in GSA, AdSec, Compos or Grasshopper Plugins. You will lead discovery activities, analyse complex problems, challenge assumptions and help create the clarity needed for teams to deliver successful products.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to broaden your career beyond project delivery and develop expertise in product management, software delivery, user research and digital product development, while continuing to apply your engineering knowledge in a highly technical and practical context.

If you are a structural engineer with a passion for software, optimisation, automation and improving engineering workflows, this role offers the opportunity to create impact at a global scale that is rarely possible through project delivery alone. You will help shape products and digital workflows used by thousands of engineers, influencing how engineering challenges are solved across projects, disciplines and regions.

Did you know: Our Digital Technology team are proud prior winners of the IT Team of the Year Award at the Chartered Institute of IT’s UK IT Industry Awards.

Is this role right for you?


You have experience using Oasys Structural Products and Grasshopper-based engineering workflows and passionate about improving how engineers work through software, automation and digital technology.
You enjoy understanding complex engineering challenges, working with users and turning insights into clear, actionable solutions.
You are comfortable bridging the gap between engineering, software development and product management, and can communicate effectively with a range of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You have experience with scripting, automation, APIs, computational design or engineering software integration.
You are a curious, analytical problem-solver who enjoys challenging assumptions, creating clarity and helping teams make better decisions.


What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We care about you and want you to perform at your best, which is why we offer one of the most competitive benefits packages in our sector.

As a member organisation, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance).

We also provide private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at Careers - Your Life at Arup .

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit our Careers page Our aim is to make this process as streamlined and easy as possible for our applicants.

Please note that all applicants must apply directly via the job portal and applications sent via email will not be considered. If this role is not quite what you are looking for, but you are interested in other opportunities for a future with purpose, please sign up to our Talent Community where you will be kept up to date with roles suitable for you to shape a better world.

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

An environment that will give you freedom to design with a purpose, focus on your skills to deliver quality work to our clients, opportunity to learn and share knowledge openly. You will have the opportunity to utilise your technical expertise to improve the lives of the most vulnerable in the communities in which we live and work through Arup's community engagement programme.  

You'll have access to lots of learning opportunities and ongoing training through Arup University and other learning programmes.

Title: Support Analyst
Description:
"At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."

Klipboard provides specialist software, services and support to deliver fully integrated trading and business management solutions to companies in the distributive trade – wherever they are in the world. With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively.

Klipboard is a global, growing business that embraces AI and emerging technologies to enhance customer outcomes, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We’re looking for people who are curious about or fluid with AI, open to change, and excited to learn how technology can improve the way we work and help our customers which is always supported by strong human insight and communication.


Klipboard is a market leader in the development and provision of rental industry software
Support Analyst role provides business-to-business software application support
Working in a global team supporting Klipboard products as well as databases and reporting tools
Communicating via multiple media – phone, e-mail, chat
Creating documentation and delivering customer training where required
Hybrid role – 40% home and 60% office based, potential for limited travel to customer sites
Covering support hours between 8am and 10pm on a rota basis


Key Responsibilities


Your responsibilities include but are not exclusive to:
Deliver a first-class service to our customers
Answer questions and troubleshoot issues quickly and efficiently.
Provision of high-quality updates to customers on a regular basis.
Correctly set the customers’ expectations.
Deliver on promises
Take personal responsibility for every case ensuring a proactive approach to resolution and ensure all parties are kept updated
Proactive management of assigned cases
Maintain excellent quality of cases with detailed notes
Always display a positive and can-do attitude
Identify solutions and preventative measures to improve the customer’s experience
Ensure all cases are progressed in line with Klipboard Rental SLA’s.
Team Working: Proactively share knowledge, help during times of leave/absence, and share service improvement opportunities.
Be curious to change, evolve and develop in ways that help us better serve our customers.

Essential

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:


Good IT skills with significant experience in a similar application support role
Knowledge of ERP or business IT systems
Experience of supporting applications with MS SQL databases, including script/query writing
Always display a “customer first" attitude
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey technical information in a clear and concise manner
Ability to troubleshoot effectively and strive for first time resolution of issues.


Desirable


Knowledge of Crystal Reports
Knowledge of Sage Accounting Solutions
Appreciation for all products and services in the Klipboard offering
Experience in the Rentals industry


Company Info

You may also have seen from our recent posts that we are excited to begin sharing our new company name – Klipboard. Kerridge Commercial Systems (KCS) is becoming Klipboard and our new brand is designed to bring together our expertise across distribution, automotive, retail, rental, transport management, manufacturing, and field service management. We have offices based across the world and we are looking for talented individuals to join our growing teams. Due to our growth over the last few years it is an exciting time to join us as we enter our next chapter! At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."

Equal Opportunities

As a global company, we value and respect the diversity of our workforce, aiming to empower everyone to embrace each other's differences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are integral to our company and culture. We recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce, where creativity and valuing differences enable us all to thrive and sparks innovation.

If you require any help, adjustments and/or support during the interview and offer process then please advise our TA or HR team.

Title: Senior Statistician
Description:
Brief Description

Location

This hybrid role is based in the UK, with office locations in Nottingham, Bicester, Manchester, London, and York.

Role Purpose

As a Senior Statistician, you will work across the business providing statistical analysis expertise, to support the successful delivery of client projects and internal workstreams. In this role, you would require support both on- and off- project from senior colleagues. You will be required to work closely with colleagues within multi-disciplinary project teams and externally with clients, external associates and third-party agencies to achieve project objectives.


Estimated 65-75% time on projects
10-15% business development & proposal writing
10-15% internal initiatives e.g. people management, thought leadership, team development


Essential Functions

Technical - General


Demonstrates a broad range of technical skills and can work on some tasks independently
Ensure quality control approaches are followed on all own projects and support given to junior members of the team in C activities. Supports efforts to improve QC practices and ways of working.
Clearly communicates approach and rationale in a client-facing project environment


Technical – HEOR specific


Will start to take more ownership of working deliverables, with contribution to entire 'section' of works. Examples include:
Writing sections of HTA dossiers for review by other team members
Writing up sections of analysis for review by other team members
Completing some areas of modelling independently (seeking follow-on QC from more experienced members of the team)
Completing some analysis independently (seeking follow-on QC from more experienced members of the team)


Project leadership and consulting


May lead smaller projects with support
Takes an active role in client communications and project meetings
Supports junior members of the project team
Ensure deliverables are submitted on time and according to budget
Effective management of own time and asks, proactively raising any resourcing issues as needed with line management, project leads, and the workload planning group.


People Leadership


May undertake line management responsibilities for 1-2 junior team members
Mentors and supports junior members of the project team


Team (functional) leadership


Contributes to internal initiatives to support team development e.g. training or best practice materials
Business development, thought leadership & external presence
Contributes to proposal discussions with clients and proposal development, with support if required
Contribute to thought leadership initiatives with senior leadership input


Requirements

Role-Specific Competencies


Scientific / Technical Expertise Applies deep subject matter expertise to deliver high-quality, credible, and accurate work. Stays current in relevant disciplines and uses knowledge to guide decisions, solve problems, and add value.
Project Delivery & Leadership Effectively plans, manages, and executes projects to deliver against scope, timelines, and quality expectations. Coordinates resources, anticipates risks, and ensures consistent delivery excellence.
Commercial Acumen Demonstrates understanding of financial drivers, client economics, and business strategy. Makes decisions that balance client value, growth opportunities, and organizational performance
Client Management Builds and maintains strong client relationships by understanding needs, managing expectations, and delivering value. Acts as a trusted partner and ensures a high-quality client experience
Data & Insight Utilization Uses data, analytics, and insights to inform decisions, identify trends, and improve outcomes. Translates complex information into actionable recommendations.


Skills And Experience


Consultancy experience
Worked in a client facing environment and understands delivery to time and budget, scoping, and managing competing project demands
Collaboration
Collaborates effectively with team members in the HEOR, wider PE and client team. Statisticians rarely work in isolation as they sit within multi-disciplinary teams such as Health Economists, Systematic Reviewers and Market Access colleagues
Strong R programming
R is our primary analysis tool, so proficiency is essential rather than desirable. Experience with GitHub for version control and code review is a significant plus
Indirect treatment comparisons
The most important technical area for this role. MAIC, STC, NMA and population-adjusted methods more broadly
Statistical aspects of HTA
Familiarity with what NICE and the other UK and European HTA bodies expect from the statistical components of a submission, and experience contributing to dossiers or technical documentation
Survival analysis
Standard parametric and flexible modelling for time-to-event endpoints, extrapolation, and an understanding of how these feed into economic models

Qualifications


A degree at 2:1 or above in an analytical subject (for instance mathematics, economics, engineering or scientific subject).
Postgraduate qualifications (e.g., MSc or PhD) involving statistics or health economics are highly valued, but not an absolute requirement.


Summary

  • Contributes to internal initiatives to support team development e.g. training or best practice materials

  • Contributes to proposal discussions with clients and proposal development, with support if required

Role-Specific Competencies

  • Data & Insight Utilization Uses data, analytics, and insights to inform decisions, identify trends, and improve outcomes. Translates complex information into actionable recommendations.

Skills And Experience

  • Consultancy experience
    • Worked in a client facing environment and understands delivery to time and budget, scoping, and managing competing project demands
  • Collaboration
    • Collaborates effectively with team members in the HEOR, wider PE and client team. Statisticians rarely work in isolation as they sit within multi-disciplinary teams such as Health Economists, Systematic Reviewers and Market Access colleagues
  • Strong R programming
    • R is our primary analysis tool, so proficiency is essential rather than desirable. Experience with GitHub for version control and code review is a significant plus
  • Indirect treatment comparisons
    • The most important technical area for this role. MAIC, STC, NMA and population-adjusted methods more broadly
  • Statistical aspects of HTA
    • Familiarity with what NICE and the other UK and European HTA bodies expect from the statistical components of a submission, and experience contributing to dossiers or technical documentation
  • Survival analysis
    • Standard parametric and flexible modelling for time-to-event endpoints, extrapolation, and an understanding of how these feed into economic models

Title: Information and AI Security Analyst
Description:
About The Job

Games Workshop has an exciting new opportunity for an Information and AI Security Analyst focusing on Governance, Risk and Compliance. We’re looking for someone enthusiastic about delivering an efficient and effective IT Solution, using their skills day in and day out to ensure Games Workshop teams comply with our AI policy by understanding and assessing AI risks associated with our software tools.

Working collaboratively with the Head of Information Security, you’ll meticulously protect Games Workshop from the risks associated with AI functionality within software applications through controls and software audits. You’ll take pride in safeguarding our business as you conduct comprehensive risk assessments of newly identified AI functionality

Your strong people skills combined with a positive approach will allow you to build a network of relationships that allows software owners to highlight new AI features as they arrive in their software applications. This approach will promote a culture of compliance and risk management relating to software and ensuring that we remain compliant with our AI policy.

We’re looking for someone who understands the importance of protecting Games Workshop, so you’ll spend time trying to really understand the challenges you are trying to solve as you review unauthorised usage of AI, identify policy breaches and emerging risk. You’ll also assess, implement and monitor appropriate AI governance controls across software applications. Being process driven you’ll document where AI capability exists within software packages and how its configured, always ensuring its usage complies to our company policy.

You’ll also be responsible for coordinating regular supplier due diligence requests ensuring we diligently audit our critical suppliers within defined timescales.

About

We’re looking for someone who can use logical reasoning to evaluate the risks associated with AI in a creative business. If you’re passionate about protecting the Warhammer brand and its assets with a knowledge of software licensing and software asset management apply today:

Working at Games Workshop

At Games Workshop we are looking for people who will do their best to understand the needs of the company and to put those needs first when they are at work. Because of this we believe that what you are like, hence the attitude you show to work and the way you choose to behave is even more important than your skills and experience.

The Warhammer World site is based just outside of Nottingham city centre and benefits from a nearby tram stop and free onsite car parking.

In return for your hard work, you will receive 33 days holiday per year (including public holidays), matching contributory pension scheme up to 7.5%, profit share bonus (subject to GW meeting profit targets) and option to join our Share Save scheme. Oh and let’s not forget, a staff discount of between 25% and 50% on our products!

Other Essential Information

Location: This position is granted on a hybrid working basis where you will be expected to work out of our head office in Lenton, twice a week

Closing date for applications is midnight, UK time, Monday 31st August 2026

How to Apply

To apply, please send us a letter or a video telling us why you want this job. This is a great opportunity for you to let us know that you understand what we are looking for.

Please include an up-to-date CV to support your application. When you’re ready, please click apply, below.
